-- public.admin_delete_attendance_today(p_token text, p_employee_id text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_delete_attendance_today(p_token text, p_employee_id text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_admin karyawan;
  v_today DATE;
  v_deleted INT := 0;
BEGIN
  -- Validasi: hanya SUPERADMIN
  v_admin := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_admin.role,'')) <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Superadmin can delete attendance.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  v_today := (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::DATE;

  DELETE FROM public.absensi
  WHERE employee_id = p_employee_id
    AND tanggal = v_today;

  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_deleted = ROW_COUNT;

  RETURN json_build_object(
    'success', TRUE,
    'message', 'Absensi hari ini untuk ' || p_employee_id || ' berhasil dihapus (' || v_deleted || ' record).',
    'deletedCount', v_deleted,
    'tanggal', to_char(v_today, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  );
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.admin_delete_reimbursement(p_token text, p_request_id text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_delete_reimbursement(p_token text, p_request_id text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_admin public.karyawan;
  v_attachment_path text;
  v_attachment_paths text[] := ARRAY[]::text[];
  v_deleted integer := 0;
BEGIN
  v_admin := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_admin.role, '')) <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Superadmin can delete Reimbursement records.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(p_request_id, '')), '') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ID pengajuan Reimbursement tidak valid.';
  END IF;

  SELECT attachment_path
    INTO v_attachment_path
  FROM public.hr_reimbursement_requests
  WHERE id = TRIM(p_request_id)
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pengajuan Reimbursement tidak ditemukan.';
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT p.storage_path), ARRAY[]::text[])
    INTO v_attachment_paths
  FROM (
    SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(v_attachment_path, '')), '') AS storage_path
    UNION
    SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(u.storage_path, '')), '')
    FROM public.hr_reimbursement_attachment_uploads u
    WHERE u.request_id = TRIM(p_request_id)
       OR (NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(v_attachment_path, '')), '') IS NOT NULL
           AND u.storage_path = v_attachment_path)
  ) p
  WHERE p.storage_path IS NOT NULL;

  -- Remove the child upload registry rows before deleting the parent request.
  DELETE FROM public.hr_reimbursement_attachment_uploads
  WHERE request_id = TRIM(p_request_id)
     OR (NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(v_attachment_path, '')), '') IS NOT NULL
         AND storage_path = v_attachment_path);

  DELETE FROM public.hr_reimbursement_requests
  WHERE id = TRIM(p_request_id);
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_deleted = ROW_COUNT;

  PERFORM public.log_activity(
    p_token,
    'DELETE',
    'REIMBURSEMENT',
    TRIM(p_request_id),
    'Superadmin menghapus pengajuan Reimbursement.',
    'SUCCESS'
  );

  RETURN json_build_object(
    'success', TRUE,
    'message', 'Pengajuan Reimbursement berhasil dihapus.',
    'deletedCount', v_deleted,
    'attachment_path', NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(v_attachment_path, '')), ''),
    'attachment_paths', to_json(v_attachment_paths)
  );
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.admin_delete_timeoff(p_token text, p_request_id text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_delete_timeoff(p_token text, p_request_id text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_admin public.karyawan;
  v_deleted integer := 0;
BEGIN
  v_admin := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_admin.role, '')) <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Superadmin can delete Time Off records.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(p_request_id, '')), '') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ID pengajuan Time Off tidak valid.';
  END IF;

  PERFORM 1
  FROM public.pengajuan_cuti
  WHERE id = TRIM(p_request_id)
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pengajuan Time Off tidak ditemukan.';
  END IF;

  DELETE FROM public.pengajuan_cuti
  WHERE id = TRIM(p_request_id);
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_deleted = ROW_COUNT;

  PERFORM public.log_activity(
    p_token,
    'DELETE',
    'TIME_OFF',
    TRIM(p_request_id),
    'Superadmin menghapus pengajuan Time Off.',
    'SUCCESS'
  );

  RETURN json_build_object(
    'success', TRUE,
    'message', 'Pengajuan Time Off berhasil dihapus.',
    'deletedCount', v_deleted
  );
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.admin_get_attendance_history(p_token text, p_employee_id text, p_year integer, p_month integer)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_get_attendance_history(p_token text, p_employee_id text, p_year integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_month integer DEFAULT NULL::integer)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_admin karyawan;
  v_year INT;
  v_month INT;
  v_result JSON;
BEGIN
  -- Validasi: hanya ADMIN
  v_admin := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_admin.role,'')) NOT IN ('ADMIN','SUPERADMIN') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  -- Default bulan ini
  v_year := COALESCE(NULLIF(p_year, 0), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::DATE)::INT);
  v_month := COALESCE(NULLIF(p_month, 0), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::DATE)::INT);

  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(
    json_build_object(
      'id', a.id,
      'tanggal', to_char(a.tanggal, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
      'jam', to_char(a.jam, 'HH24:MI:SS'),
      'tipe', a.tipe,
      'statusApproval', a.status_approval,
      'latitude', a.latitude,
      'longitude', a.longitude,
      'accuracy', a.accuracy,
      'branchTarget', a.branch_target,
      'timestamp', to_char(a.timestamp, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
    )
    ORDER BY a.timestamp DESC
  ), '[]'::json)
  INTO v_result
  FROM public.absensi a
  WHERE a.employee_id = p_employee_id
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.tanggal) = v_year
    AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM a.tanggal) = v_month;

  RETURN json_build_object(
    'success', TRUE,
    'employeeId', p_employee_id,
    'year', v_year,
    'month', v_month,
    'records', v_result
  );
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.admin_get_reimbursement_records(p_token text, p_employee_id text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_get_reimbursement_records(p_token text, p_employee_id text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_admin public.karyawan;
  v_records json;
BEGIN
  v_admin := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_admin.role, '')) NOT IN ('ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Admin and Superadmin can view Reimbursement records.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(p_employee_id, '')), '') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pilih karyawan terlebih dahulu.';
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(to_jsonb(q) ORDER BY q.request_date DESC, q.created_at DESC), '[]'::json)
    INTO v_records
  FROM (
    SELECT
      r.id,
      r.employee_id,
      r.category,
      r.request_date,
      r.period_start,
      r.period_end,
      r.amount,
      r.note,
      r.status,
      r.manager_approval_at,
      r.manager_approval_by,
      r.manager_note,
      r.hr_approval_at,
      r.hr_approval_by,
      r.hr_note,
      r.created_at,
      r.updated_at,
      (NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(r.attachment_path, '')), '') IS NOT NULL) AS has_attachment
    FROM public.hr_reimbursement_requests r
    WHERE r.employee_id = TRIM(p_employee_id)
    ORDER BY r.request_date DESC, r.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 250
  ) q;

  RETURN json_build_object('success', TRUE, 'records', COALESCE(v_records, '[]'::json));
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.admin_get_timeoff_records(p_token text, p_employee_id text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_get_timeoff_records(p_token text, p_employee_id text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_admin public.karyawan;
  v_records json;
BEGIN
  v_admin := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_admin.role, '')) NOT IN ('ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Admin and Superadmin can view Time Off records.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(p_employee_id, '')), '') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pilih karyawan terlebih dahulu.';
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(to_jsonb(q) ORDER BY q.requested_at DESC), '[]'::json)
    INTO v_records
  FROM (
    SELECT
      p.id,
      p."timestamp" AS requested_at,
      p.employee_id,
      p.nama,
      p.kode_cuti,
      p.keterangan_cuti,
      p.tanggal_mulai,
      p.tanggal_selesai,
      p.total_hari,
      p.alasan,
      p.status_atasan,
      p.status_hr,
      p.alasan_atasan,
      p.alasan_hr,
      p.timestamp_atasan,
      p.timestamp_hr,
      p.delegate_to,
      p.dinas_luar_sakit,
      p.area_sakit
    FROM public.pengajuan_cuti p
    WHERE p.employee_id = TRIM(p_employee_id)
    ORDER BY p."timestamp" DESC
    LIMIT 250
  ) q;

  RETURN json_build_object('success', TRUE, 'records', COALESCE(v_records, '[]'::json));
END;
$function$


;

-- public.attendance_capture_schedule_snapshot()
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.attendance_capture_schedule_snapshot()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_branch text;
  v_day_type text;
  v_dow smallint;
  v_rule public.attendance_schedule_rules%ROWTYPE;
  v_delta numeric;
BEGIN
  v_dow := EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM NEW.tanggal)::smallint;
  SELECT h.branch INTO v_branch
  FROM public.attendance_employee_branch_history h
  WHERE h.employee_id = NEW.employee_id
    AND h.effective_from <= NEW.tanggal
    AND (h.effective_to IS NULL OR h.effective_to >= NEW.tanggal)
  ORDER BY h.effective_from DESC
  LIMIT 1;
  IF v_branch IS NULL THEN
    SELECT k.branch INTO v_branch FROM public.karyawan k WHERE k.employee_id = NEW.employee_id;
  END IF;
  v_branch := COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(v_branch), ''), 'Pusat');
  v_day_type := public.attendance_resolved_day_type(NEW.tanggal, v_branch);

  -- Regular shift times apply on working days/joint leave. Unscheduled work on Sundays,
  -- national holidays, or manual day-off dates is still accepted, but is not judged against
  -- a regular shift. If Super Admin overrides Sunday/holiday to WORKING_DAY, use normal shift.
  IF v_day_type IN ('SUNDAY','NATIONAL_HOLIDAY','DAY_OFF') THEN
    v_rule := NULL;
  ELSIF v_day_type = 'WORKING_DAY' AND v_dow = 7 THEN
    SELECT r.* INTO v_rule
    FROM public.attendance_schedule_rules r
    WHERE LOWER(BTRIM(r.branch)) = LOWER(BTRIM(v_branch))
      AND r.day_of_week BETWEEN 1 AND 6
      AND r.is_workday = TRUE
      AND r.effective_from <= NEW.tanggal
      AND (r.effective_to IS NULL OR r.effective_to >= NEW.tanggal)
    ORDER BY r.effective_from DESC, r.day_of_week
    LIMIT 1;
  ELSE
    SELECT r.* INTO v_rule
    FROM public.attendance_schedule_rules r
    WHERE LOWER(BTRIM(r.branch)) = LOWER(BTRIM(v_branch))
      AND r.day_of_week = v_dow
      AND r.effective_from <= NEW.tanggal
      AND (r.effective_to IS NULL OR r.effective_to >= NEW.tanggal)
    ORDER BY r.effective_from DESC
    LIMIT 1;
  END IF;

  NEW.employee_branch_snapshot := v_branch;
  NEW.calendar_day_type_snapshot := v_day_type;
  NEW.attendance_snapshot_at := now();
  NEW.punctuality_status := NULL;
  NEW.attendance_warning := NULL;
  NEW.early_window_minutes_snapshot := 30;
  NEW.late_tolerance_minutes_snapshot := 5;
  NEW.schedule_is_workday_snapshot := NULL;
  NEW.shift_name_snapshot := NULL;
  NEW.shift_code_snapshot := NULL;
  NEW.shift_label_snapshot := NULL;
  NEW.scheduled_check_in_snapshot := NULL;
  NEW.scheduled_check_out_snapshot := NULL;

  IF v_rule.id IS NOT NULL THEN
    NEW.shift_name_snapshot := v_rule.shift_name;
    NEW.shift_code_snapshot := v_rule.shift_code;
    NEW.shift_label_snapshot := v_rule.shift_label;
    NEW.scheduled_check_in_snapshot := v_rule.scheduled_check_in;
    NEW.scheduled_check_out_snapshot := v_rule.scheduled_check_out;
    NEW.early_window_minutes_snapshot := v_rule.early_window_minutes;
    NEW.late_tolerance_minutes_snapshot := v_rule.late_tolerance_minutes;
    NEW.schedule_is_workday_snapshot := v_rule.is_workday;
  END IF;

  IF NEW.tipe = 'MASUK' AND NEW.scheduled_check_in_snapshot IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_delta := EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NEW.jam - NEW.scheduled_check_in_snapshot)) / 60.0;
    IF v_delta < 0 THEN
      NEW.punctuality_status := 'EARLY';
      IF v_delta < -COALESCE(NEW.early_window_minutes_snapshot, 30) THEN
        NEW.attendance_warning := 'OUTSIDE_EARLY_WINDOW';
      END IF;
    ELSIF v_delta <= COALESCE(NEW.late_tolerance_minutes_snapshot, 5) THEN
      NEW.punctuality_status := 'ON_TIME';
    ELSE
      NEW.punctuality_status := 'LATE';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.attendance_resolved_day_type(p_date date, p_branch text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.attendance_resolved_day_type(p_date date, p_branch text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_type text;
BEGIN
  SELECT o.day_type INTO v_type
  FROM public.attendance_calendar_overrides o
  WHERE o.calendar_date = p_date
    AND (
      (COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_branch), ''), '*') = '*' AND o.scope_branch = '*')
      OR
      (COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_branch), ''), '*') <> '*'
       AND (o.scope_branch = '*' OR LOWER(BTRIM(o.scope_branch)) = LOWER(BTRIM(p_branch))))
    )
  ORDER BY CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_branch), ''), '*') <> '*'
     AND LOWER(BTRIM(o.scope_branch)) = LOWER(BTRIM(p_branch)) THEN 0
    ELSE 1
  END
  LIMIT 1;
  IF v_type IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN v_type; END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.attendance_calendar_source_days s
    WHERE s.calendar_date = p_date AND s.day_type = 'NATIONAL_HOLIDAY'
  ) THEN RETURN 'NATIONAL_HOLIDAY'; END IF;
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.attendance_calendar_source_days s
    WHERE s.calendar_date = p_date AND s.day_type = 'JOINT_LEAVE'
  ) THEN RETURN 'JOINT_LEAVE'; END IF;
  IF EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM p_date) = 7 THEN RETURN 'SUNDAY'; END IF;
  RETURN 'WORKING_DAY';
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.attendance_track_employee_branch_change()
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.attendance_track_employee_branch_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_effective date;
BEGIN
  IF NULLIF(BTRIM(NEW.branch), '') IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  -- New employees need an initial branch history row; otherwise a later branch update
  -- could make the current branch appear to apply to dates before the transfer.
  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    v_effective := COALESCE(NEW.join_date, CURRENT_DATE);
    INSERT INTO public.attendance_employee_branch_history
      (employee_id, branch, effective_from, effective_to, changed_by)
    VALUES
      (NEW.employee_id::text, BTRIM(NEW.branch), v_effective, NULL, NULL)
    ON CONFLICT (employee_id, effective_from) DO NOTHING;
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF NEW.branch IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.branch THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  v_effective := GREATEST(COALESCE(NEW.transfer_date, CURRENT_DATE), CURRENT_DATE);

  UPDATE public.attendance_employee_branch_history h
  SET effective_to = v_effective - 1, changed_by = NULL
  WHERE h.employee_id = NEW.employee_id::text
    AND h.effective_to IS NULL
    AND h.effective_from < v_effective;

  INSERT INTO public.attendance_employee_branch_history (employee_id, branch, effective_from, effective_to, changed_by)
  VALUES (NEW.employee_id::text, BTRIM(NEW.branch), v_effective, NULL, NULL)
  ON CONFLICT (employee_id, effective_from) DO UPDATE
    SET branch = EXCLUDED.branch, effective_to = NULL;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$


;

-- public.authorize_evidence_access(p_token text, p_storage_path text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.authorize_evidence_access(p_token text, p_storage_path text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_path text;
  v_role text;
  v_allowed boolean := false;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  v_path := trim(coalesce(p_storage_path, ''));
  v_path := regexp_replace(v_path, '^/?evidence/', '', 'i');
  v_role := upper(coalesce(v_emp.role, ''));

  IF v_path = '' OR v_path ~* '^(https?://|data:)' OR v_path ~ '(^|/)\.\.(/|$)' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Path foto tidak valid.';
  END IF;

  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
      FROM public.absensi a
     WHERE (
       (a.employee_id::text || '/' || a.id::text || '.jpg') = v_path
       OR nullif(regexp_replace(btrim(coalesce(a.storage_path, '')), '^/?evidence/', '', 'i'), '') = v_path
       OR nullif(regexp_replace(btrim(coalesce(a.foto_path, '')), '^/?evidence/', '', 'i'), '') = v_path
       OR nullif(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(btrim(coalesce(a.foto_url, '')), '^.*/storage/v1/object/(sign|authenticated|public)/evidence/', '', 'i'), '[?].*$', ''), '') = v_path
       OR nullif(regexp_replace(btrim(coalesce(a.foto_url, '')), '^/?evidence/', '', 'i'), '') = v_path
     )
       AND (
         a.employee_id = v_emp.employee_id
         OR v_role IN ('HR', 'ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN')
         OR (
           v_role = 'KARYAWAN'
           AND a.status_approval = 'PENDING_ATASAN'
           AND a.atasan_id = v_emp.employee_id
         )
       )
  ) INTO v_allowed;

  IF NOT v_allowed THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Anda tidak berhak melihat foto bukti ini.';
  END IF;

  RETURN json_build_object('success', true, 'storage_path', v_path);
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.authorize_evidence_upload(p_token text, p_absensi_id text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.authorize_evidence_upload(p_token text, p_absensi_id text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_att public.absensi;
begin
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);

  if p_absensi_id is null or trim(p_absensi_id) = '' then
    raise exception 'ID absensi tidak valid.';
  end if;

  select * into v_att
    from public.absensi
   where id::text = trim(p_absensi_id)
     and employee_id = v_emp.employee_id;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Data absensi tidak ditemukan atau bukan milik akun ini.';
  end if;

  return json_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'storage_path', v_emp.employee_id::text || '/' || v_att.id::text || '.jpg'
  );
end;
$function$


;

-- public.authorize_reimbursement_attachment_access(p_token text, p_storage_path text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.authorize_reimbursement_attachment_access(p_token text, p_storage_path text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_emp public.karyawan; v_owner public.karyawan; v_req public.hr_reimbursement_requests%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  v_emp:=public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  SELECT r.* INTO v_req FROM public.hr_reimbursement_requests r
  WHERE r.attachment_path=p_storage_path LIMIT 1;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Lampiran tidak ditemukan atau belum terhubung ke pengajuan.' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO v_owner FROM public.karyawan WHERE employee_id=v_req.employee_id;
  IF v_emp.employee_id=v_req.employee_id
     OR (v_owner.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id AND v_req.status='PENDING_ATASAN')
     OR (upper(coalesce(v_emp.role,''))='SUPERADMIN' AND v_req.status IN ('PENDING_HR','DISETUJUI','DITOLAK_HR'))
     OR upper(coalesce(v_emp.role,'')) IN ('HR','ADMIN') THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success',true);
  END IF;
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Anda tidak berhak melihat lampiran pengajuan ini.' USING ERRCODE='42501';
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.authorize_reimbursement_attachment_access_batch(p_token text, p_storage_paths text[])
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.authorize_reimbursement_attachment_access_batch(p_token text, p_storage_paths text[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_emp public.karyawan; v_path text; v_owner_id text; v_status text; v_approver text;
BEGIN
  v_emp:=public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF p_storage_paths IS NULL OR cardinality(p_storage_paths)=0 OR cardinality(p_storage_paths)>100 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Daftar lampiran tidak valid (maksimal 100 file per batch).' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  FOREACH v_path IN ARRAY p_storage_paths LOOP
    IF v_path IS NULL OR length(v_path)>500 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Path lampiran tidak valid.' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
    SELECT r.employee_id,r.status,k.approval_line_id INTO v_owner_id,v_status,v_approver
    FROM public.hr_reimbursement_requests r
    JOIN public.karyawan k ON k.employee_id=r.employee_id
    WHERE r.attachment_path=v_path LIMIT 1;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Salah satu lampiran tidak ditemukan.' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
    IF NOT (
      v_emp.employee_id=v_owner_id
      OR (v_approver=v_emp.employee_id AND v_status='PENDING_ATASAN')
      OR (upper(coalesce(v_emp.role,''))='SUPERADMIN' AND v_status IN ('PENDING_HR','DISETUJUI','DITOLAK_HR'))
      OR upper(coalesce(v_emp.role,'')) IN ('HR','ADMIN')
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Akses ke salah satu lampiran ditolak.' USING ERRCODE='42501';
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success',true,'storage_paths',to_jsonb(p_storage_paths));
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.authorize_reimbursement_attachment_upload(p_token text, p_category text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.authorize_reimbursement_attachment_upload(p_token text, p_category text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_emp public.karyawan; v_category text:=upper(btrim(coalesce(p_category,''))); v_path text; v_ext text;
BEGIN
  v_emp:=public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF upper(coalesce(v_emp.job_code,''))<>'HYBRID' OR v_category NOT IN ('ENTERTAIN','TRANSPORT') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Akses upload lampiran reimbursement ditolak.' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  v_ext:='pending';
  v_path:=v_emp.employee_id||'/'||v_category||'/'||gen_random_uuid()::text;
  INSERT INTO public.hr_reimbursement_attachment_uploads(storage_path,employee_id,category,expires_at)
  VALUES(v_path,v_emp.employee_id,v_category,now()+interval '15 minutes');
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success',true,'storage_path',v_path);
END;
$function$


;

-- public.bootstrap(p_token text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bootstrap(p_token text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_k karyawan;
  v_status json;
  v_office json;
  v_face json;
  v_has_sub boolean;
  v_sisa int;
  v_pending_abs bigint;
  v_pending_cuti bigint;
  v_role text;
  v_today date := (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::date;
  v_year int := extract(year from (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::date)::int;
begin
  v_k := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  v_role := UPPER(COALESCE(v_k.role,''));

  select json_build_object(
    'masuk', coalesce(bool_or(tipe = 'MASUK'), false),
    'pulang', coalesce(bool_or(tipe = 'PULANG'), false),
    'jamMasuk', coalesce(max(case when tipe = 'MASUK' then to_char(jam, 'HH24:MI:SS') end), ''),
    'jamPulang', coalesce(max(case when tipe = 'PULANG' then to_char(jam, 'HH24:MI:SS') end), ''),
    'statusApproval', coalesce(max(status_approval), 'VALID')
  )
  into v_status
  from public.absensi
  where employee_id = v_k.employee_id
    and tanggal = v_today
    and status_approval not in ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR');

  select json_build_object(
    'branch', branch,
    'alamat', alamat,
    'latitude', latitude,
    'longitude', longitude,
    'radius', radius_m,
    'maxAccuracy', max_accuracy_m
  )
  into v_office
  from public.lokasi_kantor
  where branch = v_k.branch
    and status = 'AKTIF';

  select json_build_object(
    'registered', v_k.face is not null,
    'canRegister', (
      v_k.face is null
      and exists (
        select 1 from public.face_sessions fs
        where fs.employee_id = v_k.employee_id
          and fs.status = 'AUTHORIZED'
          and fs.expires_at > now()
      )
    )
  )
  into v_face;

  select exists (
    select 1 from public.karyawan b
    where b.approval_line_id = v_k.employee_id
      and b.status_akun = 'AKTIF'
  ) into v_has_sub;

  select coalesce(
    (select sisa from public.sisa_cuti
      where employee_id = v_k.employee_id and tahun = v_year and kode_cuti = 'CT'),
    public.hris_calculate_remaining_leave(v_k.employee_id, v_year, 'CT'),
    0
  ) into v_sisa;

  select count(*) into v_pending_abs
  from public.absensi a
  where (
    (a.status_approval = 'PENDING_ATASAN' AND a.atasan_id = v_k.employee_id AND v_role IN ('KARYAWAN','SUPERADMIN'))
    OR (a.status_approval = 'PENDING_HR' AND v_role = 'SUPERADMIN')
    OR (v_role = 'ADMIN' AND a.status_approval IN ('PENDING_ATASAN','PENDING_HR'))
  );

  select count(*) into v_pending_cuti
  from public.pengajuan_cuti pc
  join public.karyawan pemohon on pemohon.employee_id = pc.employee_id
  where (
    (pc.status_atasan = 'PENDING' AND pemohon.approval_line_id = v_k.employee_id AND v_role IN ('KARYAWAN','SUPERADMIN'))
    OR (pc.status_atasan = 'DISETUJUI' AND pc.status_hr = 'PENDING' AND v_role = 'SUPERADMIN')
    OR (v_role = 'ADMIN' AND (
      pc.status_atasan = 'PENDING'
      OR (pc.status_atasan = 'DISETUJUI' AND pc.status_hr = 'PENDING')
    ))
  );

  return json_build_object(
    'profile', public.karyawan_to_profile(v_k),
    'hasSubordinates', v_has_sub,
    'status', v_status,
    'office', v_office,
    'faceStatus', v_face,
    'sisaCuti', v_sisa,
    'pendingTotal', coalesce(v_pending_abs, 0) + coalesce(v_pending_cuti, 0)
  );
end;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.change_my_password(p_token text, p_old_pin text, p_new_pin text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.change_my_password(p_token text, p_old_pin text, p_new_pin text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_emp karyawan;
  v_full karyawan;
begin
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);

  if p_old_pin is null or trim(p_old_pin) = '' then
    raise exception 'PIN lama wajib diisi.';
  end if;

  if p_new_pin is null or p_new_pin !~ '^\d{4,12}$' then
    raise exception 'PIN baru harus berupa angka 4-12 digit.';
  end if;

  select *
  into v_full
  from public.karyawan
  where employee_id = v_emp.employee_id
  for update;

  if v_full.pin_hash is null or v_full.pin_hash <> "extensions"."crypt"(p_old_pin, v_full.pin_hash) then
    raise exception 'PIN lama salah.';
  end if;

  update public.karyawan
  set pin_hash = "extensions"."crypt"(p_new_pin, "extensions"."gen_salt"('bf')),
      must_change_pin = false,
      updated_at = now()
  where employee_id = v_full.employee_id;

  return json_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'message', 'PIN berhasil diubah.'
  );
end;
$function$


;

END;
$function$

-- public.cuti_to_json(c pengajuan_cuti)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cuti_to_json(c pengajuan_cuti)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT json_build_object(
    'id', c.id,
    'waktuPengajuan', to_char((c.timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta'), 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI'),
    'nik', c.employee_id,
    'nama', c.nama,
    'kode', c.kode_cuti,
    'dinasLuarSakit', COALESCE(c.dinas_luar_sakit,false),
    'areaSakit', c.area_sakit,
    'keterangan', c.keterangan_cuti,
    'tanggalMulai', to_char(c.tanggal_mulai, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
    'tanggalSelesai', to_char(c.tanggal_selesai, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
    'totalHari', c.total_hari,
    'alasan', c.alasan,
    'dokumenUrl', c.dokumen_path,
    'statusAtasan', c.status_atasan,
    'statusHR', c.status_hr,
    'alasanAtasan', c.alasan_atasan,
    'alasanHR', c.alasan_hr,
    'approvalLineId', (SELECT k.approval_line_id FROM public.karyawan k WHERE k.employee_id = c.employee_id),
    'approvalLineName', (SELECT m.nama FROM public.karyawan k LEFT JOIN public.karyawan m ON m.employee_id = k.approval_line_id WHERE k.employee_id = c.employee_id),
    'delegateTo', c.delegate_to,
    'delegateToName', (SELECT k.nama FROM public.karyawan k WHERE k.employee_id = c.delegate_to LIMIT 1)
  );
$function$


;

-- public.delete_lokasi_kantor(p_token text, p_branch text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.delete_lokasi_kantor(p_token text, p_branch text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_emp public.karyawan; v_count integer;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  IF upper(coalesce(v_emp.role,'')) <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Superadmin can deactivate office locations.' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  UPDATE public.lokasi_kantor SET status='NONAKTIF', updated_at=now()
  WHERE upper(btrim(branch)) = upper(btrim(p_branch)) AND status <> 'NONAKTIF';
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_count = ROW_COUNT;
  IF v_count = 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Active office location not found for branch %.', p_branch USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
  RETURN json_build_object('success',true,'message','Office location deactivated.','branch',p_branch,'affected',v_count);
END;
$function$


;

-- public.get_delegate_options(p_token text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_delegate_options(p_token text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_rows json;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
    'employee_id', k.employee_id, 'nama', k.nama, 'branch', k.branch, 'organization', k.organization
  ) ORDER BY UPPER(COALESCE(k.nama, k.employee_id))), '[]'::json)
  INTO v_rows
  FROM public.karyawan k
  WHERE k.status_akun = 'AKTIF' AND k.employee_id <> v_emp.employee_id;
  RETURN v_rows;
END;
$function$

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.get_karyawan_options(p_token text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_karyawan_options(p_token text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v_emp karyawan;
  v_atasan json; v_org json; v_level json; v_pos json; v_branch json;
begin
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  if v_emp.role not in ('HR','ADMIN','SUPERADMIN') then raise exception 'Akses ditolak.'; end if;
  
  select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('nik',employee_id,'nama',nama) order by nama),'[]'::json)
  into v_atasan from public.karyawan where status_akun='AKTIF';
  
  select coalesce(json_agg(x.org) ,'[]'::json) into v_org
  from (select distinct organization as org from public.karyawan where organization is not null and organization<>'' order by 1) x;
  
  select coalesce(json_agg(x.lvl),'[]'::json) into v_level
  from (select distinct job_level as lvl from public.karyawan where job_level is not null and job_level<>'' order by 1) x;
  
  select coalesce(json_agg(x.pos),'[]'::json) into v_pos
  from (select distinct job_position as pos from public.karyawan where job_position is not null and job_position<>'' order by 1) x;
  
  select coalesce(json_agg(x.br),'[]'::json) into v_branch
  from (select distinct branch as br from public.lokasi_kantor where coalesce(status,'AKTIF')='AKTIF' order by 1) x;
  
  return json_build_object(
    'atasan', v_atasan, 'organisasi', v_org, 'level', v_level,
    'jabatan', v_pos, 'branch', v_branch
  );
end; $function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.get_karyawan_summary(p_token text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_karyawan_summary(p_token text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v_emp karyawan; v_out json;
begin
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  if v_emp.role NOT IN ('HR', 'ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN') then raise exception 'Akses ditolak.'; end if;
  select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
    'nik', k.employee_id, 'nama', k.nama, 'org', k.organization, 'posisi', k.job_position,
    'akun', k.status_akun,
    'face', case when k.face is not null then 'YES' else 'NO' end,
    'faceVer', coalesce(k.face_photo_ver,0),
    'faceSessionUntil', to_char(s.exp,'HH24:MI'),
    'branch', k.branch, 'level', k.job_level, 'grade', k.grade, 'class', k.class,
    'atasanId', k.approval_line_id, 'atasanNama', k.approval_line_name,
    'joinDate', to_char(k.join_date,'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'role', k.role, 'statusKerja', k.employment_status
  ) order by k.nama),'[]'::json) into v_out
  from public.karyawan k
  left join lateral (
    select max(fs.expires_at) as exp
    from public.face_sessions fs
    where fs.employee_id=k.employee_id and fs.status='AUTHORIZED' and fs.expires_at>now()
  ) s on true;
  return json_build_object('ok',true,'list',v_out,'count',json_array_length(v_out));
end; $function$


;

    'radius', l.radius_m, 'maxAccuracy', l.max_accuracy_m,
    'status', l.status
  ) order by l.branch),'[]'::json) into v_out

  return json_build_object('success',true,'list',v_out);
end; $function$

 SET search_path TO 'public'

  v_emp karyawan;

      FROM public.karyawan
      WHERE employee_id = v_emp.employee_id
    )
  );
END;
$function$

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.get_my_notifications(p_token text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_notifications(p_token text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_list json;
  v_unread bigint;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);

  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
    'id', n.id,
    'createdAt', n.created_at,
    'kind', n.kind,
    'requestId', n.request_id,
    'stage', n.stage,
    'status', n.status,
    'title', n.title,
    'detail', n.detail,
    'actorName', n.actor_name,
    'reason', n.reason,
    'isRead', n.is_read
  ) ORDER BY n.created_at DESC), '[]'::json)
  INTO v_list
  FROM (
    SELECT
      al.id,
      al.timestamp AS created_at,
      CASE
        WHEN al.action_type LIKE 'ATTENDANCE_%' THEN 'absen'
        WHEN al.action_type LIKE 'TIME_OFF_%' THEN 'cuti'
        WHEN al.action_type LIKE 'REIMBURSEMENT_%' THEN 'reimbursement'
        ELSE 'other'
      END AS kind,
      al.target_id AS request_id,
      CASE
        WHEN al.action_type LIKE 'ATTENDANCE_MANAGER%'
          OR al.action_type = 'TIME_OFF_MANAGER_DECISION'
          OR al.action_type LIKE 'REIMBURSEMENT_MANAGER_%' THEN 'manager'
        ELSE 'superadmin'
      END AS stage,
      al.status,
      CASE
        WHEN al.action_type LIKE 'ATTENDANCE_%' THEN CASE al.status
          WHEN 'PENDING_HR' THEN 'Absensi disetujui atasan · menunggu Superadmin'
          WHEN 'DITOLAK_ATASAN' THEN 'Absensi ditolak atasan'
          WHEN 'DISETUJUI' THEN 'Absensi disetujui Superadmin'
          WHEN 'DITOLAK_HR' THEN 'Absensi ditolak Superadmin'
          ELSE 'Status persetujuan absensi diperbarui' END
        WHEN al.action_type = 'TIME_OFF_MANAGER_DECISION' THEN CASE
          WHEN split_part(coalesce(al.status, ''), '/', 1) IN ('DITOLAK','REJECTED')
            THEN 'Time Off ditolak atasan'
          ELSE 'Time Off disetujui atasan · menunggu Superadmin' END
        WHEN al.action_type IN ('TIME_OFF_HR_DECISION','TIME_OFF_MANAGER_AND_HR_DECISION') THEN CASE
          WHEN split_part(coalesce(al.status, ''), '/', 2) IN ('DITOLAK','REJECTED')
            OR al.status ~ '(DITOLAK|REJECTED)'
            THEN 'Time Off ditolak Superadmin'
          ELSE 'Time Off disetujui Superadmin' END
        WHEN al.action_type = 'REIMBURSEMENT_MANAGER_APPROVE'
          THEN 'Reimbursement disetujui atasan · menunggu Superadmin'
        WHEN al.action_type = 'REIMBURSEMENT_MANAGER_REJECT'
          THEN 'Reimbursement ditolak atasan'
        WHEN al.action_type = 'REIMBURSEMENT_SUPERADMIN_APPROVE'
          THEN 'Reimbursement disetujui Superadmin'
        WHEN al.action_type = 'REIMBURSEMENT_SUPERADMIN_REJECT'
          THEN 'Reimbursement ditolak Superadmin'
        ELSE 'Status pengajuan diperbarui'
      END AS title,
      CASE
        WHEN al.action_type LIKE 'ATTENDANCE_%' THEN concat_ws(' · ',
          CASE WHEN a.tipe = 'MASUK' THEN 'Clock in'
               WHEN a.tipe = 'PULANG' THEN 'Clock out' ELSE a.tipe END,
          to_char(a.tanggal, 'DD Mon YYYY'), to_char(a.jam, 'HH24:MI'))
        WHEN al.action_type LIKE 'TIME_OFF_%' THEN concat_ws(' · ',
          c.keterangan_cuti, to_char(c.tanggal_mulai, 'DD Mon YYYY'),
          to_char(c.tanggal_selesai, 'DD Mon YYYY'),
          CASE WHEN c.total_hari IS NOT NULL THEN c.total_hari::text || ' hari' END)
        WHEN al.action_type LIKE 'REIMBURSEMENT_%' THEN concat_ws(' · ',
          CASE r.category WHEN 'ENTERTAIN' THEN 'Entertainment'
                          WHEN 'TRANSPORT' THEN 'Transport'
                          ELSE 'Reimbursement' END,
          to_char(r.request_date, 'DD Mon YYYY'),
          CASE WHEN r.amount IS NOT NULL THEN 'Rp ' || to_char(r.amount, 'FM999G999G999G990D00') END)
        ELSE NULL
      END AS detail,
      coalesce(actor.nama, '') AS actor_name,
      CASE
        WHEN al.action_type LIKE 'ATTENDANCE_%'
          AND al.status IN ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR') THEN al.alasan
        WHEN al.action_type = 'TIME_OFF_MANAGER_DECISION'
          AND split_part(coalesce(al.status, ''), '/', 1) IN ('DITOLAK','REJECTED') THEN al.alasan
        WHEN al.action_type = 'TIME_OFF_HR_DECISION'
          AND split_part(coalesce(al.status, ''), '/', 2) IN ('DITOLAK','REJECTED') THEN al.alasan
        WHEN al.action_type = 'TIME_OFF_MANAGER_AND_HR_DECISION'
          AND al.status ~ '(DITOLAK|REJECTED)' THEN al.alasan
        WHEN al.action_type IN ('REIMBURSEMENT_MANAGER_REJECT','REIMBURSEMENT_SUPERADMIN_REJECT')
          THEN al.alasan
        ELSE NULL
      END AS reason,
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.hris_notification_reads nr
        WHERE nr.employee_id = v_emp.employee_id
          AND nr.notification_id = al.id
      ) AS is_read
    FROM public.approval_log al
    LEFT JOIN public.absensi a
      ON al.action_type LIKE 'ATTENDANCE_%' AND a.id = al.target_id
    LEFT JOIN public.pengajuan_cuti c
      ON al.action_type LIKE 'TIME_OFF_%' AND c.id = al.target_id
    LEFT JOIN public.hr_reimbursement_requests r
      ON al.action_type LIKE 'REIMBURSEMENT_%' AND r.id = al.target_id
    LEFT JOIN public.karyawan actor ON actor.employee_id = al.actor_id
    WHERE al.target_nik = v_emp.employee_id
      AND al.action_type IN (
        'ATTENDANCE_MANAGER_DECISION', 'ATTENDANCE_HR_DECISION',
        'TIME_OFF_MANAGER_DECISION', 'TIME_OFF_HR_DECISION', 'TIME_OFF_MANAGER_AND_HR_DECISION',
        'REIMBURSEMENT_MANAGER_APPROVE', 'REIMBURSEMENT_MANAGER_REJECT',
        'REIMBURSEMENT_SUPERADMIN_APPROVE', 'REIMBURSEMENT_SUPERADMIN_REJECT'
      )
    ORDER BY al.timestamp DESC
    LIMIT 100
  ) n;

  SELECT count(*) INTO v_unread
  FROM public.approval_log al
  WHERE al.target_nik = v_emp.employee_id
    AND al.action_type IN (
      'ATTENDANCE_MANAGER_DECISION', 'ATTENDANCE_HR_DECISION',
      'TIME_OFF_MANAGER_DECISION', 'TIME_OFF_HR_DECISION', 'TIME_OFF_MANAGER_AND_HR_DECISION',
      'REIMBURSEMENT_MANAGER_APPROVE', 'REIMBURSEMENT_MANAGER_REJECT',
      'REIMBURSEMENT_SUPERADMIN_APPROVE', 'REIMBURSEMENT_SUPERADMIN_REJECT'
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.hris_notification_reads nr
      WHERE nr.employee_id = v_emp.employee_id
        AND nr.notification_id = al.id
    );

  RETURN json_build_object('list', coalesce(v_list, '[]'::json),
                           'unreadCount', coalesce(v_unread, 0));
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.get_my_pending_requests(p_token text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_pending_requests(p_token text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_emp karyawan;
  v_abs json;
  v_cuti json;
begin
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);

  select coalesce(
    json_agg(public.absensi_to_json(a) order by a.timestamp desc),
    '[]'::json
  )
  into v_abs
  from public.absensi a
  where a.employee_id = v_emp.employee_id
    and a.status_approval in ('PENDING_ATASAN','PENDING_HR');

  select coalesce(
    json_agg(public.cuti_to_json(c) order by c.timestamp desc),
    '[]'::json
  )
  into v_cuti
  from public.pengajuan_cuti c
  where c.employee_id = v_emp.employee_id
    and (
      c.status_atasan = 'PENDING'
      or (
        c.status_atasan = 'DISETUJUI'
        and c.status_hr = 'PENDING'
      )
    );

  return json_build_object(
    'absensi', v_abs,
    'cuti', v_cuti
  );
end;
$function$


;

-- public.get_my_profile(p_token text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_profile(p_token text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v_emp karyawan; v_atasan karyawan; v_has_sub boolean;
begin
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  select * into v_atasan from public.karyawan where employee_id=v_emp.approval_line_id;
  select exists(select 1 from public.karyawan where approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id and status_akun='AKTIF') into v_has_sub;
  return json_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'profile', json_build_object(
      'nik', v_emp.employee_id, 'nama', v_emp.nama, 'branch', v_emp.branch,
      'organization', v_emp.organization, 'level', v_emp.job_level, 'position', v_emp.job_position,
      'grade', v_emp.grade, 'class', v_emp.class, 'statusKerja', v_emp.employment_status,
      'atasanNama', v_emp.approval_line_name, 'atasanId', v_emp.approval_line_id,
      'joinDate', to_char(v_emp.join_date,'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'statusAkun', v_emp.status_akun,
      'role', v_emp.role, 'facePhotoVer', coalesce(v_emp.face_photo_ver,0)
    ),
    'hasSubordinates', v_has_sub
  );
end; $function$


;

-- public.get_my_timeoff_request_detail(p_token text, p_id text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_timeoff_request_detail(p_token text, p_id text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_request public.pengajuan_cuti;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  SELECT c.* INTO v_request FROM public.pengajuan_cuti c
  WHERE c.id = p_id AND c.employee_id = v_emp.employee_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Time Off request not found.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;
  RETURN public.cuti_to_json(v_request);
END;
$function$

-- public.get_org_chart(p_token text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_org_chart(p_token text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_emp public.karyawan; v_full boolean; v_approver boolean; v_out json;
BEGIN
  v_emp:=public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  v_full:=UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,'')) IN ('HR','ADMIN','SUPERADMIN');
  v_approver:=public.rh_is_active_approver(v_emp.employee_id);
  IF NOT v_full AND NOT v_approver THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Akses ditolak.' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
    'nik',q.employee_id,'nama',q.nama,'posisi',q.job_position,'org',q.organization,
    'atasanId',q.approval_line_id,'faceVer',COALESCE(q.face_photo_ver,0),'directCount',q.direct_count
  ) ORDER BY q.is_self DESC,q.nama),'[]'::json)
  INTO v_out
  FROM (
    SELECT k.employee_id,k.nama,k.job_position,k.organization,k.approval_line_id,k.face_photo_ver,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.karyawan c WHERE c.approval_line_id=k.employee_id AND c.status_akun='AKTIF') AS direct_count,
      (k.employee_id=v_emp.employee_id) AS is_self
    FROM public.karyawan k
    WHERE k.status_akun='AKTIF' AND (v_full OR k.employee_id=v_emp.employee_id OR k.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id)
  ) q;
  RETURN json_build_object('success',true,'list',v_out);
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.get_pending_approvals(p_token text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_pending_approvals(p_token text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_abs json;
  v_cuti json;
  v_role text;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  v_role := UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,''));

  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(public.absensi_to_json(a) ORDER BY a.timestamp DESC), '[]'::json)
  INTO v_abs
  FROM public.absensi a
  WHERE a.status_approval IN ('PENDING_ATASAN','PENDING_HR')
    AND (
      (a.status_approval = 'PENDING_ATASAN' AND a.atasan_id = v_emp.employee_id AND v_role IN ('KARYAWAN','SUPERADMIN'))
      OR (a.status_approval = 'PENDING_HR' AND v_role = 'SUPERADMIN')
      OR (v_role = 'ADMIN' AND a.status_approval IN ('PENDING_ATASAN','PENDING_HR'))
    );

  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(public.cuti_to_json(c) ORDER BY c.timestamp DESC), '[]'::json)
  INTO v_cuti
  FROM public.pengajuan_cuti c
  JOIN public.karyawan k ON k.employee_id = c.employee_id
  WHERE (
      (c.status_atasan = 'PENDING' AND k.approval_line_id = v_emp.employee_id AND v_role IN ('KARYAWAN','SUPERADMIN'))
      OR (c.status_atasan = 'DISETUJUI' AND c.status_hr = 'PENDING' AND v_role = 'SUPERADMIN')
      OR (v_role = 'ADMIN' AND (
        c.status_atasan = 'PENDING'
        OR (c.status_atasan = 'DISETUJUI' AND c.status_hr = 'PENDING')
      ))
    );

  RETURN json_build_object(
    'absensi', COALESCE(v_abs,'[]'::json),
    'cuti', COALESCE(v_cuti,'[]'::json),
    'total', json_array_length(COALESCE(v_abs,'[]'::json)) + json_array_length(COALESCE(v_cuti,'[]'::json))
  );
END;
$function$


;

-- public.get_riwayat_kehadiran(p_token text, p_year integer, p_month integer)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_riwayat_kehadiran(p_token text, p_year integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_month integer DEFAULT NULL::integer)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_emp karyawan;
  v_year int;
  v_month int;
  v_start date;
  v_end date;
  v_out json;
begin
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);

  v_year := coalesce(
    nullif(p_year, 0),
    extract(year from (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::date)::int
  );

  v_month := coalesce(
    nullif(p_month, 0),
    extract(month from (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::date)::int
  );

  if v_month < 1 or v_month > 12 then
    raise exception 'Bulan tidak valid.';
  end if;

  v_start := make_date(v_year, v_month, 1);
  v_end := (v_start + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')::date;

  select coalesce(
    json_agg(
      json_build_object(
        'tanggal', to_char(d.tanggal, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
        'status', case
          when m.obj is not null and p.obj is not null then 'HADIR'
          when m.obj is not null then 'BELUM CLOCK OUT'
          else 'BELUM LENGKAP'
        end,
        'masuk', m.obj,
        'pulang', p.obj
      )
      order by d.tanggal desc
    ),
    '[]'::json
  )
  into v_out
  from (
    select distinct a.tanggal
    from public.absensi a
    where a.employee_id = v_emp.employee_id
      and a.tanggal between v_start and v_end
      and a.status_approval not in ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR')
  ) d
  left join lateral (
    select public.absensi_to_json(a) as obj
    from public.absensi a
    where a.employee_id = v_emp.employee_id
      and a.tanggal = d.tanggal
      and a.tipe = 'MASUK'
      and a.status_approval not in ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR')
    order by a.timestamp desc
    limit 1
  ) m on true
  left join lateral (
    select public.absensi_to_json(a) as obj
    from public.absensi a
    where a.employee_id = v_emp.employee_id
      and a.tanggal = d.tanggal
      and a.tipe = 'PULANG'
      and a.status_approval not in ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR')
    order by a.timestamp desc
    limit 1
  ) p on true;

  return v_out;
end;
$function$


;

-- public.get_sisa_cuti(p_token text, p_kode text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_sisa_cuti(p_token text, p_kode text DEFAULT 'CT'::text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_code text := COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_kode, ''))), ''), 'CT');
  v_year integer := EXTRACT(YEAR FROM (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta')::date)::integer;
  v_sisa integer;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  SELECT s.sisa INTO v_sisa
  FROM public.sisa_cuti s
  WHERE s.employee_id = v_emp.employee_id AND s.tahun = v_year AND s.kode_cuti = v_code;
  IF FOUND THEN RETURN v_sisa; END IF;
  RETURN COALESCE(public.hris_calculate_remaining_leave(v_emp.employee_id, v_year, v_code), 0);
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.get_status_hari_ini(p_token text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_status_hari_ini(p_token text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_emp karyawan;
  v_status json;
  v_today date := (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::date;
begin
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);

  select json_build_object(
    'masuk', coalesce(bool_or(tipe = 'MASUK'), false),
    'pulang', coalesce(bool_or(tipe = 'PULANG'), false),
    'jamMasuk', coalesce(max(case when tipe = 'MASUK' then to_char(jam, 'HH24:MI:SS') end), ''),
    'jamPulang', coalesce(max(case when tipe = 'PULANG' then to_char(jam, 'HH24:MI:SS') end), ''),
    'statusApproval', coalesce(max(status_approval), 'VALID')
  )
  into v_status
  from public.absensi
  where employee_id = v_emp.employee_id
    and tanggal = v_today
    and status_approval not in ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR');

  return v_status;
end;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.get_team_activity(p_token text, p_date date)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_team_activity(p_token text, p_date date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v_emp karyawan; v_date date; v_out json;
begin
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  v_date := coalesce(p_date, (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::date);

  select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
    'nik', s.employee_id, 'nama', s.nama, 'posisi', s.job_position, 'org', s.organization,
    'faceVer', s.fver, 'clockIn', a.jin, 'clockOut', a.jout, 'status', a.st
  ) order by s.nama),'[]'::json) into v_out
  from (
    select k.employee_id, k.nama, k.job_position, k.organization, coalesce(k.face_photo_ver,0) as fver
    from public.karyawan k
    where k.approval_line_id = v_emp.employee_id
      and k.status_akun = 'AKTIF'
  ) s
  left join lateral (
    select max(case when tipe='MASUK' then to_char(jam,'HH24:MI:SS') end) as jin,
           max(case when tipe='PULANG' then to_char(jam,'HH24:MI:SS') end) as jout,
           case when bool_or(tipe='MASUK') and bool_or(tipe='PULANG') then 'HADIR'
                when bool_or(tipe='MASUK') then 'BELUM CLOCK OUT'
                else 'BELUM CLOCK IN' end as st
    from public.absensi a
    where a.employee_id = s.employee_id
      and a.tanggal = v_date
      and a.status_approval not in ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR')
  ) a on true;

  return json_build_object('success',true,'tanggal',to_char(v_date,'YYYY-MM-DD'),'list',v_out);
end; $function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.grant_face_registration(p_token text, p_employee_id text, p_duration_minutes integer)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.grant_face_registration(p_token text, p_employee_id text, p_duration_minutes integer)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v_emp karyawan; v_target karyawan;
begin
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,'')) <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Superadmin can perform this action.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  select * into v_target from karyawan where employee_id = p_employee_id;
  if not found then raise exception 'Karyawan tidak ditemukan.'; end if;
  if v_target.face is not null then raise exception 'Karyawan sudah punya Face ID. Reset dulu.'; end if;
  
  insert into face_sessions(employee_id, granted_by, expires_at)
  values (p_employee_id, v_emp.employee_id, now() + (p_duration_minutes || ' minutes')::interval);
  
  return json_build_object('success', true, 'message', 'Akses registrasi diberikan selama ' || p_duration_minutes || ' menit.');
end; $function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.grant_mass_face_registration(p_token text, p_duration_minutes integer)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.grant_mass_face_registration(p_token text, p_duration_minutes integer)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v_emp karyawan; v_count int;
begin
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,'')) <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Superadmin can perform this action.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  
  insert into face_sessions(employee_id, granted_by, expires_at)
  select employee_id, v_emp.employee_id, now() + (p_duration_minutes || ' minutes')::interval
  from karyawan where face is null and status_akun = 'AKTIF';
  
  get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
  return json_build_object('success', true, 'message', v_count || ' akses registrasi massal diberikan.');
end; $function$


;

-- public.halfvec_negative_inner_product(halfvec, halfvec)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.halfvec_negative_inner_product(halfvec, halfvec)
 RETURNS double precision

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.haversine_m(lat1 double precision, lon1 double precision, lat2 double precision, lon2 double precision)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.haversine_m(lat1 double precision, lon1 double precision, lat2 double precision, lon2 double precision)
 RETURNS double precision
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  select 6371000 * 2 * asin(
    sqrt(
      power(sin(radians(lat2 - lat1) / 2), 2)
      +
      cos(radians(lat1)) * cos(radians(lat2)) *
      power(sin(radians(lon2 - lon1) / 2), 2)
    )
  );
$function$


;

-- public.hr_add_karyawan(p_token text, p_nik text, p_nama text, p_branch text, p_org text, p_level text, p_pos text, p_grade text, p_class text, p_status_kerja text, p_atasan_id text, p_join_date date, p_role text, p_pin text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_add_karyawan(p_token text, p_nik text, p_nama text, p_branch text, p_org text, p_level text, p_pos text, p_grade text, p_class text, p_status_kerja text, p_atasan_id text, p_join_date date, p_role text, p_pin text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v_emp karyawan; v_pin_final text; v_atasan_nama text; v_role text;
begin
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,'')) <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Superadmin can add employees.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  v_role := UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_role),''),'KARYAWAN'));
  IF v_role NOT IN ('KARYAWAN','ADMIN','SUPERADMIN') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid role.' USING ERRCODE = '22023'; END IF;
  if p_nik is null or trim(p_nik)='' then raise exception 'NIK wajib diisi.'; end if;
  if p_nama is null or trim(p_nama)='' then raise exception 'Nama wajib diisi.'; end if;
  if exists(select 1 from public.karyawan where employee_id=p_nik) then
    raise exception 'NIK % sudah terdaftar.', p_nik;
  end if;
  v_pin_final := coalesce(nullif(trim(p_pin),''), lpad((floor(random()*1000000))::text,6,'0'));
  select nama into v_atasan_nama from public.karyawan where employee_id=p_atasan_id;
  insert into public.karyawan(
    employee_id, nama, branch, organization, job_level, job_position, grade, class,
    employment_status, approval_line_id, approval_line_name, join_date, role, pin_hash, status_akun
  ) values (
    p_nik, p_nama, p_branch, p_org, p_level, p_pos, p_grade, p_class,
    p_status_kerja, p_atasan_id, v_atasan_nama, p_join_date,
    v_role,
    "extensions"."crypt"(v_pin_final, "extensions"."gen_salt"('bf')),
    'AKTIF'
  );
  return json_build_object('success',true,'message','Karyawan berhasil ditambahkan.','pin',v_pin_final,'nik',p_nik);
end; $function$


;

-- public.hr_attendance_recap(p_token text, p_year integer, p_month integer)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_attendance_recap(p_token text, p_year integer, p_month integer)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_start date;
  v_end date;
  v_workdays int;
  v_out json;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);

  IF v_emp.role NOT IN ('HR', 'ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Akses ditolak.';
  END IF;

  IF p_year NOT BETWEEN 2000 AND 2100
     OR p_month NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 12 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tahun atau bulan tidak valid.';
  END IF;

  v_start := make_date(p_year, p_month, 1);
  v_end := (v_start + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date;

  SELECT count(*)
  INTO v_workdays
  FROM generate_series(
    v_start, v_end, interval '1 day'
  ) AS g(d)
  WHERE extract(isodow FROM g.d) < 6;

  WITH daily AS (
    SELECT
      a.employee_id,
      a.tanggal,
      bool_or(a.tipe = 'MASUK') AS masuk,
      bool_or(a.tipe = 'PULANG') AS pulang
    FROM public.absensi a
    WHERE a.tanggal BETWEEN v_start AND v_end
      AND a.status_approval IN (
        'VALID', 'DISETUJUI',
        'PENDING_ATASAN', 'PENDING_HR'
      )
    GROUP BY a.employee_id, a.tanggal
  ),
  attendance AS (
    SELECT
      employee_id,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE masuk)::int AS hadir,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE masuk AND pulang)::int AS lengkap
    FROM daily
    GROUP BY employee_id
  ),
  employees AS (
    SELECT
      k.employee_id AS nik,
      k.nama,
      coalesce(k.organization, '-') AS bagian,
      coalesce(a.hadir, 0) AS hadir,
      coalesce(a.lengkap, 0) AS lengkap,
      coalesce(c.cuti, 0) AS cuti
    FROM public.karyawan k
    LEFT JOIN attendance a
      ON a.employee_id = k.employee_id
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT coalesce(sum(pc.total_hari), 0)::int AS cuti
      FROM public.pengajuan_cuti pc
      WHERE pc.employee_id = k.employee_id
        AND pc.status_atasan = 'DISETUJUI'
        AND pc.status_hr = 'DISETUJUI'
        AND pc.tanggal_mulai <= v_end
        AND pc.tanggal_selesai >= v_start
    ) c ON true
    WHERE k.status_akun = 'AKTIF'
  )
  SELECT coalesce(
    json_agg(
      json_build_object(
        'nik', nik,
        'nama', nama,
        'bagian', bagian,
        'hariKerja', v_workdays,
        'hadir', hadir,
        'lengkap', lengkap,
        'cuti', cuti,
        'alpha', greatest(v_workdays - hadir - cuti, 0),
        'persen',
          CASE
            WHEN v_workdays > 0
            THEN round(hadir::numeric * 100 / v_workdays)
            ELSE 0
          END
      )
      ORDER BY nama
    ),
    '[]'::json
  )
  INTO v_out
  FROM employees;

  RETURN json_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'tahun', p_year,
    'bulan', p_month,
    'hariKerja', v_workdays,
    'list', v_out
  );
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.hr_attendance_today(p_token text, p_date date)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_attendance_today(p_token text, p_date date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_emp public.karyawan; v_d date; v_list json; v_total int; v_hadir int; v_is_admin boolean;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  v_is_admin := UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,'')) IN ('HR','ADMIN','SUPERADMIN');
  IF NOT v_is_admin AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.karyawan b WHERE b.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id AND b.status_akun='AKTIF') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Akses ditolak.' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  v_d := COALESCE(p_date,(timezone('Asia/Jakarta',now()))::date);
  SELECT count(*) INTO v_total FROM public.karyawan k WHERE k.status_akun='AKTIF' AND (v_is_admin OR k.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id);
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.nama),'[]'::json) INTO v_list
  FROM (
    SELECT k.employee_id AS nik,k.nama,
      min(CASE WHEN a.tipe='MASUK' THEN to_char(a.jam,'HH24:MI') END) AS "jamMasuk",
      max(CASE WHEN a.tipe='PULANG' THEN to_char(a.jam,'HH24:MI') END) AS "jamPulang",
      CASE WHEN bool_or(a.tipe='MASUK') AND bool_or(a.tipe='PULANG') THEN 'HADIR'
           WHEN bool_or(a.tipe='MASUK') THEN 'BELUM_PULANG' ELSE 'BELUM_HADIR' END AS status
    FROM public.karyawan k
    LEFT JOIN public.absensi a ON a.employee_id=k.employee_id AND a.tanggal=v_d
      AND a.status_approval IN ('VALID','DISETUJUI','PENDING_ATASAN','PENDING_HR')
    WHERE k.status_akun='AKTIF' AND (v_is_admin OR k.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id)
    GROUP BY k.employee_id,k.nama
  ) x;
  SELECT count(*) INTO v_hadir FROM json_array_elements(v_list) e WHERE e->>'status' IN ('HADIR','BELUM_PULANG');
  RETURN json_build_object('ok',true,'tanggal',to_char(v_d,'YYYY-MM-DD'),'total',v_total,'hadir',v_hadir,'list',v_list);
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.hr_attendance_week(p_token text, p_end date)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_attendance_week(p_token text, p_end date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_end date;
  v_days json;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);

  IF v_emp.role NOT IN ('HR', 'ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Akses ditolak.';
  END IF;

  v_end := COALESCE(
    p_end,
    (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::date
  );

  SELECT COALESCE(
    json_agg(
      json_build_object(
        'label', to_char(d, 'Dy DD/MM'),
        'tanggal', to_char(d, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
        'hadir', COALESCE(x.n, 0)
      )
      ORDER BY d
    ),
    '[]'::json
  )
  INTO v_days
  FROM generate_series(
    v_end - 6,
    v_end,
    interval '1 day'
  ) d
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT count(DISTINCT a.employee_id) AS n
    FROM public.absensi a
    WHERE a.tanggal = d
      AND a.tipe = 'MASUK'
      AND a.status_approval IN (
        'VALID', 'DISETUJUI',
        'PENDING_ATASAN', 'PENDING_HR'
      )
  ) x ON true;

  RETURN json_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'days', v_days
  );
END;
$function$


;

-- public.hr_contract_expiring(p_token text, p_days integer)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_contract_expiring(p_token text, p_days integer DEFAULT 60)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_out json;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);

  IF v_emp.role NOT IN ('HR', 'ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Akses ditolak.';
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(
    json_agg(
      json_build_object(
        'nik', k.employee_id,
        'nama', k.nama,
        'bagian', k.organization,
        'contractEnd', to_char(k.contract_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
      )
      ORDER BY k.contract_end_date
    ),
    '[]'::json
  )
  INTO v_out
  FROM public.karyawan k
  WHERE k.status_akun = 'AKTIF'
    AND k.contract_end_date IS NOT NULL
    AND k.contract_end_date BETWEEN
      (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::date
      AND (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::date
          + COALESCE(p_days, 60);

  RETURN json_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'list', v_out
  );
END;
$function$


;
