------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.hr_get_reimbursement_recap(p_token text, p_start_date date, p_end_date date, p_employee_id text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_get_reimbursement_recap(p_token text, p_start_date date, p_end_date date, p_employee_id text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_emp public.karyawan; v_rows jsonb; v_entertain_limit numeric(14,2); v_transport_limit numeric(14,2);
BEGIN
  v_emp:=public.hris_assert_incentive_reader(p_token);
  IF p_start_date IS NULL OR p_end_date IS NULL OR p_start_date>p_end_date OR (p_end_date-p_start_date)>62 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Rentang reimbursement tidak valid.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  SELECT entertain_limit,transport_limit INTO v_entertain_limit,v_transport_limit FROM public.incentive_reimbursement_limits WHERE id=1;
  WITH approved AS (
    SELECT r.*,k.nama,
      sum(r.amount) OVER(PARTITION BY r.employee_id,r.category,r.period_start ORDER BY r.created_at,r.id
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total
    FROM public.hr_reimbursement_requests r
    JOIN public.karyawan k ON k.employee_id=r.employee_id
    WHERE r.status='DISETUJUI' AND r.request_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
      AND upper(coalesce(k.job_code,''))='HYBRID'
      AND (p_employee_id IS NULL OR r.employee_id=p_employee_id)
  ), rows_json AS (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'id',a.id,'employee_id',a.employee_id,'employee_name',a.nama,'category',a.category,
      'request_date',a.request_date,'amount',a.amount,'note',a.note,'attachment_path',a.attachment_path,
      'period_start',a.period_start,'period_end',a.period_end,
      'within_budget_amount',GREATEST(0,a.amount-(GREATEST(0,a.running_total-CASE WHEN a.category='ENTERTAIN' THEN v_entertain_limit ELSE v_transport_limit END) - GREATEST(0,a.running_total-a.amount-CASE WHEN a.category='ENTERTAIN' THEN v_entertain_limit ELSE v_transport_limit END))),'over_budget_amount',GREATEST(0,a.running_total-CASE WHEN a.category='ENTERTAIN' THEN v_entertain_limit ELSE v_transport_limit END) - GREATEST(0,a.running_total-a.amount-CASE WHEN a.category='ENTERTAIN' THEN v_entertain_limit ELSE v_transport_limit END),
      'status',a.status,'created_at',a.created_at
    ) AS item,a.created_at
    FROM approved a
  )
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(item ORDER BY created_at),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_rows FROM rows_json;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'requests',v_rows,'period',jsonb_build_object('start_date',p_start_date,'end_date',p_end_date));
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.hr_get_working_calendar(p_token text, p_start_date date, p_end_date date, p_branch text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_get_working_calendar(p_token text, p_start_date date, p_end_date date, p_branch text DEFAULT '*'::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_emp public.karyawan; v_rows jsonb;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role, '')) NOT IN ('HR','ADMIN','SUPERADMIN') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied.' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF p_start_date IS NULL OR p_end_date IS NULL OR p_start_date > p_end_date OR p_end_date - p_start_date > 400 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid calendar range (maximum 401 days).'; END IF;
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY x.calendar_date), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_rows
  FROM (
    SELECT d::date AS calendar_date,
      public.attendance_resolved_day_type(d::date, COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_branch),''),'*')) AS effective_day_type,
      EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM d)::integer AS day_of_week,
      CASE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM d)::integer WHEN 1 THEN 'Monday' WHEN 2 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN 3 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN 4 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN 5 THEN 'Friday' WHEN 6 THEN 'Saturday' ELSE 'Sunday' END AS day_name,
      COALESCE(o.label, s.name, CASE WHEN EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM d)::integer = 7 THEN 'Sunday' ELSE NULL END) AS label,
      COALESCE(o.reason, s.description) AS reason,
      COALESCE(o.scope_branch, '*') AS scope_branch,
      (o.id IS NOT NULL) AS has_override,
      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.attendance_calendar_source_days h WHERE h.calendar_date=d::date AND h.day_type='NATIONAL_HOLIDAY') AS is_national_holiday,
      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.attendance_calendar_source_days h WHERE h.calendar_date=d::date AND h.day_type='JOINT_LEAVE') AS is_joint_leave
    FROM generate_series(p_start_date, p_end_date, interval '1 day') d
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT x.* FROM public.attendance_calendar_overrides x
      WHERE x.calendar_date=d::date
        AND (
          (COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_branch),''),'*')='*' AND x.scope_branch='*')
          OR
          (COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_branch),''),'*')<>'*' AND
            (x.scope_branch='*' OR LOWER(BTRIM(x.scope_branch))=LOWER(BTRIM(p_branch))))
        )
      ORDER BY CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_branch),''),'*')<>'*'
         AND LOWER(BTRIM(x.scope_branch))=LOWER(BTRIM(p_branch)) THEN 0
        ELSE 1
      END
      LIMIT 1
    ) o ON TRUE
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT h.* FROM public.attendance_calendar_source_days h
      WHERE h.calendar_date=d::date
      ORDER BY CASE h.day_type WHEN 'NATIONAL_HOLIDAY' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
      LIMIT 1
    ) s ON TRUE
  ) x;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'records',v_rows,'from_date',p_start_date,'to_date',p_end_date,'branch',COALESCE(p_branch,'*'));
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.hr_import_public_holidays(p_token text, p_year integer, p_rows jsonb)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_import_public_holidays(p_token text, p_year integer, p_rows jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_emp public.karyawan; v_row jsonb; v_inserted integer := 0; v_date date; v_type text; v_name text;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role, '')) <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Superadmin can import the public calendar.' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF p_year NOT BETWEEN 2000 AND 2100 OR jsonb_typeof(p_rows) <> 'array' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid year or calendar data.'; END IF;
  FOR v_row IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) LOOP
    BEGIN v_date := NULLIF(v_row->>'date','')::date; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN v_date := NULL; END;
    v_name := NULLIF(BTRIM(v_row->>'name'),'');
    v_type := CASE LOWER(COALESCE(v_row->>'type','')) WHEN 'national_holiday' THEN 'NATIONAL_HOLIDAY' WHEN 'joint_leave' THEN 'JOINT_LEAVE' ELSE NULL END;
    IF v_date IS NULL OR EXTRACT(YEAR FROM v_date)::integer <> p_year OR v_name IS NULL OR v_type IS NULL THEN CONTINUE; END IF;
    INSERT INTO public.attendance_calendar_source_days(calendar_date,day_type,name,description,source_url,imported_at,imported_by)
    VALUES(v_date,v_type,v_name,NULLIF(BTRIM(v_row->>'description'),''),'https://indonesian-holidays.ahrulsyamil.com/holidays/'||p_year,now(),v_emp.employee_id::text)
    ON CONFLICT(calendar_date,day_type,name) DO UPDATE SET description=EXCLUDED.description,source_url=EXCLUDED.source_url,imported_at=now(),imported_by=EXCLUDED.imported_by;
    v_inserted := v_inserted + 1;
  END LOOP;

  -- Existing attendance events predate the snapshot trigger. Freeze the resolved day type
  -- for this imported year once, so later calendar edits do not silently rewrite old reports.
  UPDATE public.absensi a
  SET calendar_day_type_snapshot = public.attendance_resolved_day_type(
        a.tanggal,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(a.employee_branch_snapshot), ''),
                 (SELECT k.branch FROM public.karyawan k WHERE k.employee_id = a.employee_id),
                 'Pusat')
      ),
      attendance_snapshot_at = COALESCE(a.attendance_snapshot_at, a.created_at)
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.tanggal)::integer = p_year
    AND a.calendar_day_type_snapshot IS NULL;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'year',p_year,'processed',v_inserted,'message','Public calendar imported. Historical day types were frozen for events missing a calendar snapshot. Manual overrides remain separate and take priority.');
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.hr_leave_yearly_stats(p_token text, p_year integer)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_leave_yearly_stats(p_token text, p_year integer DEFAULT NULL::integer)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_y int;
  v_months json;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);

  IF v_emp.role NOT IN ('HR', 'ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Akses ditolak.';
  END IF;

  v_y := COALESCE(
    p_year,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::int
  );

  SELECT json_agg(
    json_build_object(
      'label', to_char(make_date(v_y, m, 1), 'Mon'),
      'bulan', m,
      'total', COALESCE(x.n, 0)
    )
    ORDER BY m
  )
  INTO v_months
  FROM generate_series(1, 12) m
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT count(*) AS n
    FROM public.pengajuan_cuti c
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.tanggal_mulai) = v_y
      AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM c.tanggal_mulai) = m
  ) x ON true;

  RETURN json_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'tahun', v_y,
    'months', v_months
  );
END;
$function$


;

-- public.hr_list_attendance_adjustments(p_token text, p_employee_id text, p_start_date date, p_end_date date)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_list_attendance_adjustments(p_token text, p_employee_id text, p_start_date date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_end_date date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_emp public.karyawan; v_rows jsonb;
BEGIN
  v_emp:=public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,''))<>'SUPERADMIN' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Superadmin can view attendance adjustments.' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_employee_id,'')),'') IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pilih karyawan terlebih dahulu.'; END IF;
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q) ORDER BY q.tanggal DESC,q.jam DESC),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_rows
  FROM (
    SELECT a.id,a.employee_id,a.tanggal,a.jam,a.tipe,a.status_approval,a.manual_adjustment,a.adjustment_reason,a.adjusted_by,a.adjusted_at
    FROM public.absensi a WHERE a.employee_id=TRIM(p_employee_id) AND a.manual_adjustment IS TRUE
      AND (p_start_date IS NULL OR a.tanggal>=p_start_date) AND (p_end_date IS NULL OR a.tanggal<=p_end_date)
    ORDER BY a.tanggal DESC,a.jam DESC LIMIT 250
  ) q;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'records',v_rows);
END;
$function$


;

-- public.hr_list_employee_docs(p_token text, p_nik text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_list_employee_docs(p_token text, p_nik text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_out json;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);

  IF v_emp.role NOT IN ('HR', 'ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Akses ditolak.';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.karyawan
    WHERE employee_id = p_nik
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Karyawan tidak ditemukan.';
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(
    json_agg(
      json_build_object(
        'id', d.id,
        'jenis', d.jenis,
        'filename', d.filename,
        'mime', d.mime,
        'uploadedBy', d.uploaded_by,
        'uploadedAt', to_char(
          d.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta',
          'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI'
        )
      ) ORDER BY d.created_at DESC
    ),
    '[]'::json
  )
  INTO v_out
  FROM public.employee_documents d
  WHERE d.employee_id = p_nik;

  RETURN json_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'list', v_out
  );
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.hr_monthly_report(p_token text, p_year integer, p_month integer)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_monthly_report(p_token text, p_year integer, p_month integer)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan; v_full boolean; v_approver boolean;
  v_start date; v_end date; v_aktif int; v_abs int; v_kontrak int; v_cuti int;
  v_rekap json; v_kontrak_list json; v_cuti_list json; v_inout json;
BEGIN
  v_emp:=public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  v_full:=UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,'')) IN ('HR','ADMIN','SUPERADMIN');
  v_approver:=public.rh_is_active_approver(v_emp.employee_id);
  IF NOT v_full AND NOT v_approver THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Akses ditolak.' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF p_year IS NULL OR p_month IS NULL OR p_month<1 OR p_month>12 OR p_year<1900 OR p_year>9999 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tahun atau bulan tidak valid.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  v_start:=make_date(p_year,p_month,1); v_end:=(v_start+interval '1 month - 1 day')::date;

  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_aktif FROM public.karyawan k WHERE k.status_akun='AKTIF'
    AND (v_full OR k.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id);
  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_abs FROM public.absensi a JOIN public.karyawan k ON k.employee_id=a.employee_id
    WHERE a.tanggal BETWEEN v_start AND v_end AND a.status_approval IN ('VALID','DISETUJUI','PENDING_ATASAN','PENDING_HR')
      AND (v_full OR k.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id);
  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_kontrak FROM public.karyawan k WHERE k.status_akun='AKTIF'
    AND k.contract_end_date BETWEEN v_start AND v_end AND (v_full OR k.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id);
  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_cuti FROM public.pengajuan_cuti c JOIN public.karyawan k ON k.employee_id=c.employee_id
    WHERE c.status_atasan='DISETUJUI' AND c.status_hr='DISETUJUI' AND c.tanggal_mulai<=v_end AND c.tanggal_selesai>=v_start
      AND (v_full OR k.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id);

  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('kategori',g.kategori,'jumlah',g.jumlah,'keterangan',g.keterangan) ORDER BY g.urutan),'[]'::json)
  INTO v_rekap FROM (
    SELECT 'Hadir (Clock In)' AS kategori,COUNT(DISTINCT (a.employee_id,a.tanggal)) AS jumlah,
      'Termasuk yang belum clock out' AS keterangan,1 AS urutan
    FROM public.absensi a JOIN public.karyawan k ON k.employee_id=a.employee_id
    WHERE a.tipe='MASUK' AND a.tanggal BETWEEN v_start AND v_end AND a.status_approval IN ('VALID','DISETUJUI','PENDING_ATASAN','PENDING_HR')
      AND (v_full OR k.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Menunggu Approval',COUNT(*),'Absensi menunggu persetujuan atasan atau HR',2
    FROM public.absensi a JOIN public.karyawan k ON k.employee_id=a.employee_id
    WHERE a.tanggal BETWEEN v_start AND v_end AND a.status_approval IN ('PENDING_ATASAN','PENDING_HR')
      AND (v_full OR k.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Ditolak',COUNT(*),'Absensi ditolak pada periode ini',3
    FROM public.absensi a JOIN public.karyawan k ON k.employee_id=a.employee_id
    WHERE a.tanggal BETWEEN v_start AND v_end AND a.status_approval IN ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR')
      AND (v_full OR k.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Cuti Disetujui',COUNT(*),'Pengajuan cuti disetujui yang beririsan dengan periode',4
    FROM public.pengajuan_cuti c JOIN public.karyawan k ON k.employee_id=c.employee_id
    WHERE c.status_atasan='DISETUJUI' AND c.status_hr='DISETUJUI' AND c.tanggal_mulai<=v_end AND c.tanggal_selesai>=v_start
      AND (v_full OR k.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id)
  ) g;

  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('nik',k.employee_id,'nama',k.nama,'bagian',k.organization,
    'tanggal',to_char(k.contract_end_date,'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY k.contract_end_date),'[]'::json)
  INTO v_kontrak_list FROM public.karyawan k WHERE k.status_akun='AKTIF' AND k.contract_end_date BETWEEN v_start AND v_end
    AND (v_full OR k.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id);

  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('nama',c.nama,'departemen',k.organization,'kode',c.kode_cuti,
    'keterangan',c.keterangan_cuti,'tanggalMulai',to_char(c.tanggal_mulai,'YYYY-MM-DD'),
    'tanggalSelesai',to_char(c.tanggal_selesai,'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY c.tanggal_mulai),'[]'::json)
  INTO v_cuti_list FROM public.pengajuan_cuti c JOIN public.karyawan k ON k.employee_id=c.employee_id
  WHERE c.status_atasan='DISETUJUI' AND c.status_hr='DISETUJUI' AND c.tanggal_mulai<=v_end AND c.tanggal_selesai>=v_start
    AND (v_full OR k.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id);

  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.tanggal),'[]'::json) INTO v_inout FROM (
    SELECT 'MASUK' AS status,k.employee_id AS nik,k.nama,k.organization AS bagian,to_char(k.join_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tanggal
    FROM public.karyawan k WHERE k.join_date BETWEEN v_start AND v_end AND (v_full OR k.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'KELUAR' AS status,k.employee_id AS nik,k.nama,k.organization AS bagian,
      to_char(k.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta','YYYY-MM-DD') AS tanggal
    FROM public.karyawan k WHERE k.status_akun='NONAKTIF'
      AND (k.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta')::date BETWEEN v_start AND v_end
      AND (v_full OR k.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id)
  ) x;
  PERFORM public.log_activity(p_token,'EXPORT','LAPORAN','hr_monthly_report',
    'Laporan '||p_year||'-'||lpad(p_month::text,2,'0'));
  RETURN json_build_object('ok',true,'ringkasan',json_build_object('karyawanAktif',v_aktif,'totalAbsensi',v_abs,
    'kontrakBerakhir',v_kontrak,'pengambilanCuti',v_cuti),'rekap',v_rekap,'kontrak',v_kontrak_list,'cuti',v_cuti_list,'inout',v_inout);
END;
$function$


;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_reactivate_karyawan(p_token text, p_nik text)

 LANGUAGE plpgsql

 SET search_path TO 'public'

  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);

-- public.hr_reimbursement_period_bounds(p_date date)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_reimbursement_period_bounds(p_date date)
 RETURNS TABLE(period_start date, period_end date)
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN extract(day FROM p_date)>=6
      THEN (date_trunc('month',p_date)::date + 5)
      ELSE ((date_trunc('month',p_date)::date - interval '1 month')::date + 5)
    END AS period_start,
    (CASE WHEN extract(day FROM p_date)>=6
      THEN (date_trunc('month',p_date)::date + 5)
      ELSE ((date_trunc('month',p_date)::date - interval '1 month')::date + 5)
    END + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')::date AS period_end;
$function$


;

AS $function$

begin

  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);

-- public.hr_save_attendance_adjustment(p_token text, p_action text, p_attendance_id text, p_employee_id text, p_date date, p_type text, p_time time without time zone, p_reason text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_save_attendance_adjustment(p_token text, p_action text, p_attendance_id text, p_employee_id text, p_date date, p_type text, p_time time without time zone, p_reason text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan; v_action text:=UPPER(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_action,''))); v_type text:=UPPER(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_type,'')));
  v_before jsonb; v_after public.absensi; v_id text; v_branch text; v_reason text:=NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_reason,'')),'');
BEGIN
  v_emp:=public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,''))<>'SUPERADMIN' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Superadmin can adjust attendance.' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF v_action NOT IN ('INSERT','UPDATE') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Aksi penyesuaian tidak valid.' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  IF v_type NOT IN ('MASUK','PULANG') OR p_date IS NULL OR p_time IS NULL OR NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_employee_id,'')),'') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Karyawan, tanggal, jenis, dan jam wajib diisi.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  IF v_reason IS NULL OR length(v_reason)<8 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Alasan penyesuaian wajib diisi minimal 8 karakter.' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.karyawan k WHERE k.employee_id=TRIM(p_employee_id)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Karyawan tidak ditemukan.' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(k.branch),''),'Pusat') INTO v_branch FROM public.karyawan k WHERE k.employee_id=TRIM(p_employee_id);

  IF v_action='INSERT' THEN
    IF p_date >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta')::date THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Penambahan manual hanya untuk tanggal yang sudah berlalu.' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.absensi a WHERE a.employee_id=TRIM(p_employee_id) AND a.tanggal=p_date AND a.tipe=v_type
      AND a.status_approval NOT IN ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR')) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Catatan jenis ini sudah ada pada tanggal tersebut. Gunakan Ubah Jam pada catatan yang ada.' USING ERRCODE='23505';
    END IF;
    v_id:='ADJ-'||to_char(clock_timestamp(),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSMS')||'-'||substr(upper(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text,'-','')),1,6);
    INSERT INTO public.absensi(id,employee_id,tanggal,jam,timestamp,tipe,address,catatan,branch_target,status_approval,
      atasan_id,face_match,face_local_precheck,manual_adjustment,adjustment_reason,adjusted_by,adjusted_at)
    VALUES(v_id,TRIM(p_employee_id),p_date,p_time,now(),v_type,'Penyesuaian manual oleh SUPERADMIN',
      '[PENYESUAIAN DATA] '||v_reason,v_branch,'DISETUJUI',NULL,FALSE,FALSE,TRUE,v_reason,v_emp.employee_id,now())
    RETURNING * INTO v_after;
    INSERT INTO public.attendance_adjustment_audit(attendance_id,employee_id,action,reason,actor_employee_id,before_data,after_data)
    VALUES(v_id,TRIM(p_employee_id),'INSERT',v_reason,v_emp.employee_id,NULL,to_jsonb(v_after));
  ELSE
    IF NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_attendance_id,'')),'') IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'ID presensi wajib untuk mengubah jam.' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
    SELECT to_jsonb(a) INTO v_before FROM public.absensi a
    WHERE a.id=TRIM(p_attendance_id) AND a.employee_id=TRIM(p_employee_id) AND a.tanggal=p_date AND a.tipe=v_type FOR UPDATE;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Catatan presensi tidak ditemukan.' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
    UPDATE public.absensi SET jam=p_time,
      punctuality_status=CASE WHEN tipe='MASUK' AND scheduled_check_in_snapshot IS NOT NULL THEN
        CASE WHEN p_time < scheduled_check_in_snapshot THEN 'EARLY'
             WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p_time-scheduled_check_in_snapshot))/60 <= COALESCE(late_tolerance_minutes_snapshot,5) THEN 'ON_TIME'
             ELSE 'LATE' END
        ELSE punctuality_status END,
      manual_adjustment=TRUE,adjustment_reason=v_reason,adjusted_by=v_emp.employee_id,adjusted_at=now()
    WHERE id=TRIM(p_attendance_id) RETURNING * INTO v_after;
    INSERT INTO public.attendance_adjustment_audit(attendance_id,employee_id,action,reason,actor_employee_id,before_data,after_data)
    VALUES(TRIM(p_attendance_id),TRIM(p_employee_id),'UPDATE',v_reason,v_emp.employee_id,v_before,to_jsonb(v_after));
  END IF;
  PERFORM public.log_activity(p_token,'ATTENDANCE_ADJUSTMENT','ABSENSI',v_after.id,
    'Penyesuaian data absensi: '||v_reason,'SUCCESS');
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'success',true,'attendance_id',v_after.id,'action',v_action,'message',
    CASE WHEN v_action='INSERT' THEN 'Absensi historis berhasil ditambahkan.' ELSE 'Jam absensi berhasil disesuaikan.' END);
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.hr_save_attendance_schedule(p_token text, p_branch text, p_day_of_week integer, p_is_workday boolean, p_shift_name text, p_shift_code text, p_shift_label text, p_scheduled_check_in time without time zone, p_scheduled_check_out time without time zone, p_early_window_minutes integer, p_late_tolerance_minutes integer, p_effective_from date)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_save_attendance_schedule(p_token text, p_branch text, p_day_of_week integer, p_is_workday boolean, p_shift_name text, p_shift_code text, p_shift_label text, p_scheduled_check_in time without time zone, p_scheduled_check_out time without time zone, p_early_window_minutes integer DEFAULT 30, p_late_tolerance_minutes integer DEFAULT 5, p_effective_from date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_emp public.karyawan; v_next date; v_branch text;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role, '')) <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Superadmin can change attendance settings.' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF NULLIF(BTRIM(p_branch),'') IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Branch is required.'; END IF;
  SELECT r.branch INTO v_branch
  FROM public.attendance_schedule_rules r
  WHERE LOWER(BTRIM(r.branch)) = LOWER(BTRIM(p_branch))
  ORDER BY r.effective_from DESC
  LIMIT 1;
  IF v_branch IS NULL THEN
    SELECT k.branch INTO v_branch
    FROM public.karyawan k
    WHERE LOWER(BTRIM(k.branch)) = LOWER(BTRIM(p_branch))
    ORDER BY k.employee_id
    LIMIT 1;
  END IF;
  v_branch := COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(v_branch), ''), BTRIM(p_branch));
  IF p_day_of_week NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 7 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Day of week must be 1..7.'; END IF;
  IF p_effective_from IS NULL OR p_effective_from < CURRENT_DATE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Effective date cannot be earlier than today.'; END IF;
  IF p_early_window_minutes NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 360 OR p_late_tolerance_minutes NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 240 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Attendance time settings are outside allowed limits.'; END IF;
  IF p_is_workday AND (p_scheduled_check_in IS NULL OR p_scheduled_check_out IS NULL OR p_scheduled_check_out <= p_scheduled_check_in) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Working day needs valid check-in and check-out times.'; END IF;
  IF NOT p_is_workday THEN p_scheduled_check_in := NULL; p_scheduled_check_out := NULL; END IF;

  SELECT MIN(r.effective_from) INTO v_next
  FROM public.attendance_schedule_rules r
  WHERE LOWER(BTRIM(r.branch)) = LOWER(BTRIM(v_branch))
    AND r.day_of_week = p_day_of_week
    AND r.effective_from > p_effective_from;

  UPDATE public.attendance_schedule_rules r
  SET effective_to = p_effective_from - 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = v_emp.employee_id::text
  WHERE LOWER(BTRIM(r.branch)) = LOWER(BTRIM(v_branch))
    AND r.day_of_week = p_day_of_week
    AND r.effective_from < p_effective_from
    AND (r.effective_to IS NULL OR r.effective_to >= p_effective_from);

  INSERT INTO public.attendance_schedule_rules (
    branch, day_of_week, is_workday, shift_name, shift_code, shift_label,
    scheduled_check_in, scheduled_check_out, early_window_minutes, late_tolerance_minutes,
    effective_from, effective_to, updated_by, updated_at
  ) VALUES (
    v_branch, p_day_of_week, p_is_workday, NULLIF(BTRIM(p_shift_name),''), NULLIF(BTRIM(p_shift_code),''), NULLIF(BTRIM(p_shift_label),''),
    p_scheduled_check_in, p_scheduled_check_out, p_early_window_minutes, p_late_tolerance_minutes,
    p_effective_from, CASE WHEN v_next IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE v_next - 1 END, v_emp.employee_id::text, now()
  )
  ON CONFLICT (branch, day_of_week, effective_from) DO UPDATE SET
    is_workday = EXCLUDED.is_workday,
    shift_name = EXCLUDED.shift_name,
    shift_code = EXCLUDED.shift_code,
    shift_label = EXCLUDED.shift_label,
    scheduled_check_in = EXCLUDED.scheduled_check_in,
    scheduled_check_out = EXCLUDED.scheduled_check_out,
    early_window_minutes = EXCLUDED.early_window_minutes,
    late_tolerance_minutes = EXCLUDED.late_tolerance_minutes,
    effective_to = EXCLUDED.effective_to,
    updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by,
    updated_at = now();

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'message','Attendance schedule saved.','branch',v_branch,'day_of_week',p_day_of_week,'effective_from',p_effective_from);
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.hr_save_calendar_override(p_token text, p_calendar_date date, p_scope_branch text, p_day_type text, p_label text, p_reason text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_save_calendar_override(p_token text, p_calendar_date date, p_scope_branch text, p_day_type text, p_label text, p_reason text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_emp public.karyawan; v_scope text; v_type text; v_branch_canonical text;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role, '')) <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Superadmin can change the calendar.' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF p_calendar_date IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Calendar date is required.'; END IF;
  v_scope := COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_scope_branch),''),'*');
  IF v_scope <> '*' THEN
    SELECT COALESCE(
      (SELECT r.branch FROM public.attendance_schedule_rules r WHERE LOWER(BTRIM(r.branch))=LOWER(BTRIM(v_scope)) ORDER BY r.effective_from DESC LIMIT 1),
      (SELECT k.branch FROM public.karyawan k WHERE LOWER(BTRIM(k.branch))=LOWER(BTRIM(v_scope)) ORDER BY k.employee_id LIMIT 1),
      v_scope
    ) INTO v_branch_canonical;
    v_scope := v_branch_canonical;
  END IF;
  v_type := UPPER(COALESCE(BTRIM(p_day_type),''));
  IF v_type NOT IN ('WORKING_DAY','DAY_OFF','NATIONAL_HOLIDAY','JOINT_LEAVE') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid calendar day type.'; END IF;
  IF NULLIF(BTRIM(p_reason),'') IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Reason is required for calendar override.'; END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.attendance_calendar_overrides(calendar_date,scope_branch,day_type,label,reason,updated_by,updated_at)
  VALUES(p_calendar_date,v_scope,v_type,NULLIF(BTRIM(p_label),''),BTRIM(p_reason),v_emp.employee_id::text,now())
  ON CONFLICT(calendar_date,scope_branch) DO UPDATE SET
    day_type=EXCLUDED.day_type,label=EXCLUDED.label,reason=EXCLUDED.reason,updated_by=EXCLUDED.updated_by,updated_at=now();
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'message','Calendar override saved.','calendar_date',p_calendar_date,'scope_branch',v_scope,'day_type',v_type);
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.hr_save_employee_doc(p_token text, p_nik text, p_jenis text, p_filename text, p_mime text, p_base64 text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_save_employee_doc(p_token text, p_nik text, p_jenis text, p_filename text, p_mime text, p_base64 text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_id text;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);

  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,'')) <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Superadmin can perform this action.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;

  IF p_nik IS NULL OR trim(p_nik) = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'NIK karyawan wajib diisi.';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.karyawan
    WHERE employee_id = p_nik
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Karyawan tidak ditemukan.';
  END IF;

  IF p_base64 IS NULL
     OR length(p_base64) = 0
     OR length(p_base64) > 3000000 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'File kosong atau melebihi batas ukuran.';
  END IF;

  IF p_filename IS NULL OR trim(p_filename) = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Nama file wajib diisi.';
  END IF;

  v_id := 'DOC-' ||
    upper(substr(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), 1, 12));

  INSERT INTO public.employee_documents (
    id,
    employee_id,
    jenis,
    filename,
    mime,
    file_data,
    uploaded_by
  )
  VALUES (
    v_id,
    p_nik,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(p_jenis), ''), 'LAINNYA'),
    p_filename,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(p_mime), ''), 'application/octet-stream'),
    p_base64,
    v_emp.employee_id
  );

  PERFORM public.log_activity(
    p_token,
    'CREATE',
    'KARYAWAN',
    p_nik,
    'Unggah dokumen ' || p_filename
  );

  RETURN json_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'id', v_id,
    'message', 'Dokumen tersimpan.'
  );
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.hr_save_face_reference(p_token text, p_employee_id text, p_descriptor double precision[], p_photo text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_save_face_reference(p_token text, p_employee_id text, p_descriptor double precision[], p_photo text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor public.karyawan;
  v_target public.karyawan;
begin
  v_actor := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  if v_actor.employee_id is null then
    raise exception 'Sesi tidak valid. Silakan masuk kembali.';
  end if;
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_actor.role,'')) <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Superadmin can manage employee face references.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  if p_employee_id is null or length(trim(p_employee_id)) = 0 then
    raise exception 'ID karyawan wajib diisi.';
  end if;
  if p_descriptor is null or array_length(p_descriptor, 1) <> 128 then
    raise exception 'Descriptor wajah tidak valid.';
  end if;
  if exists (
    select 1 from unnest(p_descriptor) as d(v)
    where v is null or v::text in ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
  ) then
    raise exception 'Descriptor wajah berisi angka tidak valid.';
  end if;
  if p_photo is null or length(p_photo) = 0 then
    raise exception 'Foto referensi wajib disertakan.';
  end if;
  if length(p_photo) > 4194304 then
    raise exception 'Foto terlalu besar. Maksimal sekitar 3 MB sebelum encoding.';
  end if;
  if p_photo not like 'data:image/%;base64,%' then
    raise exception 'Format foto tidak valid.';
  end if;

  select * into v_target
  from public.karyawan
  where employee_id = trim(p_employee_id)
  for update;
  if not found then
    raise exception 'Karyawan tidak ditemukan.';
  end if;
  if v_target.status_akun is distinct from 'AKTIF' then
    raise exception 'Karyawan tidak aktif. Foto referensi tidak diubah.';
  end if;

  update public.karyawan
  set face = p_descriptor::vector,
      face_photo = p_photo,
      face_photo_ver = coalesce(face_photo_ver, 0) + 1,
      face_updated_at = now()
  where employee_id = trim(p_employee_id);

  return json_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'message', 'Foto referensi Face ID berhasil diperbarui. Hak akses tidak berubah.',
    'employee_id', trim(p_employee_id)
  );
end;
$function$


;

-- public.hr_save_incentive_formula(p_token text, p_config jsonb)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_save_incentive_formula(p_token text, p_config jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_version integer;
  v_effective date := (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::date;
  v_pair record;
  v_flag text;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF upper(coalesce(v_emp.role,'')) <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Hanya Superadmin yang dapat menyimpan formula.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF p_config IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_config) <> 'object' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Konfigurasi formula tidak valid.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF coalesce(jsonb_typeof(p_config->'outside_rates'),'') <> 'object' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tarif dinas luar wajib berbentuk object.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF coalesce(jsonb_typeof(p_config->'eligibility'),'') <> 'object' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Aturan kelayakan formula wajib berbentuk object.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  FOREACH v_flag IN ARRAY ARRAY[
    'meal_requires_on_time','meal_exclude_outside','transport_exclude_outside',
    'phone_include_outside','outside_accept_either_event','outside_requires_clock_in',
    'outside_ignore_late_early','standby_as_outside','piket_paid'
  ] LOOP
    IF jsonb_typeof(p_config->'eligibility'->v_flag) IS DISTINCT FROM 'boolean' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Flag eligibility % harus bernilai boolean.', v_flag USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
  IF coalesce((p_config->>'meal_other')::numeric, -1) < 0
     OR coalesce((p_config->>'meal_ob')::numeric, -1) < 0
     OR coalesce((p_config->>'transport_daily')::numeric, -1) < 0
     OR coalesce((p_config->>'transport_cap')::numeric, -1) < 0
     OR coalesce((p_config->>'transport_threshold')::integer, 0) < 1
     OR coalesce((p_config->>'phone_daily')::numeric, -1) < 0
     OR coalesce((p_config->>'phone_cap')::numeric, -1) < 0
     OR coalesce((p_config->>'phone_threshold')::integer, 0) < 1
     OR coalesce((p_config->>'piket_hourly_rate')::numeric, -1) <> 15000
     OR coalesce((p_config->>'piket_min_hours')::integer, 0) <> 4
     OR coalesce((p_config->>'piket_max_hours')::integer, 0) <> 8
     OR coalesce(p_config->>'piket_rounding','FLOOR_HOUR') <> 'FLOOR_HOUR' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Nilai formula tidak valid. Periksa nominal, ambang hari, dan aturan Piket.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  -- Validate all configured rates as non-negative numbers; no string or code injection.
  FOR v_pair IN
    SELECT kv.key AS area_key, rate.key AS job_key, rate.value AS rate_value
    FROM jsonb_each(p_config->'outside_rates') kv
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(kv.value) rate
  LOOP
    IF jsonb_typeof(v_pair.rate_value) <> 'number' OR (v_pair.rate_value::text)::numeric < 0 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tarif dinas luar % / % tidak valid.', v_pair.area_key, v_pair.job_key USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  -- Serialize version allocation so two concurrent saves cannot reuse a version number.
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('public.incentive_formula_versions'));
  SELECT coalesce(max(version_no),0)+1 INTO v_version FROM public.incentive_formula_versions;
  INSERT INTO public.incentive_formula_versions
    (version_no, effective_from, config, change_note, created_by_employee_id)
  VALUES
    (v_version, v_effective, p_config, 'Disimpan melalui Formula Insentif.', v_emp.employee_id);
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'version', v_version, 'effective_from', v_effective,
    'message', 'Formula berhasil disimpan sebagai versi baru. Versi sebelumnya tetap tersedia.');
END;
$function$


;

-- public.hr_save_incentive_signatories(p_token text, p_signatories jsonb)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_save_incentive_signatories(p_token text, p_signatories jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_scope text;
  v_scope_employee_id text;
  v_prepared text;
  v_approved text;
  v_recap_prepared text;
  v_recap_approved text;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF upper(COALESCE(v_emp.role,'')) <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Hanya Superadmin yang dapat menyimpan penandatangan.' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  IF p_signatories IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_signatories) <> 'object' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Konfigurasi penandatangan tidak valid.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;

  v_scope := upper(COALESCE(p_signatories->>'scope','ALL'));
  v_scope_employee_id := CASE WHEN v_scope='ALL' THEN '*' ELSE NULLIF(BTRIM(p_signatories->>'scope_employee_id'),'') END;
  IF v_scope NOT IN ('ALL','EMPLOYEE') OR v_scope_employee_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cakupan penandatangan tidak valid.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;

  v_prepared := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_signatories->>'prepared_by_employee_id'),'');
  v_approved := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_signatories->>'approved_by_employee_id'),'');
  IF v_prepared IS NULL OR v_approved IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pilih Diajukan Oleh dan Disetujui Oleh untuk slip.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.karyawan WHERE employee_id=v_prepared AND status_akun='AKTIF')
     OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.karyawan WHERE employee_id=v_approved AND status_akun='AKTIF') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Penandatangan slip harus berasal dari karyawan aktif.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  IF v_scope <> 'ALL' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.karyawan WHERE employee_id=v_scope_employee_id AND status_akun='AKTIF'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Karyawan untuk override penandatangan tidak aktif atau tidak ditemukan.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;

  IF v_scope='ALL' THEN
    -- Kompatibilitas: pemanggil lama tanpa field recap akan memakai signer global lama.
    v_recap_prepared := COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_signatories->>'recap_prepared_by_employee_id'),''),v_prepared);
    v_recap_approved := COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_signatories->>'recap_approved_by_employee_id'),''),v_approved);
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.karyawan WHERE employee_id=v_recap_prepared AND status_akun='AKTIF')
       OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.karyawan WHERE employee_id=v_recap_approved AND status_akun='AKTIF') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Penandatangan Cetak Rekap harus berasal dari karyawan aktif.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.incentive_signatory_configs AS prior_cfg
    (scope_employee_id, prepared_by_employee_id, approved_by_employee_id,
     recap_prepared_by_employee_id, recap_approved_by_employee_id,
     updated_by_employee_id, updated_at)
  VALUES
    (v_scope_employee_id, v_prepared, v_approved,
     CASE WHEN v_scope='ALL' THEN v_recap_prepared ELSE NULL END,
     CASE WHEN v_scope='ALL' THEN v_recap_approved ELSE NULL END,
     v_emp.employee_id, now())
  ON CONFLICT (scope_employee_id) DO UPDATE SET
    prepared_by_employee_id=EXCLUDED.prepared_by_employee_id,
    approved_by_employee_id=EXCLUDED.approved_by_employee_id,
    recap_prepared_by_employee_id=CASE WHEN v_scope='ALL' THEN EXCLUDED.recap_prepared_by_employee_id ELSE prior_cfg.recap_prepared_by_employee_id END,
    recap_approved_by_employee_id=CASE WHEN v_scope='ALL' THEN EXCLUDED.recap_approved_by_employee_id ELSE prior_cfg.recap_approved_by_employee_id END,
    updated_by_employee_id=EXCLUDED.updated_by_employee_id,
    updated_at=now();

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'message',CASE WHEN v_scope='ALL' THEN 'Penandatangan slip dan Cetak Rekap/Reimbursement berhasil disimpan.' ELSE 'Override penandatangan slip berhasil disimpan.' END,
    'scope',v_scope
  );
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.hr_save_incentive_underpayment(p_token text, p_employee_id text, p_period_start date, p_period_end date, p_amount numeric, p_note text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_save_incentive_underpayment(p_token text, p_employee_id text, p_period_start date, p_period_end date, p_amount numeric, p_note text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_emp public.karyawan; v_target public.karyawan;
BEGIN
  v_emp:=public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF upper(coalesce(v_emp.role,'')) <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Input kurang bayar hanya dapat dilakukan Superadmin.' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  IF p_period_start IS NULL OR p_period_end IS NULL OR extract(day FROM p_period_start)<>6
     OR p_period_end<>(p_period_start+interval '1 month'-interval '1 day')::date THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Periode payroll harus mengikuti tanggal 6 sampai tanggal 5.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_amount IS NULL OR p_amount<=0 OR nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_note,'')),'') IS NULL OR length(p_note)>1000 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Nominal positif dan keterangan kurang bayar wajib diisi.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO v_target FROM public.karyawan WHERE employee_id=p_employee_id AND status_akun='AKTIF' FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Karyawan aktif tidak ditemukan.' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.incentive_underpayments(employee_id,period_start,period_end,amount,note,created_by_employee_id)
  VALUES(p_employee_id,p_period_start,p_period_end,p_amount,btrim(p_note),v_emp.employee_id)
  ON CONFLICT(employee_id,period_start,period_end) DO UPDATE SET amount=EXCLUDED.amount,note=EXCLUDED.note,
    created_by_employee_id=EXCLUDED.created_by_employee_id,updated_at=now();
  INSERT INTO public.approval_log(id,actor_id,actor_role,action_type,target_id,target_nik,status,alasan)
  VALUES('INCUB-'||gen_random_uuid()::text,v_emp.employee_id,v_emp.role,'INCENTIVE_UNDERPAYMENT_SAVE',
    p_employee_id||':'||p_period_start::text,p_employee_id,'SAVED',btrim(p_note));
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'message','Kurang bayar bulan lalu tersimpan pada periode payroll yang dipilih.');
END;
$function$


;

-- public.hr_save_reimbursement_limits(p_token text, p_entertain_limit numeric, p_transport_limit numeric)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_save_reimbursement_limits(p_token text, p_entertain_limit numeric, p_transport_limit numeric)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_emp public.karyawan;
BEGIN
  v_emp:=public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF upper(coalesce(v_emp.role,''))<>'SUPERADMIN' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Hanya Superadmin yang dapat mengubah Batas Reimbursement.' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  IF p_entertain_limit IS NULL OR p_transport_limit IS NULL OR p_entertain_limit<0 OR p_transport_limit<0
     OR p_entertain_limit>1000000000 OR p_transport_limit>1000000000 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Batas Reimbursement harus angka 0 sampai 1.000.000.000.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.incentive_reimbursement_limits(id,entertain_limit,transport_limit,updated_at,updated_by_employee_id)
  VALUES(1,p_entertain_limit,p_transport_limit,now(),v_emp.employee_id)
  ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET entertain_limit=EXCLUDED.entertain_limit,
    transport_limit=EXCLUDED.transport_limit,updated_at=now(),updated_by_employee_id=v_emp.employee_id;
  INSERT INTO public.approval_log(id,actor_id,actor_role,action_type,target_id,target_nik,status,alasan)
  VALUES('RMBLIMIT-'||gen_random_uuid()::text,v_emp.employee_id,v_emp.role,'REIMBURSEMENT_LIMIT_UPDATE',
    'GLOBAL',v_emp.employee_id,'SAVED',
    'Entertain='||p_entertain_limit::text||'; Transport='||p_transport_limit::text);
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'message','Batas Reimbursement berhasil disimpan.');
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.hr_set_incentive_employee_exclusion(p_token text, p_employee_id text, p_is_excluded boolean, p_reason text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_set_incentive_employee_exclusion(p_token text, p_employee_id text, p_is_excluded boolean, p_reason text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_target public.karyawan;
  v_reason text := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_reason, '')), '');
  v_changed integer := 0;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF upper(coalesce(v_emp.role, '')) <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Hanya Superadmin yang dapat mengubah pengecualian insentif.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_employee_id, '')), '') IS NULL OR p_is_excluded IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Karyawan dan status pengecualian wajib diisi.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF v_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(v_reason) > 300 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Alasan pengecualian maksimal 300 karakter.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_target
  FROM public.karyawan
  WHERE employee_id = btrim(p_employee_id)
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND OR v_target.status_akun <> 'AKTIF' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Karyawan aktif tidak ditemukan.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('public.incentive_employee_exclusions'));

  IF p_is_excluded THEN
    INSERT INTO public.incentive_employee_exclusions (
      employee_id, is_excluded, reason, updated_by_employee_id, created_at, updated_at
    ) VALUES (
      v_target.employee_id, true, v_reason, v_emp.employee_id, now(), now()
    )
    ON CONFLICT (employee_id) DO UPDATE SET
      is_excluded = true,
      reason = EXCLUDED.reason,
      updated_by_employee_id = EXCLUDED.updated_by_employee_id,
      updated_at = now();

    PERFORM public.log_activity(
      p_token, 'UPDATE', 'INSENTIF', v_target.employee_id,
      'Karyawan dikecualikan dari perhitungan dan rekap insentif.', 'SUCCESS'
    );

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', true,
      'employee_id', v_target.employee_id,
      'is_excluded', true,
      'message', 'Karyawan berhasil dikecualikan dari seluruh rekap insentif.'
    );
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.incentive_employee_exclusions
  SET is_excluded = false,
      updated_by_employee_id = v_emp.employee_id,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE employee_id = v_target.employee_id
    AND is_excluded = true;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_changed = ROW_COUNT;

  IF v_changed > 0 THEN
    PERFORM public.log_activity(
      p_token, 'UPDATE', 'INSENTIF', v_target.employee_id,
      'Karyawan dipulihkan ke perhitungan dan rekap insentif.', 'SUCCESS'
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'employee_id', v_target.employee_id,
    'is_excluded', false,
    'message', CASE WHEN v_changed > 0
      THEN 'Karyawan berhasil dipulihkan ke seluruh rekap insentif.'
      ELSE 'Karyawan sudah termasuk dalam perhitungan insentif.' END
  );
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.hr_set_role(p_token text, p_nik text, p_role text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_set_role(p_token text, p_nik text, p_role text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_actor public.karyawan;
  v_role text := UPPER(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_role, '')));
  v_target public.karyawan;
  v_super_count integer;
BEGIN
  v_actor := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_actor.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_actor.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_actor.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_actor.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_actor.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_actor.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_actor.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_actor.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_actor.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_actor.role, ''),true);
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_actor.role,'')) <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Superadmin can change roles.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF v_role NOT IN ('KARYAWAN','ADMIN','SUPERADMIN') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid role. Choose Employee, Administrator, or Superadmin.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_nik IS NULL OR BTRIM(p_nik) = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Employee ID is required.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_nik = v_actor.employee_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'You cannot change your own role.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO v_target FROM public.karyawan WHERE employee_id = p_nik FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Employee not found.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002'; END IF;
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_target.role,'')) = 'SUPERADMIN' AND v_role <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN
    SELECT count(*) INTO v_super_count FROM public.karyawan
    WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(role,'')) = 'SUPERADMIN' AND status_akun = 'AKTIF';
    IF v_super_count <= 1 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'The last active Superadmin cannot be demoted.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
  END IF;
  UPDATE public.karyawan SET role = v_role, updated_at = now() WHERE employee_id = p_nik;
  PERFORM public.log_activity(p_token, 'UPDATE', 'USER', p_nik, 'Role changed to ' || v_role);
  RETURN json_build_object('ok', true, 'message', 'Role for ' || p_nik || ' changed to ' || v_role);
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.hr_submit_reimbursement_request(p_token text, p_category text, p_tanggal date, p_nominal numeric, p_catatan text, p_lampiran text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_submit_reimbursement_request(p_token text, p_category text, p_tanggal date, p_nominal numeric, p_catatan text DEFAULT ''::text, p_lampiran text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan; v_manager public.karyawan; v_category text:=upper(btrim(coalesce(p_category,'')));
  v_start date; v_end date; v_current_start date; v_current_end date; v_budget numeric(14,2); v_approved numeric(14,2); v_pending numeric(14,2);
  v_spent numeric(14,2); v_reserved numeric(14,2); v_available numeric(14,2); v_entertain_limit numeric(14,2); v_transport_limit numeric(14,2);
  v_note text:=btrim(coalesce(p_catatan,'')); v_id text; v_attachment public.hr_reimbursement_attachment_uploads%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  v_emp:=public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF upper(coalesce(v_emp.job_code,''))<>'HYBRID' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pengajuan reimbursement hanya untuk karyawan HYBRID.' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF v_category NOT IN ('ENTERTAIN','TRANSPORT') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Kategori reimbursement tidak valid.' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  IF p_tanggal IS NULL OR p_nominal IS NULL OR p_nominal<=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tanggal dan nominal positif wajib diisi.' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  IF length(v_note)>1000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Catatan maksimal 1.000 karakter.' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  SELECT k.* INTO v_manager FROM public.karyawan k
    WHERE k.employee_id=v_emp.approval_line_id AND k.status_akun='AKTIF' AND upper(coalesce(k.role,'')) IN ('KARYAWAN','SUPERADMIN');
  IF v_emp.approval_line_id IS NULL OR v_emp.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id OR NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Atasan langsung aktif belum ditetapkan. Hubungi HR sebelum mengajukan reimbursement.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  SELECT b.period_start,b.period_end INTO v_start,v_end FROM public.hr_reimbursement_period_bounds(p_tanggal) b;
  SELECT b.period_start,b.period_end INTO v_current_start,v_current_end
    FROM public.hr_reimbursement_period_bounds((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta')::date) b;
  IF p_tanggal<v_current_start OR p_tanggal>(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta')::date THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tanggal pengeluaran harus berada pada periode payroll berjalan dan tidak boleh di masa depan.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  SELECT entertain_limit,transport_limit INTO v_entertain_limit,v_transport_limit FROM public.incentive_reimbursement_limits WHERE id=1;
  v_budget:=CASE WHEN v_category='ENTERTAIN' THEN v_entertain_limit ELSE v_transport_limit END;
  INSERT INTO public.hr_reimbursement_period_locks(employee_id,category,period_start) VALUES(v_emp.employee_id,v_category,v_start)
    ON CONFLICT(employee_id,category,period_start) DO UPDATE SET touched_at=now();
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.hr_reimbursement_period_locks WHERE employee_id=v_emp.employee_id AND category=v_category AND period_start=v_start FOR UPDATE;
  SELECT coalesce(sum(amount),0) INTO v_approved FROM public.hr_reimbursement_requests
    WHERE employee_id=v_emp.employee_id AND category=v_category AND period_start=v_start AND status='DISETUJUI';
  SELECT coalesce(sum(amount),0) INTO v_pending FROM public.hr_reimbursement_requests
    WHERE employee_id=v_emp.employee_id AND category=v_category AND period_start=v_start AND status IN ('PENDING_ATASAN','PENDING_HR');
  v_spent:=least(v_budget,v_approved);
  v_reserved:=least(v_pending,greatest(0,v_budget-v_spent));
  v_available:=greatest(0,v_budget-v_spent-v_reserved);
  IF p_nominal>v_available AND v_note='' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Catatan wajib diisi untuk pengajuan Over Budget.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  IF nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_lampiran,'')),'') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Bukti transaksi wajib dilampirkan.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_lampiran IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT * INTO v_attachment FROM public.hr_reimbursement_attachment_uploads u
      WHERE u.storage_path=p_lampiran AND u.employee_id=v_emp.employee_id AND u.category=v_category
        AND u.uploaded_at IS NOT NULL AND u.request_id IS NULL AND u.expires_at>now()
      FOR UPDATE;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Lampiran tidak valid, belum terunggah, atau bukan milik akun Anda.' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  END IF;
  v_id:='RMB-'||upper(substr(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text,'-',''),1,20));
  INSERT INTO public.hr_reimbursement_requests(id,employee_id,category,request_date,period_start,period_end,amount,
    budget_available_at_submission,over_budget_at_submission,note,attachment_path,status)
  VALUES(v_id,v_emp.employee_id,v_category,p_tanggal,v_start,v_end,p_nominal,v_available,
    greatest(0,p_nominal-v_available),v_note,p_lampiran,'PENDING_ATASAN');
  UPDATE public.hr_reimbursement_attachment_uploads SET request_id=v_id WHERE storage_path=p_lampiran;
  INSERT INTO public.approval_log(id,actor_id,actor_role,action_type,target_id,target_nik,status,alasan)
  VALUES('RMBLOG-'||gen_random_uuid()::text,v_emp.employee_id,v_emp.role,'REIMBURSEMENT_SUBMIT',v_id,v_emp.employee_id,'PENDING_ATASAN',v_note);
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'id',v_id,'status','PENDING_ATASAN','period_start',v_start,'period_end',v_end,
    'over_budget_amount',greatest(0,p_nominal-v_available),'within_budget_amount',least(p_nominal,v_available),
    'message',CASE WHEN p_nominal>v_available THEN 'Pengajuan Over Budget berhasil dikirim ke atasan langsung.' ELSE 'Pengajuan reimbursement berhasil dikirim ke atasan langsung.' END);
END;
$function$


;
