-- public.process_approval(p_token text, p_id text, p_action text, p_alasan text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.process_approval(p_token text, p_id text, p_action text, p_alasan text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_abs public.absensi;
  v_new_status text;
  v_action text := UPPER(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_action, '')));
  v_role text;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  v_role := UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,''));
  IF v_role = 'ADMIN' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Administrator role is view-only. Contact Superadmin for changes.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF v_action NOT IN ('APPROVE','REJECT') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid approval action.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF v_action = 'REJECT' AND NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_alasan,'')),'') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'A rejection reason is required.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_abs FROM public.absensi WHERE id = p_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Attendance record not found.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002'; END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id', COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id,''), true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role', COALESCE(v_emp.role,''), true);

  -- Stage 1 is strictly assigned to the direct manager. Superadmin is not a bypass.
  IF v_abs.status_approval = 'PENDING_ATASAN'
     AND v_abs.atasan_id = v_emp.employee_id
     AND v_role IN ('KARYAWAN','SUPERADMIN') THEN
    v_new_status := CASE WHEN v_action = 'APPROVE' THEN 'PENDING_HR' ELSE 'DITOLAK_ATASAN' END;
    UPDATE public.absensi SET
      status_approval = v_new_status,
      alasan_approval = NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_alasan,'')),''),
      alasan_approval_atasan = NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_alasan,'')),''),
      approval_manager_at = now(),
      approval_manager_by = v_emp.employee_id,
      approval_completed_at = CASE WHEN v_new_status = 'DITOLAK_ATASAN' THEN now() ELSE NULL END,
      foto_delete_after = NULL
    WHERE id = p_id;
  ELSIF v_abs.status_approval = 'PENDING_HR'
        AND v_role = 'SUPERADMIN' THEN
    v_new_status := CASE WHEN v_action = 'APPROVE' THEN 'DISETUJUI' ELSE 'DITOLAK_HR' END;
    UPDATE public.absensi SET
      status_approval = v_new_status,
      alasan_approval = NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_alasan,'')),''),
      alasan_approval_hr = NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_alasan,'')),''),
      approval_hr_at = now(),
      approval_hr_by = v_emp.employee_id,
      approval_completed_at = now(),
      foto_delete_after = CASE
        WHEN v_new_status = 'DISETUJUI' AND foto_retention_enabled = TRUE
          AND NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(storage_path,'')),'') IS NOT NULL
          AND BTRIM(storage_path) !~* '^https?://'
        THEN now() + INTERVAL '24 hours' ELSE NULL END
    WHERE id = p_id;
  ELSE
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'You are not authorized to process this attendance record, or its status has changed.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  RETURN json_build_object('success',true,'message','Attendance status updated successfully.','status',v_new_status);
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.process_cuti_approval(p_token text, p_id text, p_action text, p_alasan text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.process_cuti_approval(p_token text, p_id text, p_action text, p_alasan text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_cuti public.pengajuan_cuti;
  v_owner public.karyawan;
  v_action text := UPPER(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_action, '')));
  v_role text;
  v_year integer;
  v_existing integer;
  v_has_balance boolean := false;
  v_new_balance integer;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  v_role := UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,''));
  IF v_role = 'ADMIN' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Administrator role is view-only. Contact Superadmin for changes.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF v_action NOT IN ('APPROVE','REJECT') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid approval action.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF v_action = 'REJECT' AND NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_alasan,'')),'') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'A rejection reason is required.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_cuti FROM public.pengajuan_cuti WHERE id = p_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Time-off request not found.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO v_owner FROM public.karyawan WHERE employee_id = v_cuti.employee_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'The employee who submitted this request could not be found.'; END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id', COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id,''), true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role', COALESCE(v_emp.role,''), true);

  -- Stage 1 must be performed by the assigned direct manager, including when that person is Superadmin.
  IF v_cuti.status_atasan = 'PENDING'
     AND v_owner.approval_line_id = v_emp.employee_id
     AND v_role IN ('KARYAWAN','SUPERADMIN') THEN
    IF v_action = 'APPROVE' THEN
      UPDATE public.pengajuan_cuti
      SET status_atasan = 'DISETUJUI', alasan_atasan = NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_alasan,'')),''), timestamp_atasan = now()
      WHERE id = p_id;
    ELSE
      UPDATE public.pengajuan_cuti
      SET status_atasan = 'DITOLAK', alasan_atasan = NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_alasan,'')),''), timestamp_atasan = now()
      WHERE id = p_id;
    END IF;

  -- Stage 2 is final approval and is only available after the manager has approved.
  ELSIF v_cuti.status_atasan = 'DISETUJUI'
        AND v_cuti.status_hr = 'PENDING'
        AND v_role = 'SUPERADMIN' THEN
    IF v_action = 'APPROVE' THEN
      -- Locking the employee row serializes balance updates for the same employee.
      IF v_cuti.kode_cuti = 'CT' THEN
        v_year := EXTRACT(YEAR FROM v_cuti.tanggal_mulai)::integer;
        SELECT s.sisa INTO v_existing
        FROM public.sisa_cuti s
        WHERE s.employee_id = v_cuti.employee_id AND s.tahun = v_year AND s.kode_cuti = 'CT'
        FOR UPDATE;
        v_has_balance := FOUND;
      END IF;

      UPDATE public.pengajuan_cuti
      SET status_hr = 'DISETUJUI', alasan_hr = NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_alasan,'')),''), timestamp_hr = now()
      WHERE id = p_id;

      IF v_cuti.kode_cuti = 'CT' THEN
        IF v_has_balance THEN
          v_new_balance := COALESCE(v_existing, 0) - COALESCE(v_cuti.total_hari, 0);
          IF v_new_balance < 0 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Insufficient annual time-off balance. The request was not approved.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
          END IF;
          UPDATE public.sisa_cuti SET sisa = v_new_balance
          WHERE employee_id = v_cuti.employee_id AND tahun = v_year AND kode_cuti = 'CT';
        ELSE
          SELECT COALESCE(m.kuota_tahunan,0) - COALESCE((
            SELECT SUM(COALESCE(c.total_hari,0))::integer
            FROM public.pengajuan_cuti c
            WHERE c.employee_id = v_cuti.employee_id AND c.kode_cuti = 'CT'
              AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.tanggal_mulai)::integer = v_year
              AND c.status_atasan = 'DISETUJUI' AND c.status_hr = 'DISETUJUI'
          ),0)
          INTO v_new_balance
          FROM public.master_cuti m WHERE m.kode = 'CT';
          IF v_new_balance IS NULL OR v_new_balance < 0 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Insufficient annual time-off balance. The request was not approved.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
          END IF;
          INSERT INTO public.sisa_cuti(employee_id,tahun,kode_cuti,sisa)
          VALUES (v_cuti.employee_id,v_year,'CT',v_new_balance)
          ON CONFLICT (employee_id,tahun,kode_cuti) DO UPDATE SET sisa = EXCLUDED.sisa;
        END IF;
      END IF;
    ELSE
      UPDATE public.pengajuan_cuti
      SET status_hr = 'DITOLAK', alasan_hr = NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_alasan,'')),''), timestamp_hr = now()
      WHERE id = p_id;
    END IF;
  ELSE
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'You are not authorized to process this time-off request, or its status has changed.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  RETURN json_build_object('success', true, 'message', 'Time-off status updated successfully.');
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.process_reimbursement_approval(p_token text, p_id text, p_action text, p_alasan text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.process_reimbursement_approval(p_token text, p_id text, p_action text, p_alasan text DEFAULT ''::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan; v_owner public.karyawan; v_row public.hr_reimbursement_requests%ROWTYPE;
  v_action text:=upper(btrim(coalesce(p_action,'')));
  v_next text; v_audit_action text; v_msg text;
  v_manager_step boolean; v_hr_step boolean;
BEGIN
  v_emp:=public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF upper(coalesce(v_emp.role,''))='ADMIN' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Administrator role is view-only.' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF v_action NOT IN ('APPROVE','REJECT') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Aksi persetujuan tidak valid.' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  IF v_action='REJECT' AND nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_alasan,'')),'') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Catatan penolakan wajib diisi.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO v_row FROM public.hr_reimbursement_requests WHERE id=p_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pengajuan reimbursement tidak ditemukan.' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;

  v_manager_step := (v_row.status='PENDING_ATASAN'
                     AND upper(coalesce(v_emp.role,'')) IN ('KARYAWAN','SUPERADMIN'));
  v_hr_step := (v_row.status='PENDING_HR' AND upper(coalesce(v_emp.role,''))='SUPERADMIN');

  IF v_manager_step OR v_hr_step THEN
    -- Jalur normal: identik dengan implementasi sebelum migrasi.
    SELECT * INTO v_owner FROM public.karyawan WHERE employee_id=v_row.employee_id FOR UPDATE;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Data karyawan pengaju tidak ditemukan.' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
    IF upper(coalesce(v_owner.job_code,'')) <> 'HYBRID' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Persetujuan Reimbursement hanya berlaku untuk pengajuan karyawan HYBRID.' USING ERRCODE='42501';
    END IF;
    IF v_manager_step AND v_owner.approval_line_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_emp.employee_id THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tahap approval berubah atau tugas ini bukan milik Anda.' USING ERRCODE='42501';
    END IF;
    PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',coalesce(v_emp.employee_id,''),true);
    PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',coalesce(v_emp.role,''),true);
    IF v_manager_step THEN
      v_next:=CASE WHEN v_action='APPROVE' THEN 'PENDING_HR' ELSE 'DITOLAK_ATASAN' END;
      UPDATE public.hr_reimbursement_requests SET status=v_next,manager_approval_at=now(),manager_approval_by=v_emp.employee_id,
        manager_note=nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_alasan,'')),''),updated_at=now() WHERE id=p_id;
      v_audit_action:=CASE WHEN v_action='APPROVE' THEN 'REIMBURSEMENT_MANAGER_APPROVE' ELSE 'REIMBURSEMENT_MANAGER_REJECT' END;
    ELSE
      v_next:=CASE WHEN v_action='APPROVE' THEN 'DISETUJUI' ELSE 'DITOLAK_HR' END;
      UPDATE public.hr_reimbursement_requests SET status=v_next,hr_approval_at=now(),hr_approval_by=v_emp.employee_id,
        hr_note=nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_alasan,'')),''),updated_at=now() WHERE id=p_id;
      v_audit_action:=CASE WHEN v_action='APPROVE' THEN 'REIMBURSEMENT_SUPERADMIN_APPROVE' ELSE 'REIMBURSEMENT_SUPERADMIN_REJECT' END;
    END IF;
    INSERT INTO public.approval_log(id,actor_id,actor_role,action_type,target_id,target_nik,status,alasan)
    VALUES('RMBLOG-'||gen_random_uuid()::text,v_emp.employee_id,v_emp.role,v_audit_action,v_row.id,v_row.employee_id,v_next,nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_alasan,'')),''));
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'id',p_id,'status',v_next,
      'message',CASE WHEN v_next='PENDING_HR' THEN 'Disetujui atasan; menunggu persetujuan Superadmin.'
        WHEN v_next='DISETUJUI' THEN 'Pengajuan reimbursement disetujui.' ELSE 'Pengajuan reimbursement ditolak.' END);
  END IF;

  -- Idempotensi: baris sudah lewat tahap pending. Terima ulang permintaan HANYA
  -- bila pemanggil adalah pelaku transisi yang sama dengan aksi yang sama.
  IF v_row.manager_approval_by IS NOT NULL
     AND v_row.manager_approval_by = v_emp.employee_id THEN
    IF v_action='APPROVE' AND v_row.status IN ('PENDING_HR','DISETUJUI','DITOLAK_HR') THEN
      v_msg:=CASE v_row.status WHEN 'PENDING_HR' THEN 'Disetujui atasan; menunggu persetujuan Superadmin.'
              ELSE 'Pengajuan reimbursement sudah diproses sebelumnya.' END;
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'id',p_id,'status',v_row.status,'already_processed',true,'message',v_msg);
    END IF;
    IF v_action='REJECT' AND v_row.status='DITOLAK_ATASAN' THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'id',p_id,'status',v_row.status,'already_processed',true,
        'message','Pengajuan reimbursement sudah diproses sebelumnya.');
    END IF;
  END IF;
  IF v_row.hr_approval_by IS NOT NULL
     AND v_row.hr_approval_by = v_emp.employee_id
     AND v_action='APPROVE' AND v_row.status='DISETUJUI' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'id',p_id,'status',v_row.status,'already_processed',true,
      'message','Pengajuan reimbursement sudah diproses sebelumnya.');
  END IF;
  IF v_row.hr_approval_by IS NOT NULL
     AND v_row.hr_approval_by = v_emp.employee_id
     AND v_action='REJECT' AND v_row.status='DITOLAK_HR' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'id',p_id,'status',v_row.status,'already_processed',true,
      'message','Pengajuan reimbursement sudah diproses sebelumnya.');
  END IF;

  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tahap approval berubah atau tugas ini bukan milik Anda.' USING ERRCODE='42501';
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.reset_face_registration(p_token text, p_employee_id text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reset_face_registration(p_token text, p_employee_id text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v_emp karyawan;
begin
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,'')) <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Superadmin can perform this action.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  update public.karyawan set
    face=null, face_photo=null,
    face_photo_ver=coalesce(face_photo_ver,0)+1,
    face_updated_at=now()
  where employee_id=p_employee_id;
  update public.face_sessions set status='REVOKED'
  where employee_id=p_employee_id and status='AUTHORIZED';
  return json_build_object('success',true,'message','Face ID & foto berhasil direset.');
end; $function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.retention_list_candidates(p_mode text, p_limit integer)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.retention_list_candidates(p_mode text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 100)
 RETURNS TABLE(attendance_id text, object_path text, object_created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_mode text := lower(btrim(coalesce(p_mode, '')));
  v_cutoff timestamptz;
  v_limit integer := greatest(
    1,
    least(coalesce(p_limit, 100), 100)
  );
BEGIN

  IF v_mode = 'legacy' THEN

    SELECT config_timestamptz
      INTO v_cutoff
      FROM public.photo_retention_config
     WHERE config_key = 'legacy_cutoff_at';

    IF v_cutoff IS NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION
        'Waktu cutover retensi tidak ditemukan.';
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
      matched.attendance_id::text,
      o.name::text,
      o.created_at
    FROM storage.objects AS o

    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT a.id AS attendance_id
      FROM public.absensi AS a
      WHERE
        a.storage_path = o.name

        OR (
          NULLIF(btrim(a.foto_url), '') IS NOT NULL
          AND btrim(a.foto_url) !~* '^(https?://|data:)'
          AND regexp_replace(
            btrim(a.foto_url),
            '^/?evidence/',
            '',
            'i'
          ) = o.name
        )

        OR (
          NULLIF(btrim(a.foto_path), '') IS NOT NULL
          AND btrim(a.foto_path) !~* '^(https?://|data:)'
          AND regexp_replace(
            btrim(a.foto_path),
            '^/?evidence/',
            '',
            'i'
          ) = o.name
        )

        OR right(
          o.name,
          length(a.id) + 4
        ) = a.id || '.jpg'

      ORDER BY
        (a.storage_path = o.name) DESC,
        a.id

      LIMIT 1
    ) AS matched ON TRUE

    WHERE o.bucket_id = 'evidence'
      AND o.name ~ '(^|/)ABS-[^/]+[.]jpg$'
      AND o.created_at < v_cutoff

    ORDER BY
      o.created_at ASC,
      o.name ASC

    LIMIT v_limit;

  ELSIF v_mode = 'due' THEN

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
      a.id::text,
      a.storage_path::text,
      o.created_at
    FROM public.absensi AS a

    JOIN storage.objects AS o
      ON o.bucket_id = 'evidence'
     AND o.name = a.storage_path

    WHERE a.foto_retention_enabled = TRUE
      AND a.foto_deleted_at IS NULL
      AND a.foto_delete_after IS NOT NULL
      AND a.foto_delete_after <= now()
      AND a.status_approval IN ('VALID', 'DISETUJUI')

    ORDER BY
      a.foto_delete_after ASC,
      a.id ASC

    LIMIT v_limit;

  ELSE

    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'Mode retensi tidak valid. Gunakan legacy atau due.';

  END IF;

END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.retention_mark_deleted(p_object_path text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.retention_mark_deleted(p_object_path text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_rows integer;
  v_path text := btrim(coalesce(p_object_path, ''));
BEGIN

  IF v_path = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Path objek kosong.';
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.absensi AS a
  SET foto_deleted_at = COALESCE(
    a.foto_deleted_at,
    now()
  )
  WHERE
    a.storage_path = v_path

    OR (
      NULLIF(btrim(a.foto_url), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND btrim(a.foto_url) !~* '^(https?://|data:)'
      AND regexp_replace(
        btrim(a.foto_url),
        '^/?evidence/',
        '',
        'i'
      ) = v_path
    )

    OR (
      NULLIF(btrim(a.foto_path), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND btrim(a.foto_path) !~* '^(https?://|data:)'
      AND regexp_replace(
        btrim(a.foto_path),
        '^/?evidence/',
        '',
        'i'
      ) = v_path
    )

    OR right(
      v_path,
      length(a.id) + 4
    ) = a.id || '.jpg';

  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows = ROW_COUNT;

  RETURN v_rows;

END;
$function$


;

-- public.revoke_face_session(p_token text, p_employee_id text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.revoke_face_session(p_token text, p_employee_id text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v_emp karyawan; v_n int;
begin
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,'')) <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Superadmin can perform this action.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  update public.face_sessions set status='REVOKED'
  where employee_id=p_employee_id and status='AUTHORIZED';
  get diagnostics v_n = row_count;
  return json_build_object('success',true,'message','Akses registrasi dicabut ('||v_n||' sesi).');
end; $function$


;

-- public.rh_is_active_approver(p_employee_id text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rh_is_active_approver(p_employee_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.karyawan k WHERE k.approval_line_id=p_employee_id AND k.status_akun='AKTIF');
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.save_evidence_path(p_token text, p_absensi_id text, p_storage_path text, p_public_url text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_evidence_path(p_token text, p_absensi_id text, p_storage_path text, p_public_url text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_rows integer;
  v_expected_path text;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);

  IF p_absensi_id IS NULL OR BTRIM(p_absensi_id) = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ID absensi tidak valid.';
  END IF;

  v_expected_path := v_emp.employee_id::text || '/' || BTRIM(p_absensi_id) || '.jpg';

  IF BTRIM(COALESCE(p_storage_path, '')) <> v_expected_path THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Path foto tidak sesuai dengan sesi karyawan.';
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.absensi AS a
  SET
    storage_path = v_expected_path,
    foto_url = v_expected_path, -- kompatibilitas dengan frontend lama
    foto_uploaded_at = now(),
    foto_deleted_at = NULL,
    foto_retention_enabled = TRUE,
    foto_delete_after = CASE
      WHEN a.status_approval = 'VALID'
        THEN now() + INTERVAL '24 hours'
      WHEN a.status_approval = 'DISETUJUI'
        THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(a.approval_completed_at, now()), now()) + INTERVAL '24 hours'
      ELSE NULL -- pending/rejected tidak dijadwalkan otomatis
    END
  WHERE a.id = BTRIM(p_absensi_id)
    AND a.employee_id = v_emp.employee_id;

  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows = ROW_COUNT;
  IF v_rows = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Data absensi tidak ditemukan atau bukan milik akun ini.';
  END IF;

  RETURN json_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'id', p_absensi_id,
    'storage_path', v_expected_path
  );
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.save_lokasi_kantor(p_token text, p_branch text, p_alamat text, p_lat numeric, p_lon numeric, p_radius integer, p_max_accuracy integer, p_status text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_lokasi_kantor(p_token text, p_branch text, p_alamat text, p_lat numeric, p_lon numeric, p_radius integer, p_max_accuracy integer, p_status text DEFAULT 'AKTIF'::text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v_emp karyawan;
begin
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,'')) <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Superadmin can perform this action.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  if p_branch is null or trim(p_branch)='' then raise exception 'Branch wajib diisi.'; end if;

  insert into public.lokasi_kantor(branch, alamat, latitude, longitude, radius_m, max_accuracy_m, status)
  values (p_branch, p_alamat, p_lat, p_lon, coalesce(p_radius,100), coalesce(p_max_accuracy,50), p_status)
  on conflict (branch) do update set
    alamat = excluded.alamat,
    latitude = excluded.latitude,
    longitude = excluded.longitude,
    radius_m = excluded.radius_m,
    max_accuracy_m = excluded.max_accuracy_m,
    status = excluded.status;

  return json_build_object('success',true,'message','Lokasi kantor berhasil disimpan.');
end; $function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.save_lokasi_kantor(p_token text, p_old_branch text, p_branch text, p_alamat text, p_lat numeric, p_lon numeric, p_radius integer, p_max_accuracy integer, p_status text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_lokasi_kantor(p_token text, p_old_branch text, p_branch text, p_alamat text, p_lat numeric, p_lon numeric, p_radius integer, p_max_accuracy integer, p_status text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_current_branch text;
  v_count integer;
  v_new_status text := upper(coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_status),''),'AKTIF'));
  v_is_rename boolean := false;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF upper(coalesce(v_emp.role,'')) <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Superadmin can manage office locations.' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  IF nullif(btrim(p_branch),'') IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Branch name is required.' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  IF p_lat IS NULL OR p_lon IS NULL OR p_lat < -90 OR p_lat > 90 OR p_lon < -180 OR p_lon > 180 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Latitude/longitude is outside valid bounds.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  IF coalesce(p_radius,0) < 1 OR coalesce(p_max_accuracy,0) < 1 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Radius and maximum GPS accuracy must be at least 1 meter.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  IF v_new_status NOT IN ('AKTIF','NONAKTIF') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid location status.' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;

  IF nullif(btrim(p_old_branch),'') IS NULL THEN
    SELECT count(*) INTO v_count FROM public.lokasi_kantor l
    WHERE upper(btrim(l.branch)) = upper(btrim(p_branch));
    IF v_count > 0 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'A branch with this name already exists (case-insensitive). Edit the existing location instead.' USING ERRCODE='23505';
    END IF;
    INSERT INTO public.lokasi_kantor(branch,alamat,latitude,longitude,radius_m,max_accuracy_m,status,updated_at)
    VALUES(btrim(p_branch),nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_alamat,'')),''),p_lat::double precision,p_lon::double precision,p_radius,p_max_accuracy,v_new_status,now());
    RETURN json_build_object('success',true,'message','Office location created.','branch',btrim(p_branch),'renamed',false);
  END IF;

  -- Resolve old spelling case-insensitively; fail closed if old duplicate spellings exist.
  SELECT count(*) INTO v_count FROM public.lokasi_kantor l
  WHERE upper(btrim(l.branch)) = upper(btrim(p_old_branch));
  IF v_count = 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'The existing branch could not be found. Refresh the location list and retry.' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
  IF v_count > 1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Several office locations differ only by letter case. Clean up duplicate locations before renaming.' USING ERRCODE='23505'; END IF;
  SELECT l.branch INTO v_current_branch FROM public.lokasi_kantor l
  WHERE upper(btrim(l.branch)) = upper(btrim(p_old_branch))
  ORDER BY (l.branch = p_old_branch) DESC, l.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE;
  v_is_rename := v_current_branch IS DISTINCT FROM btrim(p_branch);

  SELECT count(*) INTO v_count FROM public.lokasi_kantor l
  WHERE upper(btrim(l.branch)) = upper(btrim(p_branch))
    AND upper(btrim(l.branch)) <> upper(btrim(v_current_branch));
  IF v_count > 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Another office location already uses the requested branch name (case-insensitive).' USING ERRCODE='23505'; END IF;

  -- Detect schedule collisions before moving names so migration does not merge rules silently.
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.attendance_schedule_rules src
    JOIN public.attendance_schedule_rules dst
      ON src.id <> dst.id
     AND upper(btrim(dst.branch)) = upper(btrim(p_branch))
     AND src.day_of_week = dst.day_of_week
     AND src.effective_from = dst.effective_from
    WHERE upper(btrim(src.branch)) = upper(btrim(v_current_branch))
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'The new branch name would collide with existing shift rules. Resolve duplicate branch/day/effective-date rules first.' USING ERRCODE='23505';
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.attendance_calendar_overrides src
    JOIN public.attendance_calendar_overrides dst
      ON src.id <> dst.id
     AND upper(btrim(dst.scope_branch)) = upper(btrim(p_branch))
     AND src.calendar_date = dst.calendar_date
    WHERE src.scope_branch <> '*'
      AND upper(btrim(src.scope_branch)) = upper(btrim(v_current_branch))
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'The new branch name would collide with existing calendar overrides. Resolve duplicate dates first.' USING ERRCODE='23505';
  END IF;

  -- Keep employee branch data, shift rules, and branch-scoped calendar overrides aligned.
  UPDATE public.karyawan k SET branch = btrim(p_branch), updated_at = now()
  WHERE upper(btrim(coalesce(k.branch,''))) = upper(btrim(v_current_branch));

  UPDATE public.attendance_schedule_rules r SET branch = btrim(p_branch), updated_at = now()
  WHERE upper(btrim(r.branch)) = upper(btrim(v_current_branch));

  UPDATE public.attendance_calendar_overrides o SET scope_branch = btrim(p_branch), updated_at = now()
  WHERE o.scope_branch <> '*'
    AND upper(btrim(o.scope_branch)) = upper(btrim(v_current_branch));

  UPDATE public.lokasi_kantor l SET
    branch = btrim(p_branch), alamat = nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_alamat,'')),''),
    latitude = p_lat::double precision, longitude = p_lon::double precision,
    radius_m = p_radius, max_accuracy_m = p_max_accuracy,
    status = v_new_status, updated_at = now()
  WHERE l.branch = v_current_branch;

  RETURN json_build_object('success',true,'message',CASE WHEN v_is_rename THEN 'Office location updated and branch name changed.' ELSE 'Office location updated.' END,'branch',btrim(p_branch),'oldBranch',v_current_branch,'renamed',v_is_rename);
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.save_my_face(p_token text, p_descriptor double precision[], p_photo text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_my_face(p_token text, p_descriptor double precision[], p_photo text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_photo text := NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_photo,'')), '');
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF v_emp.employee_id IS NULL OR v_emp.status_akun <> 'AKTIF' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Active employee session required.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF p_descriptor IS NULL OR array_length(p_descriptor,1) <> 128 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'A valid 128-value face descriptor is required.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF v_photo IS NOT NULL AND (length(v_photo) > 1000000 OR v_photo !~* '^data:image/(jpeg|jpg|png|webp);base64,') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Profile photo must be a valid compressed image under 1 MB.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  UPDATE public.karyawan SET
    face = p_descriptor::public.vector,
    face_version = COALESCE(face_version,0) + 1,
    face_photo = COALESCE(v_photo, face_photo),
    face_photo_ver = COALESCE(face_photo_ver,0) + 1,
    face_updated_at = now(),
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE employee_id = v_emp.employee_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Employee profile was not found.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002'; END IF;
  RETURN json_build_object('success', true, 'message', 'Profile photo and Face ID updated.', 'facePhotoVer', COALESCE(v_emp.face_photo_ver,0) + 1);
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.session_karyawan(p_token text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.session_karyawan(p_token text)
 RETURNS karyawan
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_k karyawan;
begin
  if p_token is null or trim(p_token) = '' then
    raise exception 'Unauthorized';
  end if;

  select k.*
  into v_k
  from public.app_sessions s
  join public.karyawan k on k.employee_id = s.employee_id
  where s.token_hash = encode("extensions"."digest"(p_token, 'sha256'), 'hex')
    and s.revoked_at is null
    and s.expires_at > now()
    and k.status_akun = 'AKTIF';

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Sesi berakhir. Silakan login kembali.';
  end if;

  return v_k;
end;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.submit_attendance(p_token text, p_tipe text, p_lat double precision, p_lon double precision, p_acc double precision, p_descriptor double precision[], p_catatan text, p_address text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.submit_attendance(p_token text, p_tipe text, p_lat double precision, p_lon double precision, p_acc double precision, p_descriptor double precision[], p_catatan text DEFAULT ''::text, p_address text DEFAULT ''::text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_emp karyawan; v_office lokasi_kantor; v_threshold double precision;
  v_face_dist double precision; v_distance double precision; v_in_office boolean;
  v_status text; v_atasan text; v_id text; v_has_masuk boolean; v_has_pulang boolean;
  v_today date := (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::date;
  v_now time := (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::time;
begin
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  p_tipe := upper(trim(coalesce(p_tipe,'')));
  if p_tipe not in ('MASUK','PULANG') then raise exception 'Tipe absensi tidak valid.'; end if;
  if p_lat is null or p_lon is null then raise exception 'GPS belum tersedia.'; end if;
  if p_descriptor is null or array_length(p_descriptor,1) <> 128 then raise exception 'Face descriptor tidak valid.'; end if;
  if v_emp.face is null then raise exception 'Face ID belum terdaftar.'; end if;

  select coalesce(value::double precision,0.55) into v_threshold from public.settings where key='FACE_MATCH_THRESHOLD';
  v_face_dist := (p_descriptor::vector <-> v_emp.face);
  if v_face_dist > v_threshold then raise exception 'Wajah tidak cocok.'; end if;

  select * into v_office from public.lokasi_kantor
   where upper(btrim(branch)) = upper(btrim(v_emp.branch)) and status='AKTIF'
   order by (branch = v_emp.branch) desc, updated_at desc, branch
   limit 1;
  if not found then raise exception 'Lokasi kantor untuk branch % tidak ditemukan.', v_emp.branch; end if;
  if coalesce(p_acc,9999) > v_office.max_accuracy_m then
    raise exception 'Akurasi GPS terlalu rendah (% m). Maksimal % m.', round(p_acc), v_office.max_accuracy_m;
  end if;

  v_distance := public.haversine_m(p_lat,p_lon,v_office.latitude,v_office.longitude);
  v_in_office := v_distance <= v_office.radius_m;

  -- BARU: catatan wajib saat luar radius
  if not v_in_office and (p_catatan is null or trim(p_catatan)='') then
    raise exception 'Absen di luar radius wajib disertai catatan.';
  end if;

  select coalesce(bool_or(tipe='MASUK'),false), coalesce(bool_or(tipe='PULANG'),false)
  into v_has_masuk, v_has_pulang
  from public.absensi
  where employee_id=v_emp.employee_id and tanggal=v_today
    and status_approval not in ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR');

  if p_tipe='MASUK' and v_has_masuk then raise exception 'Sudah Clock In hari ini.'; end if;
  if p_tipe='PULANG' and v_has_pulang then raise exception 'Sudah Clock Out hari ini.'; end if;
  if p_tipe='PULANG' and not v_has_masuk then raise exception 'Anda belum Clock In.'; end if;

  if v_in_office then v_status:='VALID'; v_atasan:=null;
  else v_status:='PENDING_ATASAN'; v_atasan:=v_emp.approval_line_id; end if;

  v_id := 'ABS-' || to_char(timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') || '-' || v_emp.employee_id;
  insert into public.absensi(id,employee_id,tanggal,jam,timestamp,tipe,latitude,longitude,accuracy,address,catatan,branch_target,distance_m,status_approval,atasan_id,face_match,face_distance,face_local_precheck)
  values(v_id,v_emp.employee_id,v_today,v_now,now(),p_tipe,p_lat,p_lon,p_acc,p_address,p_catatan,v_office.branch,v_distance,v_status,v_atasan,true,v_face_dist,false);

  return json_build_object('success',true,'id',v_id,'inOffice',v_in_office,
    'message', case when v_status='VALID' then case when p_tipe='MASUK' then 'Clock In berhasil.' else 'Clock Out berhasil.' end
                 else 'Pengajuan presensi terkirim. Menunggu persetujuan.' end,
    'statusApproval',v_status,'tanggal',to_char(v_today,'YYYY-MM-DD'),'jam',to_char(v_now,'HH24:MI:SS'),'tipe',p_tipe);
end; $function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.submit_attendance(p_token text, p_tipe text, p_lat double precision, p_lon double precision, p_acc double precision, p_descriptor text, p_catatan text, p_address text, p_foto_base64 text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.submit_attendance(p_token text, p_tipe text, p_lat double precision, p_lon double precision, p_acc double precision, p_descriptor text, p_catatan text DEFAULT ''::text, p_address text DEFAULT ''::text, p_foto_base64 text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_emp            karyawan;
  v_branch         text;
  v_office         lokasi_kantor;
  v_pasuruan_office lokasi_kantor;
  v_pasuruan_distance double precision;
  v_threshold      double precision;
  v_face_dist      double precision;
  v_distance       double precision;
  v_in_office      boolean;
  v_status         text;
  v_atasan         text;
  v_id             text;
  v_has_masuk      boolean;
  v_has_pulang     boolean;
  v_prior_in_status text;
  v_prior_in_manager text;
  v_prior_in_requires_approval boolean := false;
  v_approval_required boolean := false;
  v_desc_arr       double precision[];
  v_today          date := (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::date;
  v_now            time := (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::time;
begin
  -- ===== AUTH =====
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);

  -- ===== VALIDASI DASAR =====
  p_tipe := upper(trim(coalesce(p_tipe,'')));
  if p_tipe not in ('MASUK','PULANG') then
    raise exception 'Tipe absensi tidak valid.';
  end if;
  if p_lat is null or p_lon is null then
    raise exception 'GPS belum tersedia.';
  end if;

  -- ===== FIX 1: PARSE FACE DESCRIPTOR DARI TEXT =====
  if p_descriptor is null or trim(p_descriptor) = '' then
    raise exception 'Face descriptor tidak valid.';
  end if;

  -- Handle JSON array "[0.1, 0.2, ...]" ATAU PostgreSQL array "{0.1, 0.2, ...}"
  if left(trim(p_descriptor), 1) = '[' then
    v_desc_arr := translate(trim(p_descriptor), '[]', '{}')::double precision[];
  elsif left(trim(p_descriptor), 1) = '{' then
    v_desc_arr := p_descriptor::double precision[];
  else
    raise exception 'Format face descriptor tidak dikenali.';
  end if;

  if array_length(v_desc_arr, 1) <> 128 then
    raise exception 'Face descriptor harus 128 angka.';
  end if;

  if v_emp.face is null then
    raise exception 'Face ID belum terdaftar.';
  end if;

  -- ===== FACE MATCHING =====
  select coalesce(value::double precision, 0.55)
    into v_threshold
    from public.settings
   where key = 'FACE_MATCH_THRESHOLD';

  v_face_dist := (v_desc_arr::vector <-> v_emp.face);

  if v_face_dist > v_threshold then
    raise exception 'Wajah tidak cocok. Jarak: %.', round(v_face_dist::numeric, 3);
  end if;

  -- ===== LOKASI KANTOR BERDASARKAN MUTASI CABANG EFEKTIF =====
  -- Keep the geofence target aligned with the same branch-history resolver used
  -- by attendance snapshot triggers and the day-off attendance path.
  SELECT h.branch INTO v_branch
  FROM public.attendance_employee_branch_history h
  WHERE h.employee_id = v_emp.employee_id
    AND h.effective_from <= v_today
    AND (h.effective_to IS NULL OR h.effective_to >= v_today)
  ORDER BY h.effective_from DESC
  LIMIT 1;
  v_branch := COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(v_branch), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(v_emp.branch), ''), 'Pusat');

  select * into v_office
    from public.lokasi_kantor
   where upper(btrim(branch)) = upper(btrim(v_branch)) and status = 'AKTIF'
   order by (branch = v_branch) desc, updated_at desc, branch
   limit 1;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Lokasi kantor untuk branch % tidak ditemukan.', v_branch;
  end if;

  v_distance  := public.haversine_m(p_lat, p_lon, v_office.latitude, v_office.longitude);
  v_in_office := v_distance <= v_office.radius_m;

  -- PM may also clock in/out at the active Pasuruan office. The employee's
  -- own branch remains the primary location; Pasuruan is an additional option.
  -- Selecting it here makes branch_target and server-side geofence validation
  -- agree, so an in-radius Pasuruan event is stored as VALID (not pending).
  IF upper(coalesce(v_emp.job_code,'')) = 'PM' THEN
    SELECT * INTO v_pasuruan_office
    FROM public.lokasi_kantor
    WHERE lower(btrim(branch)) = 'pasuruan'
      AND status = 'AKTIF'
    ORDER BY updated_at DESC, branch
    LIMIT 1;

    IF FOUND THEN
      v_pasuruan_distance := public.haversine_m(
        p_lat, p_lon, v_pasuruan_office.latitude, v_pasuruan_office.longitude
      );
      IF v_pasuruan_distance <= v_pasuruan_office.radius_m
         AND (NOT v_in_office OR v_pasuruan_distance < v_distance) THEN
        v_office := v_pasuruan_office;
        v_distance := v_pasuruan_distance;
        v_in_office := TRUE;
      END IF;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF coalesce(p_acc, 9999) > v_office.max_accuracy_m THEN
    raise exception 'Akurasi GPS terlalu rendah (% m). Maksimal % m.',
      round(p_acc), v_office.max_accuracy_m;
  end if;

  if not v_in_office and (p_catatan is null or trim(p_catatan) = '') then
    raise exception 'Absen di luar radius wajib disertai catatan.';
  end if;

  -- ===== CEK DUPLIKASI =====
  select coalesce(bool_or(tipe='MASUK'), false),
         coalesce(bool_or(tipe='PULANG'), false)
    into v_has_masuk, v_has_pulang
    from public.absensi
   where employee_id = v_emp.employee_id
     and tanggal     = v_today
     and status_approval not in ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR');

  if p_tipe = 'MASUK'  and v_has_masuk  then raise exception 'Sudah Clock In hari ini.';  end if;
  if p_tipe = 'PULANG' and v_has_pulang then raise exception 'Sudah Clock Out hari ini.'; end if;

  -- ===== STATUS APPROVAL =====
  -- Clock Out follows Clock In when the latter is still waiting for approval,
  -- even when Clock Out itself is inside the geofence. This keeps the day coherent.
  v_prior_in_status := NULL;
  v_prior_in_manager := NULL;
  IF p_tipe='PULANG' THEN
    SELECT a.status_approval, a.atasan_id, (COALESCE(a.approval_required,false) OR COALESCE(a.outside_location,false) OR a.approval_manager_at IS NOT NULL OR a.approval_hr_at IS NOT NULL OR a.status_approval IN ('PENDING_ATASAN','PENDING_HR'))
      INTO v_prior_in_status, v_prior_in_manager, v_prior_in_requires_approval
    FROM public.absensi a
    WHERE a.employee_id=v_emp.employee_id AND a.tanggal=v_today AND a.tipe='MASUK'
      AND a.status_approval NOT IN ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR')
    ORDER BY a.jam DESC, a.timestamp DESC LIMIT 1;
  END IF;
  IF p_tipe='PULANG' AND v_prior_in_requires_approval THEN
    v_status := CASE WHEN v_prior_in_status IN ('PENDING_ATASAN','PENDING_HR') THEN v_prior_in_status ELSE 'PENDING_ATASAN' END;
    v_atasan := COALESCE(v_prior_in_manager, v_emp.approval_line_id);
    v_approval_required := TRUE;
  ELSIF v_in_office THEN
    v_status := 'VALID'; v_atasan := null;
  ELSE
    v_status := 'PENDING_ATASAN'; v_atasan := v_emp.approval_line_id;
    v_approval_required := TRUE;
  END IF;

  -- ===== FIX 2 & 3: INSERT + FOTO SEKALIGUS =====
  v_id := 'ABS-' || to_char(timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
       || '-' || v_emp.employee_id;

  insert into public.absensi(
    id, employee_id, tanggal, jam, timestamp, tipe,
    latitude, longitude, accuracy, address, catatan,
    branch_target, distance_m, status_approval, atasan_id,
    face_match, face_distance, face_local_precheck, approval_required,
    foto_url                                    -- ← foto base64 disimpan di sini
  ) values (
    v_id, v_emp.employee_id, v_today, v_now, now(), p_tipe,
    p_lat, p_lon, p_acc, p_address, p_catatan,
    v_office.branch, v_distance, v_status, v_atasan,
    true, v_face_dist, false, v_approval_required,
    p_foto_base64                               -- ← langsung tersimpan, TIDAK ada race condition
  );

  return json_build_object(
    'success',        true,
    'id',             v_id,
    'inOffice',       v_in_office,
    'message',        case
                        when v_status = 'VALID' then
                          case when p_tipe='MASUK' then 'Clock In berhasil.'
                               else 'Clock Out berhasil.' end
                        else 'Pengajuan presensi terkirim. Menunggu persetujuan.'
                      end,
    'statusApproval', v_status,
    'tanggal',        to_char(v_today, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
    'jam',            to_char(v_now, 'HH24:MI:SS'),
    'tipe',           p_tipe
  );
end;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.submit_cuti(p_token text, p_kode text, p_mulai date, p_selesai date, p_alasan text, p_dokumen text, p_delegate_to text, p_sakit_dinas_luar boolean, p_sakit_area text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.submit_cuti(p_token text, p_kode text, p_mulai date, p_selesai date, p_alasan text, p_dokumen text, p_delegate_to text, p_sakit_dinas_luar boolean, p_sakit_area text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_master public.master_cuti;
  v_id text;
  v_days integer;
  v_year integer;
  v_sisa integer;
  v_delegate text := NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_delegate_to, '')), '');
  v_sick_outside boolean := COALESCE(p_sakit_dinas_luar,false);
  v_sick_area text := NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_sakit_area,'')), '');
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role, '')) = 'ADMIN' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Administrator role is view-only. Contact Superadmin for changes.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF p_mulai IS NULL OR p_selesai IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Please select the start and end dates.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_selesai < p_mulai THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'The end date cannot be earlier than the start date.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_alasan, '')), '') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'A reason is required.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_master
  FROM public.master_cuti
  WHERE kode = UPPER(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_kode, '')))
    AND status = 'AKTIF';
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'The selected time-off type is not active.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF v_master.kode <> 'SDR' AND (v_sick_outside OR v_sick_area IS NOT NULL) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sick overseas-duty fields are only valid for SDR.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF v_master.kode = 'SDR' AND v_sick_outside AND (v_sick_area IS NULL OR v_sick_area NOT IN ('Area 1','Area 2','Area 3','Area 4','Area lainnya')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Choose a valid outside-duty area for SDR.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF v_master.kode = 'SDR' AND NOT v_sick_outside THEN
    v_sick_area := NULL;
  END IF;

  v_days := p_selesai - p_mulai + 1;
  v_year := EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p_mulai)::integer;

  IF v_delegate IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF v_delegate = v_emp.employee_id THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Choose another employee as delegate, or select No delegate.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;
    PERFORM 1 FROM public.karyawan k
    WHERE k.employee_id = v_delegate AND k.status_akun = 'AKTIF';
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'The selected delegate is not an active ReHolz employee.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF v_master.kode = 'CT' THEN
    SELECT s.sisa INTO v_sisa
    FROM public.sisa_cuti s
    WHERE s.employee_id = v_emp.employee_id
      AND s.tahun = v_year
      AND s.kode_cuti = 'CT';
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      v_sisa := COALESCE(public.hris_calculate_remaining_leave(v_emp.employee_id, v_year, 'CT'), 0);
    END IF;
    IF v_sisa < v_days THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Insufficient annual time-off balance (remaining: % days).', v_sisa USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  v_id := 'CT-' || to_char(clock_timestamp(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSMS') || '-' || v_emp.employee_id;
  INSERT INTO public.pengajuan_cuti (
    id, employee_id, nama, kode_cuti, keterangan_cuti,
    tanggal_mulai, tanggal_selesai, total_hari, alasan, dokumen_path,
    delegate_to, status_atasan, status_hr, dinas_luar_sakit, area_sakit
  ) VALUES (
    v_id, v_emp.employee_id, v_emp.nama, v_master.kode, v_master.keterangan,
    p_mulai, p_selesai, v_days, BTRIM(p_alasan), p_dokumen,
    v_delegate,
    CASE WHEN v_emp.approval_line_id IS NULL THEN 'DISETUJUI' ELSE 'PENDING' END,
    'PENDING',
    CASE WHEN v_master.kode='SDR' THEN v_sick_outside ELSE false END,
    CASE WHEN v_master.kode='SDR' AND v_sick_outside THEN v_sick_area ELSE NULL END
  );

  RETURN json_build_object('success', true, 'message', 'Time-off request submitted successfully.', 'id', v_id);
END;
$function$


;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- public.submit_dayoff_attendance_with_photo(p_token text, p_tipe text, p_lat double precision, p_lon double precision, p_acc double precision, p_descriptor text, p_catatan text, p_address text, p_foto_base64 text, p_attendance_mode text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.submit_dayoff_attendance_with_photo(p_token text, p_tipe text, p_lat double precision, p_lon double precision, p_acc double precision, p_descriptor text, p_catatan text, p_address text, p_foto_base64 text, p_attendance_mode text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_mode text := upper(coalesce(p_attendance_mode,''));
  v_today date := (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::date;
  v_branch text;
  v_office public.lokasi_kantor%ROWTYPE;
  v_pasuruan_office public.lokasi_kantor%ROWTYPE;
  v_pasuruan_distance double precision;
  v_distance double precision;
  v_outside boolean;
  v_area_marker text;
  v_clean_note text;
  v_submit_note text;
  v_result json;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF substring(coalesce(p_catatan,'') FROM '\[\[RHAREA=SBY\]\]') IS NOT NULL AND v_mode <> 'PIKET' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Surabaya & Sekitarnya is not a Standby / Dinas Luar category.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF upper(coalesce(p_tipe,'')) <> 'MASUK' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Mode Piket/Standby hanya berlaku untuk Clock In.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF v_mode NOT IN ('PIKET','STANDBY') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Mode hari libur tidak valid.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_lat IS NULL OR p_lon IS NULL OR p_descriptor IS NULL OR p_acc IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'GPS dan verifikasi Face ID wajib tersedia.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  SELECT h.branch INTO v_branch
  FROM public.attendance_employee_branch_history h
  WHERE h.employee_id = v_emp.employee_id
    AND h.effective_from <= v_today
    AND (h.effective_to IS NULL OR h.effective_to >= v_today)
  ORDER BY h.effective_from DESC LIMIT 1;
  v_branch := coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_branch),''), nullif(btrim(v_emp.branch),''));
  SELECT * INTO v_office
  FROM public.lokasi_kantor l
  WHERE upper(btrim(l.branch)) = upper(btrim(coalesce(v_branch,'')))
    AND l.status = 'AKTIF'
  ORDER BY (l.branch = v_branch) DESC, l.updated_at DESC, l.branch
  LIMIT 1;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Lokasi kantor aktif untuk branch % tidak ditemukan.', v_branch USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  v_distance := public.haversine_m(p_lat, p_lon, v_office.latitude, v_office.longitude);
  v_outside := v_distance > v_office.radius_m;

  -- PM's Pasuruan office is treated as an ordinary office for day-off mode too.
  IF upper(coalesce(v_emp.job_code,'')) = 'PM' THEN
    SELECT * INTO v_pasuruan_office
    FROM public.lokasi_kantor l
    WHERE lower(btrim(l.branch))='pasuruan' AND l.status='AKTIF'
    ORDER BY l.updated_at DESC,l.branch
    LIMIT 1;
    IF FOUND THEN
      v_pasuruan_distance := public.haversine_m(
        p_lat,p_lon,v_pasuruan_office.latitude,v_pasuruan_office.longitude
      );
      IF v_pasuruan_distance <= v_pasuruan_office.radius_m
         AND (v_outside OR v_pasuruan_distance < v_distance) THEN
        v_office := v_pasuruan_office;
        v_distance := v_pasuruan_distance;
        v_outside := FALSE;
      END IF;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF coalesce(p_acc,9999) > v_office.max_accuracy_m THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Akurasi GPS terlalu rendah (% m). Maksimal % m.', round(p_acc), v_office.max_accuracy_m USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  v_area_marker := substring(coalesce(p_catatan,'') FROM '\[\[RHAREA=(A1|A2|A3|A4|AX|SBY)\]\]');

  IF v_mode = 'STANDBY' AND NOT v_outside THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Standby hanya berlaku untuk karyawan yang dinas luar Area 1–5.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF v_mode = 'PIKET' AND v_outside AND v_area_marker IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Piket dinas luar wajib memilih Area 1–5.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF v_mode = 'PIKET' AND NOT v_outside AND v_area_marker IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Piket kantor tidak boleh memilih area dinas luar.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  -- Strip only the untrusted RHATT marker before insert. Keep RHAREA in the
  -- submitted note so the existing area-validation trigger can parse it.
  v_submit_note := btrim(regexp_replace(coalesce(p_catatan,''),
    '[[:space:]]*\[\[RHATT=(P[1-5]?|SDL[1-5]|SDLL|DL[1-5])\]\][[:space:]]*', ' ', 'gi'));
  v_clean_note := btrim(regexp_replace(coalesce(v_submit_note,''),
    '[[:space:]]*\[\[RHAREA=(A1|A2|A3|A4|AX|SBY)\]\][[:space:]]*', ' ', 'gi'));
  IF v_outside AND nullif(v_clean_note,'') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Keterangan wajib diisi untuk Piket/Standby di luar kantor.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('app.reholz_dayoff_mode', v_mode, true);
  v_result := public.submit_attendance_with_photo(
    p_token, 'MASUK', p_lat, p_lon, p_acc, p_descriptor, v_submit_note, coalesce(p_address,''), p_foto_base64
  );
  PERFORM set_config('app.reholz_dayoff_mode', '', true);
  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$


;
