--
-- Name: get_riwayat_kehadiran(text, integer, integer); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.get_riwayat_kehadiran(p_token text, p_year integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_month integer DEFAULT NULL::integer) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_emp karyawan;
  v_year int;
  v_month int;
  v_start date;
  v_end date;
  v_out json;
begin
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);

  v_year := coalesce(
    nullif(p_year, 0),
    extract(year from (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::date)::int
  );

  v_month := coalesce(
    nullif(p_month, 0),
    extract(month from (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::date)::int
  );

  if v_month < 1 or v_month > 12 then
    raise exception 'Bulan tidak valid.';
  end if;

  v_start := make_date(v_year, v_month, 1);
  v_end := (v_start + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')::date;

  select coalesce(
    json_agg(
      json_build_object(
        'tanggal', to_char(d.tanggal, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
        'status', case
          when m.obj is not null and p.obj is not null then 'HADIR'
          when m.obj is not null then 'BELUM CLOCK OUT'
          else 'BELUM LENGKAP'
        end,
        'masuk', m.obj,
        'pulang', p.obj
      )
      order by d.tanggal desc
    ),
    '[]'::json
  )
  into v_out
  from (
    select distinct a.tanggal
    from public.absensi a
    where a.employee_id = v_emp.employee_id
      and a.tanggal between v_start and v_end
      and a.status_approval not in ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR')
  ) d
  left join lateral (
    select public.absensi_to_json(a) as obj
    from public.absensi a
    where a.employee_id = v_emp.employee_id
      and a.tanggal = d.tanggal
      and a.tipe = 'MASUK'
      and a.status_approval not in ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR')
    order by a.timestamp desc
    limit 1
  ) m on true
  left join lateral (
    select public.absensi_to_json(a) as obj
    from public.absensi a
    where a.employee_id = v_emp.employee_id
      and a.tanggal = d.tanggal
      and a.tipe = 'PULANG'
      and a.status_approval not in ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR')
    order by a.timestamp desc
    limit 1
  ) p on true;

  return v_out;
end;
$$;


--
-- Name: get_sisa_cuti(text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.get_sisa_cuti(p_token text, p_kode text DEFAULT 'CT'::text) RETURNS integer
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_code text := COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_kode, ''))), ''), 'CT');
  v_year integer := EXTRACT(YEAR FROM (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta')::date)::integer;
  v_sisa integer;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  SELECT s.sisa INTO v_sisa
  FROM public.sisa_cuti s
  WHERE s.employee_id = v_emp.employee_id AND s.tahun = v_year AND s.kode_cuti = v_code;
  IF FOUND THEN RETURN v_sisa; END IF;
  RETURN COALESCE(public.hris_calculate_remaining_leave(v_emp.employee_id, v_year, v_code), 0);
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: get_status_hari_ini(text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.get_status_hari_ini(p_token text) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_emp karyawan;
  v_status json;
  v_today date := (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::date;
begin
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);

  select json_build_object(
    'masuk', coalesce(bool_or(tipe = 'MASUK'), false),
    'pulang', coalesce(bool_or(tipe = 'PULANG'), false),
    'jamMasuk', coalesce(max(case when tipe = 'MASUK' then to_char(jam, 'HH24:MI:SS') end), ''),
    'jamPulang', coalesce(max(case when tipe = 'PULANG' then to_char(jam, 'HH24:MI:SS') end), ''),
    'statusApproval', coalesce(max(status_approval), 'VALID')
  )
  into v_status
  from public.absensi
  where employee_id = v_emp.employee_id
    and tanggal = v_today
    and status_approval not in ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR');

  return v_status;
end;
$$;


--
-- Name: get_team_activity(text, date); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.get_team_activity(p_token text, p_date date DEFAULT NULL::date) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare v_emp karyawan; v_date date; v_out json;
begin
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  v_date := coalesce(p_date, (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::date);

  select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
    'nik', s.employee_id, 'nama', s.nama, 'posisi', s.job_position, 'org', s.organization,
    'faceVer', s.fver, 'clockIn', a.jin, 'clockOut', a.jout, 'status', a.st
  ) order by s.nama),'[]'::json) into v_out
  from (
    select k.employee_id, k.nama, k.job_position, k.organization, coalesce(k.face_photo_ver,0) as fver
    from public.karyawan k
    where k.approval_line_id = v_emp.employee_id
      and k.status_akun = 'AKTIF'
  ) s
  left join lateral (
    select max(case when tipe='MASUK' then to_char(jam,'HH24:MI:SS') end) as jin,
           max(case when tipe='PULANG' then to_char(jam,'HH24:MI:SS') end) as jout,
           case when bool_or(tipe='MASUK') and bool_or(tipe='PULANG') then 'HADIR'
                when bool_or(tipe='MASUK') then 'BELUM CLOCK OUT'
                else 'BELUM CLOCK IN' end as st
    from public.absensi a
    where a.employee_id = s.employee_id
      and a.tanggal = v_date
      and a.status_approval not in ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR')
  ) a on true;

  return json_build_object('success',true,'tanggal',to_char(v_date,'YYYY-MM-DD'),'list',v_out);
end; $$;


--
-- Name: grant_face_registration(text, text, integer); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.grant_face_registration(p_token text, p_employee_id text, p_duration_minutes integer) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare v_emp karyawan; v_target karyawan;
begin
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,'')) <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Superadmin can perform this action.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  select * into v_target from karyawan where employee_id = p_employee_id;
  if not found then raise exception 'Karyawan tidak ditemukan.'; end if;
  if v_target.face is not null then raise exception 'Karyawan sudah punya Face ID. Reset dulu.'; end if;
  
  insert into face_sessions(employee_id, granted_by, expires_at)
  values (p_employee_id, v_emp.employee_id, now() + (p_duration_minutes || ' minutes')::interval);
  
  return json_build_object('success', true, 'message', 'Akses registrasi diberikan selama ' || p_duration_minutes || ' menit.');
end; $$;


--
-- Name: grant_mass_face_registration(text, integer); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.grant_mass_face_registration(p_token text, p_duration_minutes integer) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare v_emp karyawan; v_count int;
begin
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,'')) <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Superadmin can perform this action.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  
  insert into face_sessions(employee_id, granted_by, expires_at)
  select employee_id, v_emp.employee_id, now() + (p_duration_minutes || ' minutes')::interval
  from karyawan where face is null and status_akun = 'AKTIF';
  
  get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
  return json_build_object('success', true, 'message', v_count || ' akses registrasi massal diberikan.');
end; $$;


--
-- Name: haversine_m(double precision, double precision, double precision, double precision); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.haversine_m(lat1 double precision, lon1 double precision, lat2 double precision, lon2 double precision) RETURNS double precision
    LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE
    AS $$
  select 6371000 * 2 * asin(
    sqrt(
      power(sin(radians(lat2 - lat1) / 2), 2)
      +
      cos(radians(lat1)) * cos(radians(lat2)) *
      power(sin(radians(lon2 - lon1) / 2), 2)
    )
  );
$$;


--
-- Name: hr_add_karyawan(text, text, text, text, text, text, text, text, text, text, text, date, text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hr_add_karyawan(p_token text, p_nik text, p_nama text, p_branch text, p_org text, p_level text, p_pos text, p_grade text, p_class text, p_status_kerja text, p_atasan_id text, p_join_date date, p_role text, p_pin text) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare v_emp karyawan; v_pin_final text; v_atasan_nama text; v_role text;
begin
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,'')) <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Superadmin can add employees.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  v_role := UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_role),''),'KARYAWAN'));
  IF v_role NOT IN ('KARYAWAN','ADMIN','SUPERADMIN') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid role.' USING ERRCODE = '22023'; END IF;
  if p_nik is null or trim(p_nik)='' then raise exception 'NIK wajib diisi.'; end if;
  if p_nama is null or trim(p_nama)='' then raise exception 'Nama wajib diisi.'; end if;
  if exists(select 1 from public.karyawan where employee_id=p_nik) then
    raise exception 'NIK % sudah terdaftar.', p_nik;
  end if;
  v_pin_final := coalesce(nullif(trim(p_pin),''), lpad((floor(random()*1000000))::text,6,'0'));
  select nama into v_atasan_nama from public.karyawan where employee_id=p_atasan_id;
  insert into public.karyawan(
    employee_id, nama, branch, organization, job_level, job_position, grade, class,
    employment_status, approval_line_id, approval_line_name, join_date, role, pin_hash, status_akun
  ) values (
    p_nik, p_nama, p_branch, p_org, p_level, p_pos, p_grade, p_class,
    p_status_kerja, p_atasan_id, v_atasan_nama, p_join_date,
    v_role,
    "extensions"."crypt"(v_pin_final, "extensions"."gen_salt"('bf')),
    'AKTIF'
  );
  return json_build_object('success',true,'message','Karyawan berhasil ditambahkan.','pin',v_pin_final,'nik',p_nik);
end; $$;


--
-- Name: hr_attendance_recap(text, integer, integer); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hr_attendance_recap(p_token text, p_year integer, p_month integer) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_start date;
  v_end date;
  v_workdays int;
  v_out json;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);

  IF v_emp.role NOT IN ('HR', 'ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Akses ditolak.';
  END IF;

  IF p_year NOT BETWEEN 2000 AND 2100
     OR p_month NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 12 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tahun atau bulan tidak valid.';
  END IF;

  v_start := make_date(p_year, p_month, 1);
  v_end := (v_start + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date;

  SELECT count(*)
  INTO v_workdays
  FROM generate_series(
    v_start, v_end, interval '1 day'
  ) AS g(d)
  WHERE extract(isodow FROM g.d) < 6;

  WITH daily AS (
    SELECT
      a.employee_id,
      a.tanggal,
      bool_or(a.tipe = 'MASUK') AS masuk,
      bool_or(a.tipe = 'PULANG') AS pulang
    FROM public.absensi a
    WHERE a.tanggal BETWEEN v_start AND v_end
      AND a.status_approval IN (
        'VALID', 'DISETUJUI',
        'PENDING_ATASAN', 'PENDING_HR'
      )
    GROUP BY a.employee_id, a.tanggal
  ),
  attendance AS (
    SELECT
      employee_id,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE masuk)::int AS hadir,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE masuk AND pulang)::int AS lengkap
    FROM daily
    GROUP BY employee_id
  ),
  employees AS (
    SELECT
      k.employee_id AS nik,
      k.nama,
      coalesce(k.organization, '-') AS bagian,
      coalesce(a.hadir, 0) AS hadir,
      coalesce(a.lengkap, 0) AS lengkap,
      coalesce(c.cuti, 0) AS cuti
    FROM public.karyawan k
    LEFT JOIN attendance a
      ON a.employee_id = k.employee_id
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT coalesce(sum(pc.total_hari), 0)::int AS cuti
      FROM public.pengajuan_cuti pc
      WHERE pc.employee_id = k.employee_id
        AND pc.status_atasan = 'DISETUJUI'
        AND pc.status_hr = 'DISETUJUI'
        AND pc.tanggal_mulai <= v_end
        AND pc.tanggal_selesai >= v_start
    ) c ON true
    WHERE k.status_akun = 'AKTIF'
  )
  SELECT coalesce(
    json_agg(
      json_build_object(
        'nik', nik,
        'nama', nama,
        'bagian', bagian,
        'hariKerja', v_workdays,
        'hadir', hadir,
        'lengkap', lengkap,
        'cuti', cuti,
        'alpha', greatest(v_workdays - hadir - cuti, 0),
        'persen',
          CASE
            WHEN v_workdays > 0
            THEN round(hadir::numeric * 100 / v_workdays)
            ELSE 0
          END
      )
      ORDER BY nama
    ),
    '[]'::json
  )
  INTO v_out
  FROM employees;

  RETURN json_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'tahun', p_year,
    'bulan', p_month,
    'hariKerja', v_workdays,
    'list', v_out
  );
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: hr_attendance_today(text, date); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hr_attendance_today(p_token text, p_date date DEFAULT NULL::date) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE v_emp public.karyawan; v_d date; v_list json; v_total int; v_hadir int; v_is_admin boolean;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  v_is_admin := UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,'')) IN ('HR','ADMIN','SUPERADMIN');
  IF NOT v_is_admin AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.karyawan b WHERE b.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id AND b.status_akun='AKTIF') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Akses ditolak.' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  v_d := COALESCE(p_date,(timezone('Asia/Jakarta',now()))::date);
  SELECT count(*) INTO v_total FROM public.karyawan k WHERE k.status_akun='AKTIF' AND (v_is_admin OR k.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id);
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.nama),'[]'::json) INTO v_list
  FROM (
    SELECT k.employee_id AS nik,k.nama,
      min(CASE WHEN a.tipe='MASUK' THEN to_char(a.jam,'HH24:MI') END) AS "jamMasuk",
      max(CASE WHEN a.tipe='PULANG' THEN to_char(a.jam,'HH24:MI') END) AS "jamPulang",
      CASE WHEN bool_or(a.tipe='MASUK') AND bool_or(a.tipe='PULANG') THEN 'HADIR'
           WHEN bool_or(a.tipe='MASUK') THEN 'BELUM_PULANG' ELSE 'BELUM_HADIR' END AS status
    FROM public.karyawan k
    LEFT JOIN public.absensi a ON a.employee_id=k.employee_id AND a.tanggal=v_d
      AND a.status_approval IN ('VALID','DISETUJUI','PENDING_ATASAN','PENDING_HR')
    WHERE k.status_akun='AKTIF' AND (v_is_admin OR k.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id)
    GROUP BY k.employee_id,k.nama
  ) x;
  SELECT count(*) INTO v_hadir FROM json_array_elements(v_list) e WHERE e->>'status' IN ('HADIR','BELUM_PULANG');
  RETURN json_build_object('ok',true,'tanggal',to_char(v_d,'YYYY-MM-DD'),'total',v_total,'hadir',v_hadir,'list',v_list);
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: hr_attendance_week(text, date); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hr_attendance_week(p_token text, p_end date DEFAULT NULL::date) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_end date;
  v_days json;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);

  IF v_emp.role NOT IN ('HR', 'ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Akses ditolak.';
  END IF;

  v_end := COALESCE(
    p_end,
    (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::date
  );

  SELECT COALESCE(
    json_agg(
      json_build_object(
        'label', to_char(d, 'Dy DD/MM'),
        'tanggal', to_char(d, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
        'hadir', COALESCE(x.n, 0)
      )
      ORDER BY d
    ),
    '[]'::json
  )
  INTO v_days
  FROM generate_series(
    v_end - 6,
    v_end,
    interval '1 day'
  ) d
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT count(DISTINCT a.employee_id) AS n
    FROM public.absensi a
    WHERE a.tanggal = d
      AND a.tipe = 'MASUK'
      AND a.status_approval IN (
        'VALID', 'DISETUJUI',
        'PENDING_ATASAN', 'PENDING_HR'
      )
  ) x ON true;

  RETURN json_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'days', v_days
  );
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: hr_contract_expiring(text, integer); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hr_contract_expiring(p_token text, p_days integer DEFAULT 60) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_out json;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);

  IF v_emp.role NOT IN ('HR', 'ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Akses ditolak.';
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(
    json_agg(
      json_build_object(
        'nik', k.employee_id,
        'nama', k.nama,
        'bagian', k.organization,
        'contractEnd', to_char(k.contract_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
      )
      ORDER BY k.contract_end_date
    ),
    '[]'::json
  )
  INTO v_out
  FROM public.karyawan k
  WHERE k.status_akun = 'AKTIF'
    AND k.contract_end_date IS NOT NULL
    AND k.contract_end_date BETWEEN
      (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::date
      AND (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::date
          + COALESCE(p_days, 60);

  RETURN json_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'list', v_out
  );
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: hr_deactivate_karyawan(text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hr_deactivate_karyawan(p_token text, p_nik text) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare v_emp karyawan;
begin
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,'')) <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Superadmin can perform this action.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  if v_emp.employee_id = p_nik then raise exception 'Tidak dapat menonaktifkan akun sendiri.'; end if;
  update public.karyawan set status_akun='NONAKTIF' where employee_id=p_nik;
  return json_build_object('success',true,'message','Karyawan dinonaktifkan.');
end; $$;


--
-- Name: hr_delete_employee_doc(text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hr_delete_employee_doc(p_token text, p_id text) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_employee_id text;
  v_filename text;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);

  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,'')) <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Superadmin can perform this action.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;

  DELETE FROM public.employee_documents
  WHERE id = p_id
  RETURNING employee_id, filename
  INTO v_employee_id, v_filename;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Dokumen tidak ditemukan.';
  END IF;

  PERFORM public.log_activity(
    p_token,
    'DELETE',
    'KARYAWAN',
    v_employee_id,
    'Hapus dokumen ' || COALESCE(v_filename, p_id)
  );

  RETURN json_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'message', 'Dokumen dihapus.'
  );
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: hr_get_activity_log(text, text, text, text, date, date, integer); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hr_get_activity_log(p_token text, p_q text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_module text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_status text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_limit integer DEFAULT 200) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_out json;
  v_limit integer;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF upper(coalesce(v_emp.role, '')) NOT IN ('HR', 'ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Akses ditolak.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF p_from IS NOT NULL AND p_to IS NOT NULL AND p_from > p_to THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tanggal awal tidak boleh melewati tanggal akhir.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  v_limit := greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit, 200), 500));

  WITH combined AS (
    SELECT
      l.created_at,
      l.employee_id,
      l.nama,
      l.role,
      l.action AS aktivitas,
      l.module AS modul,
      l.target,
      l.detail,
      l.status
    FROM public.activity_log l
    WHERE upper(btrim(coalesce(l.module, ''))) NOT IN
      ('LAPORAN', 'REPORT', 'REPORTING', 'PROSES LAPORAN', 'PROSES_LAPORAN')

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
      al.timestamp AS created_at,
      al.actor_id AS employee_id,
      coalesce(actor.nama, al.actor_id) AS nama,
      al.actor_role AS role,
      CASE al.action_type
        WHEN 'REIMBURSEMENT_SUBMIT' THEN 'Pengajuan Reimbursement'
        WHEN 'REIMBURSEMENT_MANAGER_APPROVE' THEN 'Persetujuan Atasan Reimbursement'
        WHEN 'REIMBURSEMENT_MANAGER_REJECT' THEN 'Penolakan Atasan Reimbursement'
        WHEN 'REIMBURSEMENT_SUPERADMIN_APPROVE' THEN 'Persetujuan Superadmin Reimbursement'
        WHEN 'REIMBURSEMENT_SUPERADMIN_REJECT' THEN 'Penolakan Superadmin Reimbursement'
        ELSE 'Aktivitas Reimbursement'
      END AS aktivitas,
      'REIMBURSEMENT'::text AS modul,
      concat_ws(' · ', coalesce(owner.nama, r.employee_id, al.target_nik), al.target_id) AS target,
      concat_ws(' · ',
        CASE r.category WHEN 'ENTERTAIN' THEN 'Entertainment'
                        WHEN 'TRANSPORT' THEN 'Transport'
                        ELSE 'Reimbursement' END,
        CASE WHEN r.request_date IS NOT NULL
          THEN 'Tanggal: ' || to_char(r.request_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') END,
        CASE WHEN r.amount IS NOT NULL
          THEN 'Nominal: Rp ' || to_char(r.amount, 'FM999G999G999G990D00') END,
        CASE WHEN r.period_start IS NOT NULL AND r.period_end IS NOT NULL
          THEN 'Periode: ' || to_char(r.period_start, 'DD/MM/YYYY') || '–' || to_char(r.period_end, 'DD/MM/YYYY') END,
        'Status: ' || coalesce(al.status, r.status, '—'),
        nullif(btrim(coalesce(al.alasan, '')), '')
      ) AS detail,
      'SUCCESS'::text AS status
    FROM public.approval_log al
    LEFT JOIN public.hr_reimbursement_requests r ON r.id = al.target_id
    LEFT JOIN public.karyawan owner ON owner.employee_id = coalesce(r.employee_id, al.target_nik)
    LEFT JOIN public.karyawan actor ON actor.employee_id = al.actor_id
    WHERE al.action_type IN (
      'REIMBURSEMENT_SUBMIT',
      'REIMBURSEMENT_MANAGER_APPROVE', 'REIMBURSEMENT_MANAGER_REJECT',
      'REIMBURSEMENT_SUPERADMIN_APPROVE', 'REIMBURSEMENT_SUPERADMIN_REJECT'
    )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.activity_log already
        WHERE already.module = 'REIMBURSEMENT'
          AND already.employee_id = al.actor_id
          AND already.target = al.target_id
          AND already.created_at = al.timestamp
          AND already.action = CASE al.action_type
            WHEN 'REIMBURSEMENT_SUBMIT' THEN 'Pengajuan Reimbursement'
            WHEN 'REIMBURSEMENT_MANAGER_APPROVE' THEN 'Persetujuan Atasan Reimbursement'
            WHEN 'REIMBURSEMENT_MANAGER_REJECT' THEN 'Penolakan Atasan Reimbursement'
            WHEN 'REIMBURSEMENT_SUPERADMIN_APPROVE' THEN 'Persetujuan Superadmin Reimbursement'
            WHEN 'REIMBURSEMENT_SUPERADMIN_REJECT' THEN 'Penolakan Superadmin Reimbursement'
            ELSE 'Aktivitas Reimbursement'
          END
      )
  ), filtered AS (
    SELECT * FROM combined l
    WHERE (NULLIF(btrim(coalesce(p_q, '')), '') IS NULL
      OR coalesce(l.nama, '') ILIKE '%' || btrim(p_q) || '%'
      OR coalesce(l.employee_id, '') ILIKE '%' || btrim(p_q) || '%'
      OR coalesce(l.target, '') ILIKE '%' || btrim(p_q) || '%'
      OR coalesce(l.detail, '') ILIKE '%' || btrim(p_q) || '%')
      AND (p_module IS NULL OR l.modul = p_module)
      AND (p_status IS NULL OR l.status = p_status)
      AND (p_from IS NULL OR (l.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta')::date >= p_from)
      AND (p_to IS NULL OR (l.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta')::date <= p_to)
    ORDER BY l.created_at DESC
    LIMIT v_limit
  )
  SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
    'waktu', to_char(l.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta', 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI'),
    'employee_id', l.employee_id,
    'nama', l.nama,
    'role', l.role,
    'aktivitas', l.aktivitas,
    'modul', l.modul,
    'target', l.target,
    'detail', l.detail,
    'status', l.status
  ) ORDER BY l.created_at DESC), '[]'::json)
  INTO v_out
  FROM filtered l;

  RETURN json_build_object('ok', true, 'list', v_out);
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: hr_get_attendance_approval_status(text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hr_get_attendance_approval_status(p_token text, p_id text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_row public.absensi;
  v_role text;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  v_role := upper(coalesce(v_emp.role, ''));

  SELECT * INTO v_row
    FROM public.absensi a
   WHERE a.id::text = trim(coalesce(p_id, ''));

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pengajuan presensi tidak ditemukan.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  IF NOT (
    v_row.employee_id = v_emp.employee_id
    OR v_role IN ('HR', 'ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN')
    OR (
      v_role IN ('KARYAWAN', 'SUPERADMIN')
      AND (
        v_row.atasan_id = v_emp.employee_id
        OR v_row.approval_manager_by = v_emp.employee_id
      )
    )
    OR (v_role = 'SUPERADMIN' AND v_row.approval_hr_by = v_emp.employee_id)
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Anda tidak berhak memeriksa status pengajuan presensi ini.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'id', v_row.id,
    'status', v_row.status_approval,
    'approval_manager_by', v_row.approval_manager_by,
    'approval_manager_at', v_row.approval_manager_at,
    'approval_hr_by', v_row.approval_hr_by,
    'approval_hr_at', v_row.approval_hr_at
  );
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: hr_get_attendance_monitoring(text, date, date); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hr_get_attendance_monitoring(p_token text, p_start_date date, p_end_date date) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_records jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_summary jsonb;
  v_summary_rows jsonb;
  v_today date := (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta')::date;
  v_ontime bigint := 0;
  v_late bigint := 0;
  v_early bigint := 0;
  v_no_out bigint := 0;
  v_no_in bigint := 0;
  v_has_timing boolean := false;
  v_is_approver boolean := false;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  v_is_approver := EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.karyawan b WHERE b.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id AND b.status_akun='AKTIF');
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role, '')) NOT IN ('HR','ADMIN','SUPERADMIN') AND NOT v_is_approver THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF p_start_date IS NULL OR p_end_date IS NULL OR p_start_date > p_end_date
     OR p_end_date - p_start_date > 400 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid monitoring range (maximum 401 days).';
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(
    jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY x.date DESC, x.time DESC, x.employee_name),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  INTO v_records
  FROM (
    SELECT
      a.id,
      UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(k.nama), ''), a.employee_id)) AS employee_name,
      a.employee_id,
      a.tanggal AS date,
      a.jam AS time,
      CASE WHEN a.tipe = 'MASUK' THEN 'Clock In'
           WHEN a.tipe = 'PULANG' THEN 'Clock Out' ELSE a.tipe END AS type,
      k.job_position,
      CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM storage.objects o
          WHERE o.bucket_id = 'evidence' AND o.name = a.storage_path
        ) THEN a.storage_path
        WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(a.foto_path), '') ~* '^https?://' THEN BTRIM(a.foto_path)
        WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(a.foto_url), '') ~* '^https?://' THEN BTRIM(a.foto_url)
        ELSE NULL
      END AS photo_url,
      CASE
        WHEN a.face_distance IS NOT NULL AND a.face_match IS TRUE THEN 'Matched'
        WHEN a.face_distance IS NOT NULL AND a.face_match IS FALSE THEN 'Not matched'
        WHEN a.face_match IS TRUE THEN 'Matched'
        WHEN a.face_local_precheck IS TRUE THEN 'Local precheck only'
        ELSE NULL
      END AS face_recognition,
      NULL::text AS liveness_validation,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(a.employee_branch_snapshot), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(k.branch), ''), 'Pusat') AS location_setting_name,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(a.branch_target), ''), '—') AS location_gps_name,
      a.area AS area,
      a.catatan AS note,
      a.status_approval AS status_approval,
      a.address AS location_address,
      a.latitude,
      a.longitude,
      a.accuracy,
      a.distance_m,
      a.face_match,
      a.face_distance,
      a.face_local_precheck,
      a.shift_name_snapshot AS shift_name,
      a.shift_code_snapshot AS shift_code,
      a.shift_label_snapshot AS shift_label,
      to_char(a.scheduled_check_in_snapshot, 'HH24:MI') AS schedule_check_in,
      to_char(a.scheduled_check_out_snapshot, 'HH24:MI') AS schedule_check_out,
      CASE WHEN a.tipe='MASUK' THEN
        CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(k.job_code,'')) IN ('WFA','HYBRID')
          OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.absensi ai WHERE ai.employee_id=a.employee_id AND ai.tanggal=a.tanggal AND ai.tipe='MASUK'
            AND COALESCE(ai.status_approval,'VALID') NOT IN ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR')
            AND (COALESCE(ai.catatan,'') ~ '\[\[RHATT=(DL[1-5]?|DLL|SDL[1-5]?|SDLL)\]\]'
              OR (COALESCE(ai.catatan,'') !~ '\[\[RHATT=P' AND COALESCE(ai.outside_location,FALSE) IS TRUE
                  AND ai.area IN ('Area 1','Area 2','Area 3','Area 4','Area lainnya')))) THEN 'ON_TIME'
          WHEN a.scheduled_check_in_snapshot IS NULL THEN 'ON_TIME'
          WHEN a.jam >= a.scheduled_check_in_snapshot + interval '1 minute' THEN 'LATE'
          ELSE 'ON_TIME' END
        ELSE a.punctuality_status END AS punctuality_status,
      a.attendance_warning,
      a.calendar_day_type_snapshot,
      a.employee_branch_snapshot,
      a.outside_location,
      (a.tipe='PULANG' AND a.scheduled_check_out_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND a.jam < (a.scheduled_check_out_snapshot - make_interval(mins => COALESCE(a.early_window_minutes_snapshot,0)))
        AND UPPER(COALESCE(k.job_code,'')) NOT IN ('WFA','HYBRID')
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.absensi ai WHERE ai.employee_id=a.employee_id AND ai.tanggal=a.tanggal AND ai.tipe='MASUK'
          AND COALESCE(ai.status_approval,'VALID') NOT IN ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR')
          AND (COALESCE(ai.catatan,'') ~ '\[\[RHATT=(DL[1-5]?|DLL|SDL[1-5]?|SDLL)\]\]'
            OR (COALESCE(ai.catatan,'') !~ '\[\[RHATT=P' AND COALESCE(ai.outside_location,FALSE) IS TRUE
                AND ai.area IN ('Area 1','Area 2','Area 3','Area 4','Area lainnya'))))) AS is_early_clock_out
    FROM public.absensi a
    LEFT JOIN public.karyawan k ON k.employee_id = a.employee_id
    WHERE a.tanggal BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
      AND (UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,'')) IN ('HR','ADMIN','SUPERADMIN') OR k.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id)
  ) x;

  -- IMPORTANT: group raw events before referencing branch/calendar fields in any subquery.
  -- This avoids SQLSTATE 42803 (ungrouped outer column in subquery).
  WITH daily_events AS (
    SELECT
      a.employee_id::text AS employee_id,
      a.tanggal AS dt,
      BOOL_OR(a.tipe = 'MASUK' AND a.status_approval NOT IN ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR')) AS has_in,
      BOOL_OR(a.tipe = 'PULANG' AND a.status_approval NOT IN ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR')) AS has_out,
      MIN(a.jam) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='MASUK' AND a.status_approval NOT IN ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR')) AS first_in_time,
      MAX(a.scheduled_check_in_snapshot) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='MASUK' AND a.status_approval NOT IN ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR')) AS scheduled_in,
      substring(MAX(a.catatan) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='MASUK' AND a.status_approval NOT IN ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR')) FROM '\[\[RHATT=([A-Za-z0-9]+)\]\]') AS attendance_marker,
      MAX(k.job_code) AS job_code,
      BOOL_OR(COALESCE(a.outside_location,false)) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='MASUK' AND a.status_approval NOT IN ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR')) AS first_in_outside,
      MAX(a.area) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='MASUK' AND a.status_approval NOT IN ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR')) AS first_in_area,
      MAX(a.jam) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='PULANG' AND a.status_approval NOT IN ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR')) AS last_out,
      COALESCE(MAX(a.scheduled_check_out_snapshot) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='PULANG' AND a.status_approval NOT IN ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR')),
               MAX(a.scheduled_check_out_snapshot) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='MASUK' AND a.status_approval NOT IN ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR'))) AS scheduled_out,
      COALESCE(MAX(a.early_window_minutes_snapshot) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='PULANG' AND a.status_approval NOT IN ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR')),
               MAX(a.early_window_minutes_snapshot) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='MASUK' AND a.status_approval NOT IN ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR'))) AS early_window_minutes,
      MAX(a.employee_branch_snapshot) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe = 'MASUK' AND a.status_approval IN ('VALID','DISETUJUI')) AS branch_snapshot,
      MAX(a.calendar_day_type_snapshot) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe = 'MASUK' AND a.status_approval IN ('VALID','DISETUJUI')) AS day_type_snapshot
    FROM public.absensi a
    LEFT JOIN public.karyawan k ON k.employee_id=a.employee_id
    WHERE a.tanggal BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
      AND a.status_approval NOT IN ('DITOLAK_ATASAN', 'DITOLAK_HR')
      AND (UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,'')) IN ('HR','ADMIN','SUPERADMIN') OR k.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id)
    GROUP BY a.employee_id, a.tanggal
  ), daily_resolved AS (
    SELECT
      d.*,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(d.branch_snapshot), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(k.branch), ''), 'Pusat') AS branch,
      COALESCE(
        d.day_type_snapshot,
        public.attendance_resolved_day_type(
          d.dt,
          COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(d.branch_snapshot), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(k.branch), ''), 'Pusat')
        )
      ) AS day_type,
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.attendance_schedule_rules r
        WHERE LOWER(BTRIM(r.branch)) = LOWER(BTRIM(
          COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(d.branch_snapshot), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(k.branch), ''), 'Pusat')
        ))
          AND r.effective_from <= d.dt
          AND (r.effective_to IS NULL OR r.effective_to >= d.dt)
          AND r.is_workday = TRUE
          AND (
            r.day_of_week = EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM d.dt)::integer
            OR (
              EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM d.dt)::integer = 7
              AND public.attendance_resolved_day_type(
                d.dt,
                COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(d.branch_snapshot), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(k.branch), ''), 'Pusat')
              ) = 'WORKING_DAY'
              AND r.day_of_week BETWEEN 1 AND 6
            )
          )
          AND COALESCE(
            d.day_type_snapshot,
            public.attendance_resolved_day_type(
              d.dt,
              COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(d.branch_snapshot), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(k.branch), ''), 'Pusat')
            )
          ) NOT IN ('SUNDAY', 'NATIONAL_HOLIDAY', 'DAY_OFF')
      ) AS expected_workday,
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.pengajuan_cuti c
        WHERE c.employee_id = d.employee_id
          AND c.status_atasan = 'DISETUJUI'
          AND c.status_hr = 'DISETUJUI'
          AND c.tanggal_mulai <= d.dt
          AND c.tanggal_selesai >= d.dt
      ) AS has_approved_time_off
    FROM daily_events d
    LEFT JOIN public.karyawan k ON k.employee_id = d.employee_id
  )
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_in AND (
      UPPER(COALESCE(job_code,'')) IN ('WFA','HYBRID') OR COALESCE(attendance_marker,'') ~ '^(DL|SDL)' OR
      (COALESCE(attendance_marker,'') !~ '^P' AND first_in_outside IS TRUE AND COALESCE(first_in_area,'') IN ('Area 1','Area 2','Area 3','Area 4','Area lainnya')) OR
      (scheduled_in IS NOT NULL AND first_in_time < scheduled_in + interval '1 minute'))),
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_in AND scheduled_in IS NOT NULL AND
      UPPER(COALESCE(job_code,'')) NOT IN ('WFA','HYBRID') AND COALESCE(attendance_marker,'') !~ '^(DL|SDL)' AND
      NOT (COALESCE(attendance_marker,'') !~ '^P' AND first_in_outside IS TRUE AND COALESCE(first_in_area,'') IN ('Area 1','Area 2','Area 3','Area 4','Area lainnya')) AND
      first_in_time >= scheduled_in + interval '1 minute'),
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_out AND scheduled_out IS NOT NULL AND
      UPPER(COALESCE(job_code,'')) NOT IN ('WFA','HYBRID') AND COALESCE(attendance_marker,'') !~ '^(DL|SDL)' AND
      NOT (COALESCE(attendance_marker,'') !~ '^P' AND first_in_outside IS TRUE AND COALESCE(first_in_area,'') IN ('Area 1','Area 2','Area 3','Area 4','Area lainnya')) AND
      last_out < (scheduled_out - make_interval(mins => COALESCE(early_window_minutes,0)))),
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_in AND NOT has_out),
    COALESCE(BOOL_OR(has_in AND (UPPER(COALESCE(job_code,'')) IN ('WFA','HYBRID') OR COALESCE(attendance_marker,'') ~ '^(DL|SDL)' OR
      (COALESCE(attendance_marker,'') !~ '^P' AND first_in_outside IS TRUE AND COALESCE(first_in_area,'') IN ('Area 1','Area 2','Area 3','Area 4','Area lainnya')) OR scheduled_in IS NOT NULL)), FALSE)
  INTO v_ontime, v_late, v_early, v_no_out, v_has_timing
  FROM daily_resolved;

  -- No Clock In is calculated from the complete employee-day grid, not from events alone.
  v_summary_rows := (
    public.hr_get_attendance_summary(p_token, p_start_date, p_end_date) -> 'records'
  );
  IF v_summary_rows IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(v_summary_rows) = 'array' THEN
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_no_in
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_summary_rows) r
    WHERE COALESCE((r ->> 'employee_is_active')::boolean, FALSE) = TRUE
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.absensi a
        WHERE a.employee_id = r ->> 'employee_id'
          AND a.tanggal = (r ->> 'date')::date
          AND a.tipe = 'MASUK'
          AND COALESCE(a.status_approval,'VALID') NOT IN ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR')
      );
  END IF;

  -- The dashboard should show unknown, not zero, when no punctuality snapshots exist.
  IF NOT v_has_timing THEN
    v_ontime := NULL;
    v_late := NULL;
  END IF;


  v_summary := jsonb_build_object(
    'ontime', v_ontime,
    'lateClockIn', v_late,
    'earlyClockOut', v_early,
    'noClockOut', v_no_out,
    'noClockIn', v_no_in
  );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'summary', v_summary,
    'records', COALESCE(v_records, '[]'::jsonb),
    'total', jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(v_records, '[]'::jsonb)),
    'from_date', p_start_date,
    'to_date', p_end_date,
    'timezone', 'Asia/Jakarta'
  );
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: hr_get_attendance_schedule(text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hr_get_attendance_schedule(p_token text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE v_emp public.karyawan; v_rows jsonb;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role, '')) NOT IN ('HR','ADMIN','SUPERADMIN') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied.' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.branch, r.day_of_week, r.effective_from DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_rows
  FROM public.attendance_schedule_rules r
  WHERE r.effective_to IS NULL OR r.effective_to >= CURRENT_DATE;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'records',v_rows);
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: hr_get_attendance_summary(text, date, date); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hr_get_attendance_summary(p_token text, p_start_date date, p_end_date date) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_rows jsonb;
  v_is_approver boolean := false;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  v_is_approver := EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.karyawan b WHERE b.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id AND b.status_akun='AKTIF');
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role, '')) NOT IN ('HR','ADMIN','SUPERADMIN') AND NOT v_is_approver THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied.' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  IF p_start_date IS NULL OR p_end_date IS NULL OR p_start_date > p_end_date OR p_end_date - p_start_date > 400 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid summary range (maximum 401 days).';
  END IF;

  WITH dates AS (
    SELECT d::date AS dt
    FROM generate_series(p_start_date, p_end_date, interval '1 day') d
  ), emp_days AS (
    SELECT
      k.employee_id::text AS employee_id,
      k.nama,
      k.organization,
      k.job_position,
      k.job_code,
      k.status_akun,
      k.join_date,
      k.contract_end_date,
      d.dt,
      COALESCE(h.branch, NULLIF(BTRIM(k.branch),''), 'Pusat') AS profile_branch
    FROM public.karyawan k
    CROSS JOIN dates d
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT bh.branch
      FROM public.attendance_employee_branch_history bh
      WHERE bh.employee_id = k.employee_id::text
        AND bh.effective_from <= d.dt
        AND (bh.effective_to IS NULL OR bh.effective_to >= d.dt)
      ORDER BY bh.effective_from DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ) h ON TRUE
    WHERE (k.join_date IS NULL OR k.join_date <= d.dt)
      AND (UPPER(COALESCE(k.status_akun,'')) = 'AKTIF' OR d.dt <= (k.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta')::date)
      AND (UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,'')) IN ('HR','ADMIN','SUPERADMIN') OR k.approval_line_id = v_emp.employee_id)
  ), actual AS (
    SELECT
      a.employee_id::text AS employee_id,
      a.tanggal AS dt,
      MIN(a.jam) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='MASUK') AS check_in,
      MAX(a.jam) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='PULANG') AS check_out,
      MAX(a.employee_branch_snapshot) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='MASUK') AS event_branch,
      MAX(a.shift_name_snapshot) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='MASUK') AS event_shift_name,
      MAX(a.shift_code_snapshot) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='MASUK') AS event_shift_code,
      MAX(a.shift_label_snapshot) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='MASUK') AS event_shift_label,
      MAX(a.scheduled_check_in_snapshot) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='MASUK') AS event_scheduled_in,
      MAX(a.scheduled_check_out_snapshot) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='MASUK') AS event_scheduled_out,
      MAX(a.calendar_day_type_snapshot) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='MASUK') AS event_day_type,
      MAX(substring(COALESCE(a.catatan,'') from '\[\[RHATT=([A-Za-z0-9]+)\]\]'))
        FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='MASUK') AS event_attendance_marker,
      MAX(a.area) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='MASUK') AS first_in_area,
      COALESCE(BOOL_OR(COALESCE(a.outside_location,FALSE)) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='MASUK'),FALSE) AS first_in_outside,
      COALESCE(
        MAX(a.area) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='MASUK' AND COALESCE(a.outside_location,FALSE) IS TRUE),
        MAX(a.area) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='PULANG' AND COALESCE(a.outside_location,FALSE) IS TRUE)
      ) AS event_area,
      BOOL_OR(COALESCE(a.outside_location,FALSE)) AS outside_any
    FROM public.absensi a
    WHERE a.tanggal BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
      AND COALESCE(a.status_approval,'VALID') NOT IN ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR')
    GROUP BY a.employee_id, a.tanggal
  ), base AS (
    SELECT
      e.*,
      a.check_in,
      a.check_out,
      a.event_attendance_marker,
      a.event_area,
      a.first_in_area,
      COALESCE(a.first_in_outside,FALSE) AS first_in_outside,
      COALESCE(a.outside_any,FALSE) AS outside_any,
      COALESCE(a.event_branch,e.profile_branch) AS branch,
      COALESCE(a.event_shift_name,r.shift_name) AS shift_name,
      COALESCE(a.event_shift_code,r.shift_code) AS shift_code,
      COALESCE(a.event_shift_label,r.shift_label) AS shift_label,
      COALESCE(a.event_scheduled_in,r.scheduled_check_in) AS scheduled_in,
      COALESCE(a.event_scheduled_out,r.scheduled_check_out) AS scheduled_out,
      COALESCE(a.event_day_type,public.attendance_resolved_day_type(e.dt,COALESCE(a.event_branch,e.profile_branch))) AS day_type,
      COALESCE(r.is_workday,FALSE) AS rule_is_workday,
      lv.kode_cuti AS time_off_code,
      lv.total_hari AS time_off_days,
      COALESCE(lv.dinas_luar_sakit,false) AS sick_outside_leave,
      lv.area_sakit AS sick_outside_area
    FROM emp_days e
    LEFT JOIN actual a ON a.employee_id=e.employee_id AND a.dt=e.dt
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT sr.*
      FROM public.attendance_schedule_rules sr
      WHERE LOWER(BTRIM(sr.branch)) = LOWER(BTRIM(COALESCE(a.event_branch,e.profile_branch)))
        AND sr.effective_from <= e.dt
        AND (sr.effective_to IS NULL OR sr.effective_to >= e.dt)
        AND (
          public.attendance_resolved_day_type(e.dt,COALESCE(a.event_branch,e.profile_branch)) NOT IN ('SUNDAY','NATIONAL_HOLIDAY','DAY_OFF')
          OR (
            EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM e.dt)::integer = 7
            AND public.attendance_resolved_day_type(e.dt,COALESCE(a.event_branch,e.profile_branch)) = 'WORKING_DAY'
          )
        )
        AND (
          sr.day_of_week = EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM e.dt)::integer
          OR (
            EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM e.dt)::integer = 7
            AND public.attendance_resolved_day_type(e.dt,COALESCE(a.event_branch,e.profile_branch)) = 'WORKING_DAY'
            AND sr.day_of_week BETWEEN 1 AND 6
            AND sr.is_workday = TRUE
          )
        )
        AND NOT (
          EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM e.dt)::integer = 7
          AND public.attendance_resolved_day_type(e.dt,COALESCE(a.event_branch,e.profile_branch)) = 'WORKING_DAY'
          AND sr.day_of_week = 7
          AND sr.is_workday = FALSE
        )
      ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN sr.day_of_week = EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM e.dt)::integer THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
        sr.effective_from DESC,
        sr.day_of_week
      LIMIT 1
    ) r ON TRUE
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT c.kode_cuti, c.total_hari, c.dinas_luar_sakit, c.area_sakit
      FROM public.pengajuan_cuti c
      WHERE c.employee_id=e.employee_id
        AND c.status_atasan='DISETUJUI'
        AND c.status_hr='DISETUJUI'
        AND c.tanggal_mulai<=e.dt
        AND c.tanggal_selesai>=e.dt
      ORDER BY c.tanggal_mulai DESC, c."timestamp" DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ) lv ON TRUE
  ), final_rows AS (
    SELECT
      employee_id,
      UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(nama),''),employee_id)) AS full_name,
      branch,
      organization,
      job_position,
      job_code,
      dt AS date,
      COALESCE(shift_name, CASE WHEN day_type IN ('SUNDAY','NATIONAL_HOLIDAY','DAY_OFF') THEN 'Day Off' ELSE '—' END) AS shift,
      shift_code,
      shift_label,
      to_char(scheduled_in,'HH24:MI') AS schedule_check_in,
      to_char(scheduled_out,'HH24:MI') AS schedule_check_out,
      CASE
        WHEN time_off_code='SDR' AND sick_outside_leave AND sick_outside_area='Area 1' THEN 'SDR-DL1'
        WHEN time_off_code='SDR' AND sick_outside_leave AND sick_outside_area='Area 2' THEN 'SDR-DL2'
        WHEN time_off_code='SDR' AND sick_outside_leave AND sick_outside_area='Area 3' THEN 'SDR-DL3'
        WHEN time_off_code='SDR' AND sick_outside_leave AND sick_outside_area='Area 4' THEN 'SDR-DL4'
        WHEN time_off_code='SDR' AND sick_outside_leave AND sick_outside_area='Area lainnya' THEN 'SDR-DLL'
        WHEN event_attendance_marker IN ('P','P1','P2','P3','P4','PL') THEN event_attendance_marker
        WHEN event_attendance_marker = 'P5' THEN 'PL'
        WHEN event_attendance_marker IN ('SDL1','SDL2','SDL3','SDL4','SDLL') THEN event_attendance_marker
        WHEN event_attendance_marker = 'SDL5' THEN 'SDLL'
        WHEN event_attendance_marker IN ('DL1','DL2','DL3','DL4','DLL') THEN event_attendance_marker
        WHEN event_attendance_marker = 'DL5' THEN 'DLL'
        WHEN event_area = 'Surabaya & Sekitarnya' AND check_in IS NOT NULL THEN 'H'
        WHEN COALESCE(event_attendance_marker,'') !~ '^P' AND first_in_outside AND first_in_area = 'Area 1' THEN 'DL1'
        WHEN COALESCE(event_attendance_marker,'') !~ '^P' AND first_in_outside AND first_in_area = 'Area 2' THEN 'DL2'
        WHEN COALESCE(event_attendance_marker,'') !~ '^P' AND first_in_outside AND first_in_area = 'Area 3' THEN 'DL3'
        WHEN COALESCE(event_attendance_marker,'') !~ '^P' AND first_in_outside AND first_in_area = 'Area 4' THEN 'DL4'
        WHEN COALESCE(event_attendance_marker,'') !~ '^P' AND first_in_outside AND first_in_area = 'Area lainnya' THEN 'DLL'
        WHEN check_in IS NOT NULL AND day_type IN ('SUNDAY','NATIONAL_HOLIDAY','DAY_OFF') THEN 'P'
        WHEN check_in IS NOT NULL THEN 'H'
        WHEN time_off_code IS NOT NULL THEN time_off_code
        ELSE NULL
      END AS attendance_code,
      time_off_code,
      NULL::text AS hourly_time_off_breakdown,
      to_char(check_in,'HH24:MI') AS check_in,
      to_char(check_out,'HH24:MI') AS check_out,
      (check_in IS NOT NULL) AS has_clock_in,
      (UPPER(COALESCE(status_akun,''))='AKTIF') AS employee_is_active,
      (rule_is_workday AND day_type NOT IN ('SUNDAY','NATIONAL_HOLIDAY','DAY_OFF')) AS expected_workday,
      day_type AS calendar_day_type,
      CASE WHEN time_off_code='SDR' AND sick_outside_leave THEN sick_outside_area ELSE event_area END AS area,
      (outside_any OR (time_off_code='SDR' AND sick_outside_leave)) AS outside_location,
      CASE
        WHEN check_in IS NULL THEN '-'
        WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(job_code,'')) IN ('WFA','HYBRID')
          OR COALESCE(event_attendance_marker,'') ~ '^(DL|SDL)'
          OR (COALESCE(event_attendance_marker,'') !~ '^P' AND first_in_outside IS TRUE AND COALESCE(first_in_area,'') IN ('Area 1','Area 2','Area 3','Area 4','Area lainnya')) THEN 'Ontime'
        WHEN scheduled_in IS NULL THEN 'Ontime'
        WHEN check_in >= scheduled_in + interval '1 minute' THEN 'Late'
        ELSE 'Ontime'
      END AS punctuality_status
    FROM base
  )
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(f) ORDER BY f.date, f.branch, f.full_name), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO v_rows
  FROM final_rows f;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'records',v_rows,
    'from_date',p_start_date,
    'to_date',p_end_date,
    'total',jsonb_array_length(v_rows)
  );
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: hr_get_dashboard_panels(text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hr_get_dashboard_panels(p_token text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_today date := (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta')::date;
  v_start date; v_end date; v_calc jsonb; v_row jsonb; v_employee_id text;
  v_area1 numeric:=0; v_area2 numeric:=0; v_area3 numeric:=0; v_area4 numeric:=0; v_arealain numeric:=0;
  v_transport numeric:=0; v_entertain numeric:=0;
  v_absent jsonb;
  v_admin boolean;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  v_admin := UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,'')) IN ('HR','ADMIN','SUPERADMIN');
  IF NOT v_admin AND NOT public.rh_is_active_approver(v_emp.employee_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied.' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  SELECT b.period_start,b.period_end INTO v_start,v_end FROM public.hr_reimbursement_period_bounds(v_today) b;

  IF v_admin THEN
    v_calc := public.hris_incentive_calculate(v_start,v_end,NULL);
    FOR v_row IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(v_calc->'records','[]'::jsonb)) LOOP
      v_area1 := v_area1 + COALESCE(NULLIF(v_row->>'area_1_amount','')::numeric,0);
      v_area2 := v_area2 + COALESCE(NULLIF(v_row->>'area_2_amount','')::numeric,0);
      v_area3 := v_area3 + COALESCE(NULLIF(v_row->>'area_3_amount','')::numeric,0);
      v_area4 := v_area4 + COALESCE(NULLIF(v_row->>'area_4_amount','')::numeric,0);
      v_arealain := v_arealain + COALESCE(NULLIF(v_row->>'area_lain_amount','')::numeric,0);
    END LOOP;
  ELSE
    FOR v_employee_id IN SELECT k.employee_id FROM public.karyawan k WHERE k.status_akun='AKTIF' AND k.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id LOOP
      v_calc := public.hris_incentive_calculate(v_start,v_end,v_employee_id);
      FOR v_row IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(v_calc->'records','[]'::jsonb)) LOOP
        v_area1 := v_area1 + COALESCE(NULLIF(v_row->>'area_1_amount','')::numeric,0);
        v_area2 := v_area2 + COALESCE(NULLIF(v_row->>'area_2_amount','')::numeric,0);
        v_area3 := v_area3 + COALESCE(NULLIF(v_row->>'area_3_amount','')::numeric,0);
        v_area4 := v_area4 + COALESCE(NULLIF(v_row->>'area_4_amount','')::numeric,0);
        v_arealain := v_arealain + COALESCE(NULLIF(v_row->>'area_lain_amount','')::numeric,0);
      END LOOP;
    END LOOP;
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.amount) FILTER (WHERE r.category='TRANSPORT'),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(r.amount) FILTER (WHERE r.category='ENTERTAIN'),0)
    INTO v_transport,v_entertain
  FROM public.hr_reimbursement_requests r
  JOIN public.karyawan k ON k.employee_id=r.employee_id
  WHERE r.status='DISETUJUI' AND r.period_start=v_start AND r.period_end=v_end
    AND UPPER(COALESCE(k.job_code,''))='HYBRID'
    AND (v_admin OR k.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id);

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('employee_id',q.employee_id,'nama',q.nama,'time_off_code',q.time_off_code)
      ORDER BY q.nama),'[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_absent
  FROM (
    SELECT k.employee_id,k.nama,
      (SELECT c.kode_cuti FROM public.pengajuan_cuti c
       WHERE c.employee_id=k.employee_id AND c.status_atasan='DISETUJUI' AND c.status_hr='DISETUJUI'
         AND c.tanggal_mulai<=v_today AND c.tanggal_selesai>=v_today
       ORDER BY c.tanggal_mulai DESC,c."timestamp" DESC LIMIT 1) AS time_off_code
    FROM public.karyawan k
    WHERE k.status_akun='AKTIF' AND (k.join_date IS NULL OR k.join_date<=v_today)
      AND (v_admin OR k.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.absensi a WHERE a.employee_id=k.employee_id AND a.tanggal=v_today
        AND a.tipe='MASUK' AND a.status_approval NOT IN ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR'))
  ) q;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'period',jsonb_build_object('start_date',v_start,'end_date',v_end),
    'hybrid_expense',jsonb_build_object('transport',v_transport,'entertain',v_entertain),
    'outside_incentive',jsonb_build_object('area_1',v_area1,'area_2',v_area2,'area_3',v_area3,'area_4',v_area4,'area_lain',v_arealain),
    'absent_today',v_absent);
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: hr_get_employee_attendance_history(text, text, integer, integer); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hr_get_employee_attendance_history(p_token text, p_employee_id text, p_year integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_month integer DEFAULT NULL::integer) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_admin public.karyawan;
  v_year integer;
  v_month integer;
  v_result json;
BEGIN
  v_admin := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF v_admin.role NOT IN ('HR', 'ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Akses ditolak. Hanya HR/ADMIN yang dapat melihat riwayat absensi.';
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.karyawan k WHERE k.employee_id = p_employee_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Karyawan tidak ditemukan.';
  END IF;
  v_year := COALESCE(NULLIF(p_year,0), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::integer);
  v_month := COALESCE(NULLIF(p_month,0), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::integer);
  IF v_month < 1 OR v_month > 12 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Bulan tidak valid.'; END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
    'id', a.id,
    'tanggal', to_char(a.tanggal,'YYYY-MM-DD'),
    'jam', to_char(a.jam,'HH24:MI:SS'),
    'tipe', a.tipe,
    'statusApproval', a.status_approval,
    'branchTarget', a.branch_target,
    'timestamp', to_char(a.timestamp,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
  ) ORDER BY a.timestamp DESC), '[]'::json)
  INTO v_result
  FROM public.absensi a
  WHERE a.employee_id = p_employee_id
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.tanggal) = v_year
    AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM a.tanggal) = v_month;

  RETURN json_build_object('success',true,'employeeId',p_employee_id,'year',v_year,'month',v_month,'records',v_result);
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: hr_get_employee_directory(text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hr_get_employee_directory(p_token text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_is_admin boolean := false;
  v_list jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF p_token IS NULL OR BTRIM(p_token) = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  v_is_admin := UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,'')) IN ('HR','ADMIN','SUPERADMIN');
  IF NOT v_is_admin AND NOT public.rh_is_active_approver(v_emp.employee_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
    CASE WHEN v_is_admin THEN to_jsonb(r)
      ELSE jsonb_build_object(
        'id',r.id,'employee_id',r.employee_id,'nik',r.nik,'nama',r.nama,
        'branch',r.branch,'organization',r.organization,'org',r.org,'department',r.department,
        'job_level',r.job_level,'level',r.level,'job_position',r.job_position,'posisi',r.posisi,
        'job_code',r.job_code,'grade',r.grade,'class',r.class,
        'employment_status',r.employment_status,'statusKerja',r."statusKerja",
        'approval_line_name',r.approval_line_name,'atasanNama',r."atasanNama",
        'approval_line_id',r.approval_line_id,'atasanId',r."atasanId",
        'join_date',r.join_date,'joinDate',r."joinDate",
        'working_period',r.working_period,'workingPeriod',r."workingPeriod",
        'status_akun',r.status_akun,'akun',r.akun,'role',r.role,
        'faceVer',r."faceVer",'facePhotoVer',r."facePhotoVer",'gender',r.gender
      ) END ORDER BY r.nama
    ),'[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_list
  FROM (
    SELECT
      k.id,
      k.employee_id,
      k.employee_id AS nik,
      k.nama,
      k.branch,
      k.organization,
      k.organization AS org,
      k.organization AS department,
      k.job_level,
      k.job_level AS level,
      k.job_position,
      k.job_position AS posisi,
      k.job_code,
      k.grade,
      k.class,
      k.total_reprimand,
      k.reprimand_type,
      k.reprimand_status,
      k.employment_status,
      k.employment_status AS "statusKerja",
      k.approval_line_name,
      k.approval_line_name AS "atasanNama",
      k.approval_line_id,
      k.approval_line_id AS "atasanId",
      k.join_date,
      k.join_date AS "joinDate",
      public.karyawan_working_period(k.join_date, CURRENT_DATE) AS working_period,
      public.karyawan_working_period(k.join_date, CURRENT_DATE) AS "workingPeriod",
      k.contract_start_date,
      k.contract_start_date AS "contractStartDate",
      k.contract_end_date,
      k.contract_end_date AS "contractEndDate",
      k.address,
      k.ktp_number,
      k.place_of_birth,
      k.birth_date,
      k.phone,
      k.email,
      k.education,
      k.gender,
      k.religion,
      k.marital_status,
      k.npwp,
      k.bpjs_kesehatan,
      k.bpjs_ketenagakerjaan,
      k.bank_name,
      k.bank_account,
      k.status_akun,
      k.status_akun AS akun,
      k.role,
      CASE WHEN k.face IS NULL THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END AS face,
      k.face_version AS "faceVer",
      k.face_photo_ver AS "facePhotoVer"
    FROM public.karyawan AS k
    WHERE v_is_admin OR k.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id
  ) AS r;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'list', v_list);
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: hr_get_employee_directory_summary(text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hr_get_employee_directory_summary(p_token text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE v_emp public.karyawan; v_list jsonb; v_is_admin boolean;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  v_is_admin := UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,'')) IN ('HR','ADMIN','SUPERADMIN');
  IF NOT v_is_admin AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.karyawan b WHERE b.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id AND b.status_akun='AKTIF') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.nama),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_list
  FROM (
    SELECT k.employee_id AS nik,k.employee_id,k.nama,k.branch,k.organization,k.organization AS org,k.organization AS department,
      k.job_level,k.job_level AS level,k.job_position,k.job_position AS posisi,k.job_code,k.grade,k.class,
      k.employment_status,k.employment_status AS "statusKerja",k.status_akun,k.status_akun AS akun,k.role,
      k.join_date,k.contract_end_date,k.approval_line_id,k.approval_line_name,
      COALESCE(k.face_photo_ver,0) AS "facePhotoVer",COALESCE(k.face_version,0) AS "faceVer",k.gender
    FROM public.karyawan k
    WHERE v_is_admin OR k.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id
  ) r;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'list',v_list);
END;
$$;

-- Name: hr_get_employee_doc(text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hr_get_employee_doc(p_token text, p_id text) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_d public.employee_documents;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);

  IF v_emp.role NOT IN ('HR', 'ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Akses ditolak.';
  END IF;

  SELECT *
  INTO v_d
  FROM public.employee_documents
  WHERE id = p_id;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Dokumen tidak ditemukan.';
  END IF;

  RETURN json_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'filename', v_d.filename,
    'mime', v_d.mime,
    'fileData', v_d.file_data
  );
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: hr_get_incentive_employee_recap(text, date, date, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hr_get_incentive_employee_recap(p_token text, p_start_date date, p_end_date date, p_employee_id text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    SET statement_timeout TO '30s'
    AS $$
DECLARE v_emp public.karyawan;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.hris_assert_incentive_reader(p_token);
  IF p_employee_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.karyawan WHERE employee_id=p_employee_id AND status_akun='AKTIF'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Karyawan tidak aktif atau tidak ditemukan.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;
  RETURN public.hris_incentive_calculate(p_start_date,p_end_date,p_employee_id);
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: hr_get_incentive_exclusions(text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hr_get_incentive_exclusions(p_token text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_rows jsonb;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.hris_assert_incentive_reader(p_token);

  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'employee_id', x.employee_id,
    'nama', k.nama,
    'branch', k.branch,
    'status_akun', k.status_akun,
    'reason', x.reason,
    'updated_at', x.updated_at
  ) ORDER BY k.nama, x.employee_id), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_rows
  FROM public.incentive_employee_exclusions x
  JOIN public.karyawan k ON k.employee_id = x.employee_id
  WHERE x.is_excluded = true;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'exclusions', v_rows);
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: hr_get_incentive_formula(text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hr_get_incentive_formula(p_token text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE v_emp public.karyawan; v_row public.incentive_formula_versions%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.hris_assert_incentive_reader(p_token);
  SELECT * INTO v_row
  FROM public.incentive_formula_versions
  WHERE effective_from <= (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::date
  ORDER BY effective_from DESC, version_no DESC
  LIMIT 1;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'configured', false, 'message', 'Belum ada formula efektif.');
  END IF;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'configured', true,
    'version', v_row.version_no,
    'effective_from', v_row.effective_from,
    'created_at', v_row.created_at,
    'config', v_row.config
  );
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: hr_get_incentive_signatories(text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hr_get_incentive_signatories(p_token text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_global jsonb;
  v_overrides jsonb;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.hris_assert_incentive_reader(p_token);

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'prepared_by_employee_id', p.prepared_employee_id,
    'prepared_by', p.prepared_name,
    'approved_by_employee_id', a.approved_employee_id,
    'approved_by', a.approved_name,
    'received_by_mode', 'CURRENT_EMPLOYEE',
    'recap_prepared_by_employee_id', COALESCE(rp.recap_prepared_employee_id,p.prepared_employee_id),
    'recap_prepared_by', COALESCE(rp.recap_prepared_name,p.prepared_name),
    'recap_approved_by_employee_id', COALESCE(ra.recap_approved_employee_id,a.approved_employee_id),
    'recap_approved_by', COALESCE(ra.recap_approved_name,a.approved_name)
  ) INTO v_global
  FROM public.incentive_signatory_configs c
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT k.employee_id AS prepared_employee_id, k.nama AS prepared_name
    FROM public.karyawan k
    WHERE k.employee_id=c.prepared_by_employee_id AND k.status_akun='AKTIF'
  ) p ON true
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT k.employee_id AS approved_employee_id, k.nama AS approved_name
    FROM public.karyawan k
    WHERE k.employee_id=c.approved_by_employee_id AND k.status_akun='AKTIF'
  ) a ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT k.employee_id AS recap_prepared_employee_id, k.nama AS recap_prepared_name
    FROM public.karyawan k
    WHERE k.employee_id=COALESCE(c.recap_prepared_by_employee_id,c.prepared_by_employee_id)
      AND k.status_akun='AKTIF'
  ) rp ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT k.employee_id AS recap_approved_employee_id, k.nama AS recap_approved_name
    FROM public.karyawan k
    WHERE k.employee_id=COALESCE(c.recap_approved_by_employee_id,c.approved_by_employee_id)
      AND k.status_akun='AKTIF'
  ) ra ON true
  WHERE c.scope_employee_id='*';

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(c.scope_employee_id, jsonb_build_object(
    'prepared_by_employee_id', p.employee_id,
    'prepared_by', p.nama,
    'approved_by_employee_id', a.employee_id,
    'approved_by', a.nama,
    'received_by_mode', 'CURRENT_EMPLOYEE'
  )), '{}'::jsonb) INTO v_overrides
  FROM public.incentive_signatory_configs c
  JOIN public.karyawan p ON p.employee_id=c.prepared_by_employee_id AND p.status_akun='AKTIF'
  JOIN public.karyawan a ON a.employee_id=c.approved_by_employee_id AND a.status_akun='AKTIF'
  WHERE c.scope_employee_id <> '*';

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'configured', (v_global IS NOT NULL),
    'global', COALESCE(v_global, '{}'::jsonb),
    'by_employee_id', COALESCE(v_overrides, '{}'::jsonb)
  );
END;
$$;

CREATE FUNCTION public.hr_get_incentive_total_recap(p_token text, p_start_date date, p_end_date date) RETURNS jsonb

--
-- Name: hr_get_leave_list(text, integer); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hr_get_leave_list(p_token text, p_year integer DEFAULT NULL::integer) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_y int;
  v_out json;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);

  IF v_emp.role NOT IN ('HR', 'ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Akses ditolak.';
  END IF;

  v_y := COALESCE(
    p_year,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::int
  );

  SELECT COALESCE(
    json_agg(j ORDER BY j."tanggalMulai" DESC),
    '[]'::json
  )
  INTO v_out
  FROM (
    SELECT
      public.cuti_to_json(c) || jsonb_build_object(
        'org', k.organization,
        'status',
        CASE
          WHEN c.status_atasan = 'DITOLAK'
            OR c.status_hr = 'DITOLAK' THEN 'DITOLAK'
          WHEN c.status_hr = 'DISETUJUI' THEN 'DISETUJUI'
          ELSE 'PENDING'
        END
      )::json AS j
    FROM public.pengajuan_cuti c
    JOIN public.karyawan k
      ON k.employee_id = c.employee_id
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.tanggal_mulai) = v_y
       OR EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.tanggal_selesai) = v_y
  ) s(j);

  RETURN json_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'tahun', v_y,
    'list', v_out
  );
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: hr_get_leave_list_v2(text, integer); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hr_get_leave_list_v2(p_token text, p_year integer) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_list jsonb;
  v_is_approver boolean := false;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  v_is_approver := EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.karyawan b WHERE b.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id AND b.status_akun='AKTIF');
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,'')) NOT IN ('HR','ADMIN','SUPERADMIN') AND NOT v_is_approver THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF p_year IS NULL OR p_year NOT BETWEEN 2000 AND 2100 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid year.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.submitted_at DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_list
  FROM (
    SELECT
      p.id, p."timestamp" AS submitted_at, p."timestamp" AS timestamp,
      p.employee_id, p.employee_id AS nik,
      UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(k.nama),''),NULLIF(BTRIM(p.nama),''),'')) AS nama,
      p.kode_cuti, COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p.keterangan_cuti),''),p.kode_cuti) AS keterangan_cuti,
      p.tanggal_mulai, p.tanggal_selesai, p.total_hari, p.alasan, p.dokumen_path,
      p.status_atasan, p.status_hr, p.alasan_atasan, p.alasan_hr,
      p.timestamp_atasan, p.timestamp_hr, k.approval_line_name, k.approval_line_id,
      p.delegate_to, d.nama AS delegate_name
    FROM public.pengajuan_cuti p
    LEFT JOIN public.karyawan k ON UPPER(BTRIM(k.employee_id))=UPPER(BTRIM(p.employee_id))
    LEFT JOIN public.karyawan d ON d.employee_id=p.delegate_to
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM COALESCE(p.tanggal_mulai,p.tanggal_selesai,p."timestamp"::date))::integer=p_year
      AND (UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,'')) IN ('HR','ADMIN','SUPERADMIN') OR k.approval_line_id=v_emp.employee_id)
  ) r;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'list',v_list);
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: hr_get_my_attendance_dayoff_context(text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hr_get_my_attendance_dayoff_context(p_token text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_today date := (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::date;
  v_branch text;
  v_type text;
  v_dow smallint;
  v_workday boolean;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  SELECT h.branch INTO v_branch
  FROM public.attendance_employee_branch_history h
  WHERE h.employee_id = v_emp.employee_id
    AND h.effective_from <= v_today
    AND (h.effective_to IS NULL OR h.effective_to >= v_today)
  ORDER BY h.effective_from DESC LIMIT 1;
  v_branch := coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_branch),''), nullif(btrim(v_emp.branch),''));
  IF v_branch IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'verified', false, 'message', 'Branch belum dapat diverifikasi.');
  END IF;
  v_type := public.attendance_resolved_day_type(v_today, v_branch);
  IF v_type IN ('SUNDAY','NATIONAL_HOLIDAY','JOINT_LEAVE','DAY_OFF') THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'verified', true, 'is_off', true,
      'date', v_today, 'branch', v_branch, 'day_type', v_type);
  END IF;
  v_dow := extract(isodow FROM v_today)::smallint;
  -- Mirror attendance_capture_schedule_snapshot(): when Sunday is explicitly
  -- overridden to WORKING_DAY, use the latest normal Mon-Sat work rule.
  IF v_type = 'WORKING_DAY' AND v_dow = 7 THEN
    SELECT r.is_workday INTO v_workday
    FROM public.attendance_schedule_rules r
    WHERE lower(btrim(r.branch)) = lower(btrim(v_branch))
      AND r.day_of_week BETWEEN 1 AND 6
      AND r.is_workday = TRUE
      AND r.effective_from <= v_today
      AND (r.effective_to IS NULL OR r.effective_to >= v_today)
    ORDER BY r.effective_from DESC, r.day_of_week
    LIMIT 1;
  ELSE
    SELECT r.is_workday INTO v_workday
    FROM public.attendance_schedule_rules r
    WHERE lower(btrim(r.branch)) = lower(btrim(v_branch))
      AND r.day_of_week = v_dow
      AND r.effective_from <= v_today
      AND (r.effective_to IS NULL OR r.effective_to >= v_today)
    ORDER BY r.effective_from DESC
    LIMIT 1;
  END IF;
  IF v_workday IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'verified', false, 'message', 'Jadwal kerja hari ini belum dapat diverifikasi.');
  END IF;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'verified', true, 'is_off', NOT v_workday,
    'date', v_today, 'branch', v_branch, 'day_type', v_type);
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: hr_get_my_reimbursement_balance(text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hr_get_my_reimbursement_balance(p_token text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_today date := (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta')::date;
  v_start date; v_end date; v_e_limit numeric(14,2); v_t_limit numeric(14,2);
  v_e_approved numeric(14,2); v_e_pending numeric(14,2); v_t_approved numeric(14,2); v_t_pending numeric(14,2);
  v_e_spent numeric(14,2); v_e_reserved numeric(14,2); v_t_spent numeric(14,2); v_t_reserved numeric(14,2);
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF upper(coalesce(v_emp.job_code,'')) <> 'HYBRID' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Modul reimbursement hanya tersedia untuk karyawan HYBRID.' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  SELECT entertain_limit,transport_limit INTO v_e_limit,v_t_limit FROM public.incentive_reimbursement_limits WHERE id=1;
  SELECT b.period_start,b.period_end INTO v_start,v_end FROM public.hr_reimbursement_period_bounds(v_today) b;
  SELECT coalesce(sum(amount),0) INTO v_e_approved FROM public.hr_reimbursement_requests
    WHERE employee_id=v_emp.employee_id AND category='ENTERTAIN' AND period_start=v_start AND status='DISETUJUI';
  SELECT coalesce(sum(amount),0) INTO v_e_pending FROM public.hr_reimbursement_requests
    WHERE employee_id=v_emp.employee_id AND category='ENTERTAIN' AND period_start=v_start AND status IN ('PENDING_ATASAN','PENDING_HR');
  SELECT coalesce(sum(amount),0) INTO v_t_approved FROM public.hr_reimbursement_requests
    WHERE employee_id=v_emp.employee_id AND category='TRANSPORT' AND period_start=v_start AND status='DISETUJUI';
  SELECT coalesce(sum(amount),0) INTO v_t_pending FROM public.hr_reimbursement_requests
    WHERE employee_id=v_emp.employee_id AND category='TRANSPORT' AND period_start=v_start AND status IN ('PENDING_ATASAN','PENDING_HR');
  v_e_spent:=least(v_e_limit,v_e_approved); v_e_reserved:=least(v_e_pending,greatest(0,v_e_limit-v_e_spent));
  v_t_spent:=least(v_t_limit,v_t_approved); v_t_reserved:=least(v_t_pending,greatest(0,v_t_limit-v_t_spent));
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,'period',jsonb_build_object('start_date',v_start,'end_date',v_end),
    'entertain',jsonb_build_object('budget',v_e_limit,'spent',v_e_spent,'pending_reserved',v_e_reserved,'available',greatest(0,v_e_limit-v_e_spent-v_e_reserved)),
    'transport',jsonb_build_object('budget',v_t_limit,'spent',v_t_spent,'pending_reserved',v_t_reserved,'available',greatest(0,v_t_limit-v_t_spent-v_t_reserved))
  );
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: hr_get_my_reimbursement_requests(text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hr_get_my_reimbursement_requests(p_token text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE v_emp public.karyawan; v_rows jsonb; v_entertain_limit numeric(14,2); v_transport_limit numeric(14,2);
BEGIN
  v_emp:=public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF upper(coalesce(v_emp.job_code,''))<>'HYBRID' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Modul reimbursement hanya tersedia untuk karyawan HYBRID.' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  SELECT entertain_limit,transport_limit INTO v_entertain_limit,v_transport_limit FROM public.incentive_reimbursement_limits WHERE id=1;
  WITH active_rows AS (
    SELECT r.*,
      sum(CASE WHEN r.status IN ('PENDING_ATASAN','PENDING_HR','DISETUJUI') THEN r.amount ELSE 0 END)
        OVER(PARTITION BY r.employee_id,r.category,r.period_start ORDER BY r.created_at,r.id
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total
    FROM public.hr_reimbursement_requests r
    WHERE r.employee_id=v_emp.employee_id
      AND r.status IN ('PENDING_ATASAN','PENDING_HR','DISETUJUI','DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR')
  )
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',a.id,'category',a.category,'request_date',a.request_date,'amount',a.amount,'note',a.note,
    'attachment_path',a.attachment_path,'status',a.status,'period_start',a.period_start,'period_end',a.period_end,
    'over_budget_amount',CASE WHEN a.status IN ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR') THEN 0 ELSE
      GREATEST(0,a.running_total-CASE WHEN a.category='ENTERTAIN' THEN v_entertain_limit ELSE v_transport_limit END)
      - GREATEST(0,a.running_total-a.amount-CASE WHEN a.category='ENTERTAIN' THEN v_entertain_limit ELSE v_transport_limit END) END,
    'manager_note',a.manager_note,'hr_note',a.hr_note,'created_at',a.created_at
  ) ORDER BY a.created_at DESC),'[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_rows FROM active_rows a;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'requests',v_rows);
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: hr_get_my_timeoff_clockin_guard(text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hr_get_my_timeoff_clockin_guard(p_token text) RETURNS jsonb
