  IF TG_OP IN ('UPDATE','DELETE') THEN v_old := to_jsonb(OLD); END IF;
  IF TG_OP IN ('INSERT','UPDATE') THEN v_new := to_jsonb(NEW); END IF;

  v_actor_id := NULLIF(current_setting('app.employee_id',true),'');
  v_actor_role := NULLIF(current_setting('app.hris_role',true),'');
  v_actor_id := COALESCE(
    v_actor_id,
    NULLIF(v_new->>'updated_by',''),
    NULLIF(v_new->>'updated_by_employee_id',''),
    NULLIF(v_new->>'created_by_employee_id',''),
    NULLIF(v_new->>'imported_by',''),
    NULLIF(v_new->>'changed_by',''),
    NULLIF(v_old->>'updated_by',''),
    NULLIF(v_old->>'updated_by_employee_id',''),
    NULLIF(v_old->>'created_by_employee_id',''),
    NULLIF(v_old->>'imported_by',''),
    NULLIF(v_old->>'changed_by','')
  );
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('absensi','pengajuan_cuti') THEN
    v_actor_id := COALESCE(v_actor_id,NULLIF(v_new->>'employee_id',''),NULLIF(v_old->>'employee_id',''));
  END IF;

  IF v_actor_role IS NULL AND v_actor_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT k.role INTO v_actor_role FROM public.karyawan k WHERE k.employee_id=v_actor_id LIMIT 1;
  END IF;
  IF v_actor_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT k.nama INTO v_actor_name FROM public.karyawan k WHERE k.employee_id=v_actor_id LIMIT 1;
  END IF;
  v_actor_id := COALESCE(v_actor_id,'SYSTEM');
  v_actor_role := COALESCE(v_actor_role,'SYSTEM');
  v_actor_name := COALESCE(v_actor_name,CASE WHEN v_actor_id='SYSTEM' THEN 'SYSTEM' ELSE v_actor_id END);

  v_target := COALESCE(
    NULLIF(v_new->>'employee_id',''),NULLIF(v_old->>'employee_id',''),
    NULLIF(v_new->>'branch',''),NULLIF(v_old->>'branch',''),
    NULLIF(v_new->>'key',''),NULLIF(v_old->>'key',''),
    NULLIF(v_new->>'kode',''),NULLIF(v_old->>'kode',''),
    NULLIF(v_new->>'scope_employee_id',''),NULLIF(v_old->>'scope_employee_id',''),
    NULLIF(v_new->>'config_key',''),NULLIF(v_old->>'config_key',''),
    NULLIF(v_new->>'id',''),NULLIF(v_old->>'id','')
  );

  SELECT string_agg(j.key, ', ' ORDER BY j.key)
    INTO v_changed
  FROM jsonb_object_keys(CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN v_old ELSE v_new END) AS j(key)
  WHERE (v_new->j.key) IS DISTINCT FROM (v_old->j.key)
    AND j.key NOT IN (
      'created_at','updated_at','last_seen_at','last_login_at','failed_login','locked_until',
      'pin_hash','must_change_pin','face','face_version','face_updated_at','face_photo','face_photo_ver',
      'user_agent','token_hash','session_id','config','value','reason','description','source_url',
      'alamat','latitude','longitude','address','ktp_number','npwp','bpjs_kesehatan',
      'bpjs_ketenagakerjaan','bank_account','phone','email','birth_date','place_of_birth'
    );

  -- Pembacaan row-level hanya untuk tabel yang memang dipasangi trigger berikut.
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='absensi' THEN
    v_module := 'ABSENSI';
    IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
      v_action := 'ATTENDANCE_SUBMITTED';
      v_detail := format('%s · %s · %s · %s',
        CASE COALESCE(v_new->>'tipe','') WHEN 'MASUK' THEN 'Clock In' WHEN 'PULANG' THEN 'Clock Out' ELSE 'Presensi' END,
        COALESCE(v_new->>'tanggal',''),
        CASE WHEN COALESCE((v_new->>'outside_location')::boolean,FALSE) THEN COALESCE(v_new->>'area','Area luar') ELSE 'Kantor' END,
        COALESCE(v_new->>'status_approval','PENDING'));
    ELSE
      IF v_new->>'status_approval' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v_old->>'status_approval' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
      v_action := 'ATTENDANCE_APPROVAL_STATUS_CHANGED';
      v_detail := format('Status persetujuan presensi: %s → %s',COALESCE(v_old->>'status_approval','-'),COALESCE(v_new->>'status_approval','-'));
    END IF;
    v_target := COALESCE(v_new->>'id',v_old->>'id',v_target);

  ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='pengajuan_cuti' THEN
    v_module := 'CUTI';
    IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
      v_action := 'TIME_OFF_SUBMITTED';
      v_detail := format('%s · %s s.d. %s · %s',
        COALESCE(v_new->>'kode_cuti','Time Off'),
        COALESCE(v_new->>'tanggal_mulai',''),
        COALESCE(v_new->>'tanggal_selesai',''),
        COALESCE(v_new->>'status_atasan','PENDING')||'/'||COALESCE(v_new->>'status_hr','PENDING'));
    ELSE
      IF v_new->>'status_atasan' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v_old->>'status_atasan'
         AND v_new->>'status_hr' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v_old->>'status_hr' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
      v_action := 'TIME_OFF_APPROVAL_STATUS_CHANGED';
      v_detail := format('Status persetujuan Time Off: %s/%s → %s/%s',
        COALESCE(v_old->>'status_atasan','PENDING'),COALESCE(v_old->>'status_hr','PENDING'),
        COALESCE(v_new->>'status_atasan','PENDING'),COALESCE(v_new->>'status_hr','PENDING'));
    END IF;
    v_target := COALESCE(v_new->>'id',v_old->>'id',v_target);

  ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='karyawan' THEN
    v_module := 'KARYAWAN';
    IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND (v_changed IS NULL OR v_changed='') THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
    -- hr_set_role sudah menulis log peran tersendiri; hindari duplikasi event
    -- trigger untuk update yang hanya mengubah role.
    IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND v_changed='role' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
    v_action := CASE TG_OP WHEN 'INSERT' THEN 'EMPLOYEE_CREATED' WHEN 'DELETE' THEN 'EMPLOYEE_DELETED' ELSE 'EMPLOYEE_PROFILE_UPDATED' END;
    v_target := COALESCE(v_new->>'employee_id',v_old->>'employee_id',v_target);
    v_detail := CASE TG_OP
      WHEN 'INSERT' THEN 'Data karyawan dibuat.'
      WHEN 'DELETE' THEN 'Data karyawan dihapus.'
      ELSE 'Data karyawan diperbarui. Field: '||COALESCE(v_changed,'-')
    END;

  ELSE
    v_module := 'PENGATURAN';
    v_action := CASE TG_OP WHEN 'INSERT' THEN 'HRIS_SETTING_CREATED' WHEN 'DELETE' THEN 'HRIS_SETTING_DELETED' ELSE 'HRIS_SETTING_UPDATED' END;
    v_detail := CASE TG_TABLE_NAME
      WHEN 'lokasi_kantor' THEN 'Pengaturan lokasi kantor berubah. Cabang='||COALESCE(v_target,'-')||'; status='||COALESCE(CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN v_old->>'status' ELSE v_new->>'status' END,'-')||'; radius_m='||COALESCE(CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN v_old->>'radius_m' ELSE v_new->>'radius_m' END,'-')
      WHEN 'attendance_schedule_rules' THEN 'Aturan jadwal presensi berubah. Cabang='||COALESCE(CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN v_old->>'branch' ELSE v_new->>'branch' END,'-')||'; hari='||COALESCE(CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN v_old->>'day_of_week' ELSE v_new->>'day_of_week' END,'-')||'; shift='||COALESCE(CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN v_old->>'shift_code' ELSE v_new->>'shift_code' END,'-')||'; fields='||COALESCE(v_changed,'-')
      WHEN 'attendance_calendar_overrides' THEN 'Kalender presensi berubah. Tanggal='||COALESCE(CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN v_old->>'calendar_date' ELSE v_new->>'calendar_date' END,'-')||'; tipe='||COALESCE(CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN v_old->>'day_type' ELSE v_new->>'day_type' END,'-')||'; fields='||COALESCE(v_changed,'-')
      WHEN 'attendance_calendar_source_days' THEN 'Sumber hari libur diperbarui. Tanggal='||COALESCE(CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN v_old->>'calendar_date' ELSE v_new->>'calendar_date' END,'-')||'; nama='||COALESCE(CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN v_old->>'name' ELSE v_new->>'name' END,'-')||'; fields='||COALESCE(v_changed,'-')
      WHEN 'master_cuti' THEN 'Master Time Off berubah. Kode='||COALESCE(v_target,'-')||'; status='||COALESCE(CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN v_old->>'status' ELSE v_new->>'status' END,'-')||'; fields='||COALESCE(v_changed,'-')
      WHEN 'settings' THEN 'Kunci konfigurasi '||COALESCE(v_target,'-')||' berubah; isi nilai tidak disalin ke log.'
      WHEN 'incentive_formula_versions' THEN 'Versi formula insentif berubah. Versi='||COALESCE(CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN v_old->>'version_no' ELSE v_new->>'version_no' END,'-')||'; effective_from='||COALESCE(CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN v_old->>'effective_from' ELSE v_new->>'effective_from' END,'-')||'; isi formula tidak disalin ke log.'
      WHEN 'incentive_signatory_configs' THEN 'Konfigurasi penandatangan insentif berubah. Scope='||COALESCE(v_target,'-')
      WHEN 'incentive_employee_exclusions' THEN 'Status pengecualian insentif karyawan berubah. Karyawan='||COALESCE(v_target,'-')||'; excluded='||COALESCE(CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN v_old->>'is_excluded' ELSE v_new->>'is_excluded' END,'-')
      WHEN 'photo_retention_config' THEN 'Konfigurasi retensi foto berubah. Key='||COALESCE(v_target,'-')||'; nilai tanggal tidak disalin ke log.'
      ELSE 'Perubahan konfigurasi HRIS pada tabel '||TG_TABLE_NAME||'. Field: '||COALESCE(v_changed,'-')
    END;
    -- Data actor disuplai oleh fungsi RPC. Bila tabel ini diubah langsung oleh
    -- job sistem, log akan diberi actor SYSTEM (bukan identitas palsu).
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.activity_log(employee_id,nama,role,action,module,target,detail,status)
  VALUES(v_actor_id,v_actor_name,v_actor_role,v_action,v_module,v_target,v_detail,v_status);

  IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: FUNCTION hris_activity_row_audit(); Type: COMMENT; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.hris_activity_row_audit() IS 'Safe row-level activity audit for core HRIS employee actions and backend-affecting configuration changes.';

    contract_start_date date,
    place_of_birth text,

    religion text,
    CONSTRAINT karyawan_role_allowed_v13_chk CHECK ((upper(COALESCE(role, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['KARYAWAN'::text, 'HR'::text, 'ADMIN'::text, 'SUPERADMIN'::text]))),
    CONSTRAINT karyawan_role_check CHECK ((role = ANY (ARRAY['KARYAWAN'::text, 'HR'::text, 'ADMIN'::text, 'SUPERADMIN'::text]))),
    CONSTRAINT karyawan_status_akun_check CHECK ((status_akun = ANY (ARRAY['AKTIF'::text, 'NONAKTIF'::text])))
);

--
-- Name: hris_assert_incentive_reader(text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hris_assert_incentive_reader(p_token text) RETURNS public.karyawan
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE v_emp public.karyawan;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF upper(coalesce(v_emp.role,'')) NOT IN ('HR','ADMIN','SUPERADMIN') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Akses rekap insentif hanya untuk HR/Admin/Superadmin.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN v_emp;
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: hris_calculate_remaining_leave(text, integer, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hris_calculate_remaining_leave(p_employee_id text, p_year integer, p_kode_cuti text) RETURNS integer
    LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
  SELECT GREATEST(0, COALESCE(m.kuota_tahunan, 0) - COALESCE((
    SELECT SUM(COALESCE(c.total_hari, 0))::integer
    FROM public.pengajuan_cuti c
    WHERE c.employee_id = p_employee_id
      AND c.kode_cuti = p_kode_cuti
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.tanggal_mulai)::integer = p_year
      AND c.status_atasan = 'DISETUJUI'
      AND c.status_hr = 'DISETUJUI'
  ), 0))::integer
  FROM public.master_cuti m WHERE m.kode = p_kode_cuti;
$$;


--
-- Name: hris_incentive_calculate(date, date, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hris_incentive_calculate(p_start_date date, p_end_date date, p_employee_id text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_formula public.incentive_formula_versions%ROWTYPE;
  v_records jsonb;
  v_cfg jsonb;
  v_reimbursement_entertain_limit numeric(14,2);
  v_reimbursement_transport_limit numeric(14,2);
BEGIN
  IF p_start_date IS NULL OR p_end_date IS NULL OR p_start_date > p_end_date
     OR (p_end_date - p_start_date) > 62 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Rentang periode insentif tidak valid (maksimal 63 hari inklusif).' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO v_formula
  FROM public.incentive_formula_versions
  WHERE effective_from <= p_end_date
  ORDER BY effective_from DESC, version_no DESC
  LIMIT 1;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Belum ada formula yang efektif untuk periode ini. Simpan formula backend terlebih dahulu.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;
  v_cfg := v_formula.config;
  SELECT entertain_limit,transport_limit INTO v_reimbursement_entertain_limit,v_reimbursement_transport_limit
  FROM public.incentive_reimbursement_limits WHERE id=1;

  WITH employees AS (
    SELECT k.employee_id, k.nama, k.branch, k.organization, k.job_position, k.job_code, k.bank_name, k.bank_account, k.join_date, k.contract_end_date
    FROM public.karyawan k
    WHERE k.status_akun = 'AKTIF'
      AND (p_employee_id IS NULL OR k.employee_id = p_employee_id)
  
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.incentive_employee_exclusions AS exclusion
        WHERE exclusion.employee_id = k.employee_id
          AND exclusion.is_excluded = true
      )
), raw_events AS (
    SELECT a.*
    FROM public.absensi a
    JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = a.employee_id
    WHERE a.tanggal BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
  ), daily0 AS (
    SELECT
      a.employee_id, a.tanggal,
      min(a.jam) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='MASUK' AND a.status_approval IN ('VALID','DISETUJUI')) AS clock_in,
      max(a.jam) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='PULANG' AND a.status_approval IN ('VALID','DISETUJUI')) AS clock_out,
      max(a.status_approval) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='MASUK' AND a.status_approval IN ('VALID','DISETUJUI')) AS clock_in_status,
      max(a.status_approval) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='PULANG' AND a.status_approval IN ('VALID','DISETUJUI')) AS clock_out_status,
      bool_or(a.tipe='MASUK' AND a.status_approval IN ('VALID','DISETUJUI')) AS valid_clock_in,
      bool_or(a.tipe='PULANG' AND a.status_approval IN ('VALID','DISETUJUI')) AS valid_clock_out,
      bool_or(a.status_approval IN ('VALID','DISETUJUI')) AS any_final,
      bool_or(a.status_approval IN ('PENDING_ATASAN','PENDING_HR')) AS has_pending,
      bool_or(a.status_approval IN ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR')) AS has_rejected,
      bool_or(a.outside_location) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='MASUK' AND a.status_approval IN ('VALID','DISETUJUI')) AS clock_in_outside,
      bool_or(a.outside_location) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='PULANG' AND a.status_approval IN ('VALID','DISETUJUI')) AS clock_out_outside,
      -- Prefer Clock In area, otherwise accept approved Clock Out area.
      COALESCE(
        max(a.area) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='MASUK' AND a.status_approval IN ('VALID','DISETUJUI') AND a.outside_location IS TRUE AND a.area IS NOT NULL),
        max(a.area) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='PULANG' AND a.status_approval IN ('VALID','DISETUJUI') AND a.outside_location IS TRUE AND a.area IS NOT NULL)
      ) AS area,
      count(DISTINCT a.area) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe IN ('MASUK','PULANG') AND a.status_approval IN ('VALID','DISETUJUI') AND a.outside_location IS TRUE AND a.area IS NOT NULL) AS area_count,
      substring(max(a.catatan) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='MASUK' AND a.status_approval IN ('VALID','DISETUJUI'))
        FROM '\[\[RHATT=(P[1-5]?|SDL[1-5]|SDLL)\]\]') AS attendance_marker,
      max(a.punctuality_status) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='MASUK' AND a.status_approval IN ('VALID','DISETUJUI')) AS punctuality_status,
      max(a.scheduled_check_in_snapshot) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='MASUK' AND a.status_approval IN ('VALID','DISETUJUI')) AS scheduled_check_in,
      max(a.late_tolerance_minutes_snapshot) FILTER (WHERE a.tipe='MASUK' AND a.status_approval IN ('VALID','DISETUJUI')) AS late_tolerance_minutes,
      count(*) AS event_count,
      string_agg(DISTINCT a.status_approval, ', ' ORDER BY a.status_approval) AS statuses
    FROM raw_events a
    GROUP BY a.employee_id, a.tanggal
  ), sick_outside_days AS (
    SELECT c.employee_id::text AS employee_id, g.dt::date AS tanggal,
      NULL::time AS clock_in, NULL::time AS clock_out,
      NULL::text AS clock_in_status, NULL::text AS clock_out_status,
      FALSE AS valid_clock_in, FALSE AS valid_clock_out, FALSE AS any_final,
      FALSE AS has_pending, FALSE AS has_rejected,
      FALSE AS clock_in_outside, FALSE AS clock_out_outside,
      c.area_sakit::text AS area, 1::bigint AS area_count,
      NULL::text AS attendance_marker, NULL::text AS punctuality_status,
      NULL::time AS scheduled_check_in, NULL::integer AS late_tolerance_minutes,
      0::bigint AS event_count, 'APPROVED_SDR_DL'::text AS statuses,
      TRUE AS sick_outside
    FROM public.pengajuan_cuti c
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(c.tanggal_mulai,c.tanggal_selesai,interval '1 day') g(dt)
    JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id=c.employee_id
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT COALESCE((
        SELECT bh.branch
        FROM public.attendance_employee_branch_history bh
        WHERE bh.employee_id=c.employee_id
          AND bh.effective_from<=g.dt::date
          AND (bh.effective_to IS NULL OR bh.effective_to>=g.dt::date)
        ORDER BY bh.effective_from DESC LIMIT 1
      ), NULLIF(BTRIM(e.branch),''), 'Pusat') AS day_branch
    ) branch_at_day
    JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT sr.is_workday
      FROM public.attendance_schedule_rules sr
      WHERE LOWER(BTRIM(sr.branch))=LOWER(BTRIM(branch_at_day.day_branch))
        AND sr.effective_from<=g.dt::date
        AND (sr.effective_to IS NULL OR sr.effective_to>=g.dt::date)
        AND (
          public.attendance_resolved_day_type(g.dt::date,branch_at_day.day_branch) NOT IN ('SUNDAY','NATIONAL_HOLIDAY','DAY_OFF')
          OR (EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM g.dt::date)::integer=7
              AND public.attendance_resolved_day_type(g.dt::date,branch_at_day.day_branch)='WORKING_DAY')
        )
        AND (
          sr.day_of_week=EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM g.dt::date)::integer
          OR (EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM g.dt::date)::integer=7
              AND public.attendance_resolved_day_type(g.dt::date,branch_at_day.day_branch)='WORKING_DAY'
              AND sr.day_of_week BETWEEN 1 AND 6 AND sr.is_workday=TRUE)
        )
        AND NOT (
          EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM g.dt::date)::integer=7
          AND public.attendance_resolved_day_type(g.dt::date,branch_at_day.day_branch)='WORKING_DAY'
          AND sr.day_of_week=7 AND sr.is_workday=FALSE
        )
      ORDER BY CASE WHEN sr.day_of_week=EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM g.dt::date)::integer THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
               sr.effective_from DESC,sr.day_of_week
      LIMIT 1
    ) schedule_for_day ON schedule_for_day.is_workday=TRUE
    WHERE c.kode_cuti='SDR' AND c.dinas_luar_sakit IS TRUE
      AND c.area_sakit IN ('Area 1','Area 2','Area 3','Area 4','Area lainnya')
      AND c.status_atasan='DISETUJUI' AND c.status_hr='DISETUJUI'
      AND g.dt::date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM daily0 d WHERE d.employee_id=c.employee_id AND d.tanggal=g.dt::date)
  ), daily_seed AS (
    SELECT d.*,
      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.pengajuan_cuti c WHERE c.employee_id=d.employee_id
        AND c.kode_cuti='SDR' AND c.dinas_luar_sakit IS TRUE AND c.area_sakit IS NOT NULL
        AND c.status_atasan='DISETUJUI' AND c.status_hr='DISETUJUI'
        AND c.tanggal_mulai<=d.tanggal AND c.tanggal_selesai>=d.tanggal) AS sick_outside,
      COALESCE((SELECT c.area_sakit FROM public.pengajuan_cuti c WHERE c.employee_id=d.employee_id
        AND c.kode_cuti='SDR' AND c.dinas_luar_sakit IS TRUE AND c.area_sakit IS NOT NULL
        AND c.status_atasan='DISETUJUI' AND c.status_hr='DISETUJUI'
        AND c.tanggal_mulai<=d.tanggal AND c.tanggal_selesai>=d.tanggal
        ORDER BY c.tanggal_mulai DESC, c."timestamp" DESC LIMIT 1),d.area) AS effective_area
    FROM daily0 d
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sd.*, sd.area AS effective_area FROM sick_outside_days sd
  ), day0 AS (
    SELECT d.*,
      CASE WHEN d.sick_outside THEN TRUE
           WHEN d.effective_area='Surabaya & Sekitarnya' THEN FALSE
           ELSE (coalesce(d.clock_in_outside,false) OR coalesce(d.clock_out_outside,false)) END AS outside_flag,
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.pengajuan_cuti c
        WHERE c.employee_id=d.employee_id
          AND c.status_atasan='DISETUJUI' AND c.status_hr='DISETUJUI'
          AND c.tanggal_mulai <= d.tanggal AND c.tanggal_selesai >= d.tanggal
          AND NOT (d.sick_outside AND c.kode_cuti='SDR' AND c.dinas_luar_sakit IS TRUE AND c.area_sakit=d.effective_area)
      ) AS timeoff_conflict
    FROM daily_seed d
  ), classified AS (
    SELECT d.*,
      CASE
        WHEN d.sick_outside AND d.effective_area='Area 1' THEN 'SDR-DL1'
        WHEN d.sick_outside AND d.effective_area='Area 2' THEN 'SDR-DL2'
        WHEN d.sick_outside AND d.effective_area='Area 3' THEN 'SDR-DL3'
        WHEN d.sick_outside AND d.effective_area='Area 4' THEN 'SDR-DL4'
        WHEN d.sick_outside AND d.effective_area='Area lainnya' THEN 'SDR-DLL'
        WHEN d.attendance_marker IS NOT NULL THEN d.attendance_marker
        WHEN d.outside_flag AND d.effective_area='Area 1' THEN 'DL1'
        WHEN d.outside_flag AND d.effective_area='Area 2' THEN 'DL2'
        WHEN d.outside_flag AND d.effective_area='Area 3' THEN 'DL3'
        WHEN d.outside_flag AND d.effective_area='Area 4' THEN 'DL4'
        WHEN d.outside_flag AND d.effective_area='Area lainnya' THEN 'DL5'
        WHEN d.any_final THEN 'H'
        ELSE '—'
      END AS attendance_code,
      CASE d.effective_area
        WHEN 'Area 1' THEN 'AREA 1' WHEN 'Area 2' THEN 'AREA 2'
        WHEN 'Area 3' THEN 'AREA 3' WHEN 'Area 4' THEN 'AREA 4'
        WHEN 'Area lainnya' THEN 'AREA LAIN' ELSE NULL END AS area_rate_key,
      CASE
        WHEN d.punctuality_status IN ('EARLY','ON_TIME') THEN TRUE
        WHEN d.punctuality_status='LATE' THEN FALSE
        WHEN d.clock_in IS NOT NULL AND d.scheduled_check_in IS NOT NULL
          AND d.late_tolerance_minutes IS NOT NULL
          THEN d.clock_in <= (d.scheduled_check_in + make_interval(mins => d.late_tolerance_minutes))::time
        ELSE FALSE
      END AS on_time_by_snapshot
    FROM day0 d
  ), rated AS (
    SELECT c.*,
      CASE WHEN c.sick_outside OR (c.attendance_code IN ('SDL1','SDL2','SDL3','SDL4','SDL5','SDLL')
                 AND coalesce((v_cfg->'eligibility'->>'standby_as_outside')::boolean,true))
          OR (c.outside_flag AND c.attendance_code IN ('DL1','DL2','DL3','DL4','DL5'))
        THEN NULLIF(v_cfg->'outside_rates'->c.area_rate_key->>upper(coalesce(e.job_code,'')),'')::numeric
        ELSE NULL END AS outside_rate,
      (NOT c.sick_outside AND (c.attendance_marker = 'P' OR c.attendance_marker IN ('P1','P2','P3','P4','P5'))) AS is_picket,
      (NOT c.sick_outside AND c.attendance_marker IN ('SDL1','SDL2','SDL3','SDL4','SDL5','SDLL')) AS is_standby,
      (c.any_final AND NOT c.timeoff_conflict AND NOT c.sick_outside) AS attendance_eligible,
      (c.any_final AND NOT c.timeoff_conflict AND NOT c.sick_outside AND NOT c.outside_flag
        AND coalesce(c.attendance_marker,'') NOT IN ('P1','P2','P3','P4','P5','SDL1','SDL2','SDL3','SDL4','SDL5','SDLL')) AS transport_eligible,
      (c.any_final AND NOT c.timeoff_conflict AND NOT c.sick_outside) AS phone_eligible,
      (c.valid_clock_in AND NOT c.timeoff_conflict AND NOT c.sick_outside AND NOT c.outside_flag
        AND c.on_time_by_snapshot) AS meal_eligible,
      ((c.sick_outside OR c.any_final) AND NOT c.timeoff_conflict AND (c.sick_outside OR c.area_count <= 1)
        AND (c.sick_outside OR c.outside_flag) AND c.area_rate_key IS NOT NULL
        AND (c.sick_outside OR c.attendance_code IN ('DL1','DL2','DL3','DL4','DL5')
          OR (c.attendance_code IN ('SDL1','SDL2','SDL3','SDL4','SDL5','SDLL')
            AND coalesce((v_cfg->'eligibility'->>'standby_as_outside')::boolean,true)))) AS outside_eligible,
      CASE
        WHEN NOT c.sick_outside AND c.clock_in IS NOT NULL AND c.clock_out IS NOT NULL AND c.clock_out > c.clock_in
         AND c.clock_in_status='DISETUJUI' AND c.clock_out_status IN ('VALID','DISETUJUI')
         AND NOT c.timeoff_conflict AND c.area_count <= 1
         AND ((c.attendance_marker='P' AND (NOT coalesce(c.clock_in_outside,false) OR c.effective_area='Surabaya & Sekitarnya'))
           OR (c.attendance_marker IN ('P1','P2','P3','P4','P5') AND coalesce(c.clock_in_outside,false)))
        THEN CASE
          WHEN floor(extract(epoch FROM (c.clock_out-c.clock_in))/3600)::integer >= coalesce((v_cfg->>'piket_min_hours')::integer,4)
          THEN least(coalesce((v_cfg->>'piket_max_hours')::integer,8),
               floor(extract(epoch FROM (c.clock_out-c.clock_in))/3600)::integer)
          ELSE 0
        END
        ELSE 0
      END AS picket_paid_hours
    FROM classified c
    JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id=c.employee_id
  ), daily_calc AS (
    SELECT r.*, e.nama, e.branch, e.organization, e.job_position, e.job_code,
      CASE WHEN r.meal_eligible THEN
        CASE WHEN upper(coalesce(e.job_code,''))='OB' THEN coalesce((v_cfg->>'meal_ob')::numeric,0)
             ELSE coalesce((v_cfg->>'meal_other')::numeric,0) END
      ELSE 0 END AS meal_amount_day,
      CASE WHEN r.outside_eligible AND r.outside_rate IS NOT NULL THEN r.outside_rate ELSE 0 END AS outside_amount_day,
      CASE WHEN r.is_picket AND r.picket_paid_hours >= coalesce((v_cfg->>'piket_min_hours')::integer,4)
        THEN r.picket_paid_hours * coalesce((v_cfg->>'piket_hourly_rate')::numeric,15000) ELSE 0 END AS picket_amount_day,
      (r.is_picket AND r.picket_paid_hours >= coalesce((v_cfg->>'piket_min_hours')::integer,4)) AS picket_eligible,
      array_remove(ARRAY[
        CASE WHEN r.timeoff_conflict THEN 'Konflik: ada absensi pada tanggal Time Off final; hari dikecualikan.' END,
        CASE WHEN r.area_count > 1 AND NOT r.sick_outside THEN 'Konflik area: lebih dari satu Area pada tanggal yang sama; tarif area dan Piket dikecualikan.' END,
        CASE WHEN r.has_pending THEN 'Ada event absensi yang masih menunggu approval; event pending tidak dihitung.' END,
        CASE WHEN r.has_rejected THEN 'Ada event absensi yang ditolak; event tersebut tidak dihitung.' END,
        CASE WHEN r.outside_flag AND NOT r.sick_outside AND r.area IS NULL THEN 'Dinas luar tanpa Area tervalidasi pada Clock In/Clock Out; tarif DL tidak dihitung.' END,
        CASE WHEN r.sick_outside AND (r.outside_rate IS NULL OR r.outside_rate <= 0) THEN 'Tarif SDR-DL belum aktif: periksa kombinasi Area dan Kode Jabatan pada Formula Insentif.' END,
        CASE WHEN r.outside_eligible AND (r.outside_rate IS NULL OR r.outside_rate <= 0) THEN 'Tarif DL untuk kombinasi Area/Job Code kosong atau nol; nominal tidak dibayarkan.' END,
        CASE WHEN r.valid_clock_in AND r.clock_in IS NOT NULL AND r.punctuality_status IS NULL AND r.scheduled_check_in IS NULL THEN 'Uang makan tidak dihitung: snapshot jadwal masuk tidak tersedia.' END,
        CASE WHEN r.is_picket AND (r.clock_in IS NULL OR r.clock_out IS NULL) THEN 'Piket belum memiliki pasangan Clock In dan Clock Out; jam Piket belum dapat dihitung.' END,
        CASE WHEN r.is_picket AND r.clock_in IS NOT NULL AND r.clock_out IS NOT NULL AND r.clock_out <= r.clock_in THEN 'Durasi Piket tidak valid: Clock Out tidak setelah Clock In.' END,
        CASE WHEN r.is_picket AND r.clock_in IS NOT NULL AND r.clock_out IS NOT NULL AND r.clock_out > r.clock_in
          AND r.picket_paid_hours < coalesce((v_cfg->>'piket_min_hours')::integer,4) THEN 'Durasi Piket di bawah 4 jam; nominal Piket Rp0.' END,
        CASE WHEN r.is_picket AND r.clock_in_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'DISETUJUI' THEN 'Piket belum mendapat persetujuan final; nominal Piket tidak dihitung.' END,
        CASE WHEN nullif(btrim(e.job_code),'') IS NULL AND r.outside_flag THEN 'Job Code kosong; tarif dinas luar tidak dihitung.' END
      ], NULL) AS day_warnings
    FROM rated r JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id=r.employee_id
  ), period_calendar_base AS (
    SELECT e.employee_id, g.dt::date AS tanggal,
      COALESCE((
        SELECT bh.branch
        FROM public.attendance_employee_branch_history bh
        WHERE bh.employee_id=e.employee_id
          AND bh.effective_from<=g.dt::date
          AND (bh.effective_to IS NULL OR bh.effective_to>=g.dt::date)
        ORDER BY bh.effective_from DESC LIMIT 1
      ), NULLIF(BTRIM(e.branch),''), 'Pusat') AS day_branch
    FROM employees e
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(p_start_date,p_end_date,interval '1 day') g(dt)
    WHERE (e.join_date IS NULL OR g.dt::date>=e.join_date)
      AND (e.contract_end_date IS NULL OR g.dt::date<=e.contract_end_date)
  ), period_calendar AS (
    SELECT b.employee_id, b.tanggal, b.day_branch,
      public.attendance_resolved_day_type(b.tanggal,b.day_branch) AS day_type,
      COALESCE(schedule_for_day.is_workday,FALSE)
        AND public.attendance_resolved_day_type(b.tanggal,b.day_branch)
          NOT IN ('SUNDAY','NATIONAL_HOLIDAY','DAY_OFF') AS is_workday,
      (schedule_for_day.is_workday IS NOT NULL) AS schedule_known
    FROM period_calendar_base b
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT sr.is_workday
      FROM public.attendance_schedule_rules sr
      WHERE LOWER(BTRIM(sr.branch))=LOWER(BTRIM(b.day_branch))
        AND sr.effective_from<=b.tanggal
        AND (sr.effective_to IS NULL OR sr.effective_to>=b.tanggal)
        AND (
          public.attendance_resolved_day_type(b.tanggal,b.day_branch) NOT IN ('SUNDAY','NATIONAL_HOLIDAY','DAY_OFF')
          OR (EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM b.tanggal)::integer=7
              AND public.attendance_resolved_day_type(b.tanggal,b.day_branch)='WORKING_DAY')
        )
        AND (
          sr.day_of_week=EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM b.tanggal)::integer
          OR (EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM b.tanggal)::integer=7
              AND public.attendance_resolved_day_type(b.tanggal,b.day_branch)='WORKING_DAY'
              AND sr.day_of_week BETWEEN 1 AND 6 AND sr.is_workday=TRUE)
        )
        AND NOT (
          EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM b.tanggal)::integer=7
          AND public.attendance_resolved_day_type(b.tanggal,b.day_branch)='WORKING_DAY'
          AND sr.day_of_week=7 AND sr.is_workday=FALSE
        )
      ORDER BY CASE WHEN sr.day_of_week=EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM b.tanggal)::integer THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
               sr.effective_from DESC,sr.day_of_week
      LIMIT 1
    ) schedule_for_day ON TRUE
  ), period_day_flags AS (
    SELECT pc.employee_id, pc.tanggal, pc.day_branch, pc.day_type, pc.is_workday, pc.schedule_known,
      COALESCE(att.outside_attendance,FALSE) OR COALESCE(sick.sick_outside,FALSE) AS outside_day,
      COALESCE(att.home_branch_attendance,FALSE) AS home_return_day,
      COALESCE(att.special_dayoff_marker,FALSE) AS special_dayoff_marker,
      COALESCE(sick.sick_outside,FALSE) AS sick_outside_day
    FROM period_calendar pc
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT
        BOOL_OR(a.status_approval IN ('VALID','DISETUJUI') AND a.outside_location IS TRUE
          AND a.area IN ('Area 1','Area 2','Area 3','Area 4','Area lainnya')) AS outside_attendance,
        BOOL_OR(a.status_approval IN ('VALID','DISETUJUI')
          AND NULLIF(BTRIM(a.branch_target),'') IS NOT NULL
          AND LOWER(BTRIM(a.branch_target))=LOWER(BTRIM(pc.day_branch))
          AND COALESCE(a.outside_location,FALSE)=FALSE) AS home_branch_attendance,
        BOOL_OR(a.status_approval IN ('VALID','DISETUJUI')
          AND substring(COALESCE(a.catatan,'') FROM '\[\[RHATT=(P[1-5]?|SDL[1-5]|SDLL)\]\]') IS NOT NULL) AS special_dayoff_marker
      FROM raw_events a
      WHERE a.employee_id=pc.employee_id AND a.tanggal=pc.tanggal
    ) att ON TRUE
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.pengajuan_cuti c
        WHERE c.employee_id=pc.employee_id AND c.kode_cuti='SDR'
          AND c.dinas_luar_sakit IS TRUE
          AND c.area_sakit IN ('Area 1','Area 2','Area 3','Area 4','Area lainnya')
          AND c.status_atasan='DISETUJUI' AND c.status_hr='DISETUJUI'
          AND c.tanggal_mulai<=pc.tanggal AND c.tanggal_selesai>=pc.tanggal
      ) AS sick_outside
    ) sick ON TRUE
  ), employee_period_flags AS (
    SELECT e.employee_id,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.is_workday) AS scheduled_work_days,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.is_workday AND f.outside_day) AS outside_work_days,
      BOOL_OR(f.home_return_day) AS returned_home,
      COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'date',f.tanggal,'workday',f.is_workday,
        'sick_outside',f.sick_outside_day,
        'outside_day',f.outside_day,
        'home_return',f.home_return_day,
        'standby_or_picket',f.special_dayoff_marker
      ) ORDER BY f.tanggal) FILTER (
        WHERE f.is_workday
           OR (NOT f.is_workday AND (f.special_dayoff_marker OR f.sick_outside_day))
      ),'[]'::jsonb) AS family_trip_dates,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT f.is_workday AND (f.special_dayoff_marker OR f.sick_outside_day)) AS special_off_days,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.day_type NOT IN ('SUNDAY','NATIONAL_HOLIDAY','DAY_OFF') AND NOT f.schedule_known) AS schedule_unknown_days
    FROM employees e
    LEFT JOIN period_day_flags f ON f.employee_id=e.employee_id
    GROUP BY e.employee_id
  ), pm_pasuruan_daily AS (
    SELECT a.employee_id, a.tanggal
    FROM raw_events a
    JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id=a.employee_id
    WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(e.job_code,''))='PM'
      AND LOWER(BTRIM(COALESCE(a.branch_target,'')))='pasuruan'
      AND a.status_approval IN ('VALID','DISETUJUI')
      AND COALESCE(a.outside_location,FALSE)=FALSE
      AND a.tipe IN ('MASUK','PULANG')
    GROUP BY a.employee_id,a.tanggal
  ), pm_pasuruan_period AS (
    SELECT e.employee_id,
      COUNT(p.tanggal)::integer AS pasuruan_days,
      COALESCE(jsonb_agg(p.tanggal ORDER BY p.tanggal) FILTER (WHERE p.tanggal IS NOT NULL),'[]'::jsonb) AS pasuruan_dates
    FROM employees e
    LEFT JOIN pm_pasuruan_daily p ON p.employee_id=e.employee_id
    GROUP BY e.employee_id
  ), per_employee AS (
    SELECT e.employee_id, e.nama, e.branch, e.organization, e.job_position, e.job_code, e.bank_name, e.bank_account,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.attendance_eligible) AS attendance_days,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.meal_eligible) AS punctual_days,
      coalesce(sum(d.meal_amount_day),0)::numeric(18,0) AS meal_amount,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.transport_eligible) AS transport_days,
      CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.transport_eligible) >= coalesce((v_cfg->>'transport_threshold')::integer,25)
        THEN coalesce((v_cfg->>'transport_cap')::numeric,0)
        ELSE (count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.transport_eligible) * coalesce((v_cfg->>'transport_daily')::numeric,0)) END::numeric(18,0) AS transport_amount,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.phone_eligible) AS phone_days,
      CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.phone_eligible) >= coalesce((v_cfg->>'phone_threshold')::integer,25)
        THEN coalesce((v_cfg->>'phone_cap')::numeric,0)
        ELSE (count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.phone_eligible) * coalesce((v_cfg->>'phone_daily')::numeric,0)) END::numeric(18,0) AS phone_amount,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.outside_eligible) AS outside_days,
      coalesce(sum(d.outside_amount_day),0)::numeric(18,0) AS outside_amount,
      coalesce(sum(d.outside_amount_day) FILTER (WHERE d.area_rate_key='AREA 1'),0)::numeric(18,0) AS area_1_amount,
      coalesce(sum(d.outside_amount_day) FILTER (WHERE d.area_rate_key='AREA 2'),0)::numeric(18,0) AS area_2_amount,
      coalesce(sum(d.outside_amount_day) FILTER (WHERE d.area_rate_key='AREA 3'),0)::numeric(18,0) AS area_3_amount,
      coalesce(sum(d.outside_amount_day) FILTER (WHERE d.area_rate_key='AREA 4'),0)::numeric(18,0) AS area_4_amount,
      coalesce(sum(d.outside_amount_day) FILTER (WHERE d.area_rate_key='AREA LAIN'),0)::numeric(18,0) AS area_lain_amount,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.picket_eligible) AS picket_days,
      coalesce(sum(d.picket_paid_hours),0) AS picket_hours,
      coalesce(sum(d.picket_amount_day),0)::numeric(18,0) AS picket_amount,
      CASE WHEN COALESCE(epf.scheduled_work_days,0)>0
        AND epf.outside_work_days=epf.scheduled_work_days
        AND COALESCE(epf.schedule_unknown_days,0)=0
        AND COALESCE(epf.returned_home,FALSE)=FALSE
        THEN 360000 ELSE 0 END::numeric(18,0) AS family_trip_amount,
      CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(e.job_code,''))='PM' AND COALESCE(pp.pasuruan_days,0)>4
        THEN pp.pasuruan_days*80000 ELSE 0 END::numeric(18,0) AS extra_transport_amount,
      COALESCE(epf.scheduled_work_days,0) AS family_trip_scheduled_work_days,
      COALESCE(epf.outside_work_days,0) AS family_trip_outside_work_days,
      COALESCE(epf.returned_home,FALSE) AS returned_home,
      COALESCE(epf.family_trip_dates,'[]'::jsonb) AS family_trip_dates,
      COALESCE(epf.special_off_days,0) AS family_trip_special_off_days,
      COALESCE(epf.schedule_unknown_days,0) AS family_trip_schedule_unknown_days,
      COALESCE(pp.pasuruan_days,0) AS extra_transport_days,
      COALESCE(pp.pasuruan_dates,'[]'::jsonb) AS extra_transport_dates,
      coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'date', d.tanggal,
        'attendance_code', d.attendance_code,
        'clock_in', d.clock_in,
        'clock_out', d.clock_out,
        'clock_in_status', d.clock_in_status,
        'clock_out_status', d.clock_out_status,
        'area', d.effective_area,
        'outside_location', (coalesce(d.clock_in_outside,false) OR coalesce(d.clock_out_outside,false)),
        'punctuality_status', d.punctuality_status,
        'scheduled_check_in', d.scheduled_check_in,
        'late_tolerance_minutes', d.late_tolerance_minutes,
        'meal_eligible', d.meal_eligible,
        'meal_amount', d.meal_amount_day,
        'transport_eligible', d.transport_eligible,
        'phone_eligible', d.phone_eligible,
        'outside_eligible', d.outside_eligible,
        'outside_rate_key', d.area_rate_key,
        'outside_job_code', e.job_code,
        'outside_rate', d.outside_rate,
        'outside_rate_configured', (d.outside_rate IS NOT NULL AND d.outside_rate > 0),
        'outside_amount', d.outside_amount_day,
        'picket_hours_paid', d.picket_paid_hours,
        'picket_amount', d.picket_amount_day,
        'warnings', to_jsonb(d.day_warnings)
      ) ORDER BY d.tanggal) FILTER (WHERE d.event_count > 0 OR d.sick_outside), '[]'::jsonb) AS details,
      coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('date',d.tanggal,'warnings',to_jsonb(d.day_warnings)) ORDER BY d.tanggal)
        FILTER (WHERE cardinality(d.day_warnings)>0), '[]'::jsonb) AS warnings
    FROM employees e
    LEFT JOIN daily_calc d ON d.employee_id=e.employee_id
    LEFT JOIN employee_period_flags epf ON epf.employee_id=e.employee_id
    LEFT JOIN pm_pasuruan_period pp ON pp.employee_id=e.employee_id
    GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.nama, e.branch, e.organization, e.job_position, e.job_code,
      e.bank_name, e.bank_account, epf.scheduled_work_days, epf.outside_work_days,
      epf.returned_home, epf.family_trip_dates, epf.special_off_days, epf.schedule_unknown_days,
      pp.pasuruan_days, pp.pasuruan_dates
  )
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'employee_id', x.employee_id,
    'nama', x.nama,
    'branch', x.branch,
    'organization', x.organization,
    'job_position', x.job_position,
    'job_code', x.job_code,
    'bank_name', x.bank_name,
    'bank_account', x.bank_account,
    'attendance_days', x.attendance_days,
    'punctual_days', x.punctual_days,
    'meal_days', x.punctual_days,
    'meal_amount', x.meal_amount,
    'transport_days', x.transport_days,
    'transport_amount', x.transport_amount,
    'phone_days', x.phone_days,
    'phone_amount', x.phone_amount,
    'outside_days', x.outside_days,
    'outside_amount', x.outside_amount,
    'area_1_amount', x.area_1_amount,
    'area_2_amount', x.area_2_amount,
    'area_3_amount', x.area_3_amount,
    'area_4_amount', x.area_4_amount,
    'area_lain_amount', x.area_lain_amount,
    'family_trip_amount', x.family_trip_amount,
    'extra_transport_amount', x.extra_transport_amount,
    'underpayment_last_month_amount', COALESCE((
      SELECT u.amount
      FROM public.incentive_underpayments u
      WHERE u.employee_id=x.employee_id
        AND u.period_start=p_start_date
        AND u.period_end=p_end_date
      LIMIT 1
    ),0),
    'reimbursement_entertain_amount', COALESCE((
      SELECT SUM(a.amount) FROM public.hr_reimbursement_requests a
      WHERE a.employee_id=x.employee_id AND upper(coalesce(x.job_code,''))='HYBRID' AND a.category='ENTERTAIN'
        AND a.period_start=p_start_date AND a.period_end=p_end_date
        AND a.status='DISETUJUI'
    ),0),
    'reimbursement_transport_amount', COALESCE((
      SELECT SUM(a.amount) FROM public.hr_reimbursement_requests a
      WHERE a.employee_id=x.employee_id AND upper(coalesce(x.job_code,''))='HYBRID' AND a.category='TRANSPORT'
        AND a.period_start=p_start_date AND a.period_end=p_end_date
        AND a.status='DISETUJUI'
    ),0),
    'reimbursement_over_budget_amount',
      GREATEST(0,COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.amount) FROM public.hr_reimbursement_requests a
        WHERE a.employee_id=x.employee_id AND upper(coalesce(x.job_code,''))='HYBRID' AND a.category='ENTERTAIN'
          AND a.period_start=p_start_date AND a.period_end=p_end_date AND a.status='DISETUJUI'),0)-v_reimbursement_entertain_limit)
      + GREATEST(0,COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.amount) FROM public.hr_reimbursement_requests a
        WHERE a.employee_id=x.employee_id AND upper(coalesce(x.job_code,''))='HYBRID' AND a.category='TRANSPORT'
          AND a.period_start=p_start_date AND a.period_end=p_end_date AND a.status='DISETUJUI'),0)-v_reimbursement_transport_limit),
    'picket_days', x.picket_days,
    'picket_hours', x.picket_hours,
    'picket_amount', x.picket_amount,
    'family_trip_scheduled_work_days', x.family_trip_scheduled_work_days,
    'family_trip_outside_work_days', x.family_trip_outside_work_days,
    'family_trip_returned_home', x.returned_home,
    'family_trip_dates', x.family_trip_dates,
    'family_trip_special_off_days', x.family_trip_special_off_days,
    'family_trip_schedule_unknown_days', x.family_trip_schedule_unknown_days,
    'extra_transport_days', x.extra_transport_days,
    'extra_transport_dates', x.extra_transport_dates,
    'extra_amount', 0,
    'total_amount',
      COALESCE(x.meal_amount,0)+COALESCE(x.transport_amount,0)+COALESCE(x.phone_amount,0)
      +COALESCE(x.outside_amount,0)+COALESCE(x.picket_amount,0)+COALESCE(x.family_trip_amount,0)
      +COALESCE(x.extra_transport_amount,0)
      +COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.amount) FROM public.hr_reimbursement_requests a
        WHERE a.employee_id=x.employee_id AND upper(coalesce(x.job_code,''))='HYBRID' AND a.period_start=p_start_date AND a.period_end=p_end_date
          AND a.status='DISETUJUI'),0)
      +COALESCE((SELECT u.amount FROM public.incentive_underpayments u
        WHERE u.employee_id=x.employee_id AND u.period_start=p_start_date AND u.period_end=p_end_date LIMIT 1),0),
    'details', x.details,
    'warnings', x.warnings
  ) ORDER BY x.nama), '[]'::jsonb) INTO v_records
  FROM per_employee x;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'period', jsonb_build_object('start_date',p_start_date,'end_date',p_end_date,'timezone','Asia/Jakarta'),
    'formula', jsonb_build_object('version',v_formula.version_no,'effective_from',v_formula.effective_from,'config',v_formula.config),
    'records', v_records
  );
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: hris_log_attendance_approval_change(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hris_log_attendance_approval_change() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_actor_id text;
  v_actor_role text;
  v_action text;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.status_approval IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.status_approval THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  v_actor_id := COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('app.employee_id',true),''), auth.uid()::text);
  v_actor_role := NULLIF(current_setting('app.hris_role',true),'');
  v_action := CASE WHEN NEW.status_approval IN ('PENDING_HR','DITOLAK_ATASAN') THEN 'ATTENDANCE_MANAGER_DECISION' ELSE 'ATTENDANCE_HR_DECISION' END;
  INSERT INTO public.approval_log(id,"timestamp",actor_id,actor_role,action_type,target_id,target_nik,status,alasan)
  VALUES(gen_random_uuid()::text,now(),v_actor_id,v_actor_role,v_action,NEW.id,NEW.employee_id,
    NEW.status_approval,CASE WHEN NEW.status_approval = 'DITOLAK_ATASAN' THEN COALESCE(NEW.alasan_approval_atasan,NEW.alasan_approval) WHEN NEW.status_approval = 'DITOLAK_HR' THEN COALESCE(NEW.alasan_approval_hr,NEW.alasan_approval) ELSE NULL END);
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: hris_log_timeoff_approval_change(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hris_log_timeoff_approval_change() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_actor_id text;
  v_actor_role text;
  v_action text;
  v_reason text;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.status_atasan IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.status_atasan
     AND NEW.status_hr IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.status_hr THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  v_actor_id := COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('app.employee_id',true),''), auth.uid()::text);
  v_actor_role := NULLIF(current_setting('app.hris_role',true),'');
  IF NEW.status_hr IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status_hr AND NEW.status_atasan IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status_atasan THEN
    v_action := 'TIME_OFF_MANAGER_AND_HR_DECISION';
  ELSIF NEW.status_hr IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status_hr THEN
    v_action := 'TIME_OFF_HR_DECISION';
  ELSE
    v_action := 'TIME_OFF_MANAGER_DECISION';
  END IF;
  v_reason := CASE
    WHEN NEW.status_atasan IN ('DITOLAK','REJECTED') AND NEW.status_atasan IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status_atasan THEN NEW.alasan_atasan
    WHEN NEW.status_hr IN ('DITOLAK','REJECTED') AND NEW.status_hr IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status_hr THEN NEW.alasan_hr
    ELSE NULL END;
  INSERT INTO public.approval_log(id,"timestamp",actor_id,actor_role,action_type,target_id,target_nik,status,alasan)
  VALUES(gen_random_uuid()::text,now(),v_actor_id,v_actor_role,v_action,NEW.id,NEW.employee_id,
    COALESCE(NEW.status_atasan,'PENDING')||'/'||COALESCE(NEW.status_hr,'PENDING'),v_reason);
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: hris_reholz_attendance_incentive_guard(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hris_reholz_attendance_incentive_guard() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_mode text := upper(coalesce(current_setting('app.reholz_dayoff_mode', true), ''));
  v_approver text;
  v_area_no integer;
  v_code text;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.tipe = 'MASUK' AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.pengajuan_cuti c
    WHERE c.employee_id = NEW.employee_id
      AND c.status_atasan = 'DISETUJUI'
      AND c.status_hr = 'DISETUJUI'
      AND c.tanggal_mulai <= NEW.tanggal
      AND c.tanggal_selesai >= NEW.tanggal
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Selamat Menjalankan Time Off Anda' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- Marker RHATT dari browser tidak dipercaya. Marker lama maupun baru dibuang
  -- sebelum server menambahkan marker kanonis yang dihitung sendiri.
  NEW.catatan := btrim(regexp_replace(coalesce(NEW.catatan,''),
    '[[:space:]]*\[\[RHATT=(P[1-5]?|PL|SDL[1-5]|SDLL|DL[1-5]|DLL)\]\][[:space:]]*', ' ', 'gi'));

  IF NEW.tipe = 'MASUK' AND v_mode = '' AND (
       coalesce(NEW.calendar_day_type_snapshot IN ('SUNDAY','NATIONAL_HOLIDAY','JOINT_LEAVE','DAY_OFF'), false)
       OR coalesce(NEW.schedule_is_workday_snapshot = FALSE, false)
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Clock In pada hari libur harus melalui pilihan Piket atau Standby.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF v_mode = '' THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.tipe <> 'MASUK' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Mode Piket/Standby hanya berlaku untuk Clock In.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF NOT (
    coalesce(NEW.calendar_day_type_snapshot IN ('SUNDAY','NATIONAL_HOLIDAY','JOINT_LEAVE','DAY_OFF'), false)
    OR coalesce(NEW.schedule_is_workday_snapshot = FALSE, false)
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Kalender tidak memvalidasi hari ini sebagai hari libur. Clock In Piket/Standby dibatalkan.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  v_area_no := CASE NEW.area
    WHEN 'Area 1' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Area 2' THEN 2
    WHEN 'Area 3' THEN 3
    WHEN 'Area 4' THEN 4
    WHEN 'Area lainnya' THEN 5
    WHEN 'Surabaya & Sekitarnya' THEN 0
    ELSE NULL
  END;

  IF v_mode = 'STANDBY' THEN
    IF coalesce(NEW.outside_location,false) IS NOT TRUE OR v_area_no IS NULL OR v_area_no NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Standby hanya berlaku untuk dinas luar Area 1–4 atau Area Lain.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;
    v_code := CASE WHEN v_area_no = 5 THEN 'SDLL' ELSE 'SDL' || v_area_no::text END;
  ELSIF v_mode = 'PIKET' THEN
    IF coalesce(NEW.outside_location,false) THEN
      IF v_area_no IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Piket dinas luar wajib memiliki Area 1–4 atau Area Lain.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
      END IF;
      v_code := CASE WHEN v_area_no = 0 THEN 'P' WHEN v_area_no = 5 THEN 'PL' ELSE 'P' || v_area_no::text END;
    ELSE
      IF NEW.area IS NOT NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Piket kantor tidak boleh memiliki area dinas luar.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
      END IF;
      v_code := 'P';
    END IF;
  ELSE
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Mode kehadiran hari libur tidak dikenal.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  SELECT k.approval_line_id INTO v_approver
  FROM public.karyawan k
  JOIN public.karyawan a ON a.employee_id = k.approval_line_id AND a.status_akun = 'AKTIF'
  WHERE k.employee_id = NEW.employee_id;
  IF v_approver IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Atasan langsung belum terpetakan. Hubungi HR sebelum Clock In Piket/Standby.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  NEW.atasan_id := v_approver;
  NEW.status_approval := 'PENDING_ATASAN';
  NEW.catatan := concat_ws(' ', nullif(btrim(NEW.catatan),''), '[[RHATT=' || v_code || ']]');
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: hris_validate_outside_location_attendance(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hris_validate_outside_location_attendance() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_area_code text;
  v_branch text;
  v_radius numeric;
  v_outside boolean;
  v_distance_is_verifiable boolean := false;
BEGIN
  v_area_code := substring(COALESCE(NEW.catatan,'') from '\[\[RHAREA=(A1|A2|A3|A4|AX|SBY)\]\]');

  IF v_area_code IS NOT NULL THEN
    NEW.area := CASE v_area_code
      WHEN 'A1' THEN 'Area 1'
      WHEN 'A2' THEN 'Area 2'
      WHEN 'A3' THEN 'Area 3'
      WHEN 'A4' THEN 'Area 4'
      WHEN 'AX' THEN 'Area lainnya'
      WHEN 'SBY' THEN 'Surabaya & Sekitarnya'
      ELSE 'Area lainnya'
    END;
    NEW.catatan := BTRIM(regexp_replace(COALESCE(NEW.catatan,''),
      '[[:space:]]*\[\[RHAREA=(A1|A2|A3|A4|AX|SBY)\]\][[:space:]]*',' ','g'));
  END IF;

  -- Cabang snapshot diprioritaskan agar riwayat tidak berubah mengikuti cabang
  -- karyawan yang mungkin sudah dipindahkan setelah tanggal presensi.
  -- submit_attendance menghitung distance_m terhadap lokasi branch_target.
  -- Karena itu radius validasi harus berasal dari branch_target yang sama,
  -- bukan cabang historis yang dapat berbeda setelah mutasi karyawan.
  SELECT COALESCE(
           NULLIF(BTRIM(NEW.branch_target),''),
           NULLIF(BTRIM(NEW.employee_branch_snapshot),''),
           NULLIF(BTRIM(k.branch),'')
         )
    INTO v_branch
  FROM public.karyawan k
  WHERE k.employee_id = NEW.employee_id;

  IF v_branch IS NULL THEN
    v_branch := COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(NEW.branch_target),''),
                         NULLIF(BTRIM(NEW.employee_branch_snapshot),''));
  END IF;

  SELECT lk.radius_m
    INTO v_radius
  FROM public.lokasi_kantor lk
  WHERE lk.status = 'AKTIF'
    AND LOWER(BTRIM(lk.branch)) = LOWER(BTRIM(COALESCE(v_branch,'')))
  ORDER BY lk.updated_at DESC
  LIMIT 1;

  IF NEW.distance_m IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF v_radius IS NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Radius kantor aktif tidak ditemukan untuk cabang %; presensi dibatalkan.',
        COALESCE(v_branch,'(kosong)') USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    v_distance_is_verifiable := true;
    v_outside := NEW.distance_m > v_radius;
  ELSIF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Jarak GPS hasil perhitungan server tidak tersedia; presensi dibatalkan.'
      USING ERRCODE='23514';
  ELSE
    -- Update historis tanpa distance_m tidak boleh mengubah hasil geofence.
    v_outside := COALESCE(NEW.outside_location,FALSE);
  END IF;

  IF v_area_code IS NOT NULL AND v_distance_is_verifiable AND NOT v_outside THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Area luar kantor tidak sesuai: GPS berada dalam radius kantor. Perbarui lokasi GPS.'
      USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;

  NEW.outside_location := COALESCE(v_outside,FALSE);

  IF NEW.tipe IN ('MASUK','PULANG') AND NEW.outside_location IS TRUE THEN
    IF NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(NEW.catatan,'')),'') IS NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Keterangan wajib diisi untuk presensi di luar kantor.' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    IF NEW.area IS NULL OR NEW.area NOT IN ('Area 1','Area 2','Area 3','Area 4','Area lainnya','Surabaya & Sekitarnya') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pilih Pengaturan Lokasi yang sesuai untuk presensi di luar kantor.' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: FUNCTION hris_validate_outside_location_attendance(); Type: COMMENT; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.hris_validate_outside_location_attendance() IS 'Validates outside-office area and note for both MASUK and PULANG using server distance and configured office radius.';


--
-- Name: hris_validate_timeoff_h7(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.hris_validate_timeoff_h7() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_label text;
  v_code text := UPPER(BTRIM(COALESCE(NEW.kode_cuti, '')));
  v_today date := (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta')::date;
  v_requires_h7 boolean := false;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.tanggal_mulai IS NULL OR v_code = '' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  SELECT LOWER(BTRIM(COALESCE(m.keterangan, ''))) INTO v_label
  FROM public.master_cuti m WHERE m.kode = v_code;
  v_requires_h7 := v_code IN ('CIH','CBA','CKA','CM','CMA','CKTN','CTPDP')
    OR v_label LIKE '%baptis anak%'
    OR v_label LIKE '%khitan%anak%'
    OR v_label LIKE '%menikah%'
    OR v_label LIKE '%menikahkan anak%'
    OR v_label LIKE '%kewajiban terhadap negara%'
    OR v_label LIKE '%aktivitas bela negara%'
    OR v_label LIKE '%aktifitas bela negara%';
  IF v_requires_h7 AND NEW.tanggal_mulai < (v_today + 7) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'This time-off request must be submitted at least 7 days in advance.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: karyawan_normalize_profile_uppercase(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.karyawan_normalize_profile_uppercase() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
    AS $$
BEGIN
  -- Human-readable employee and organization fields are stored uppercase.
  NEW.nama := upper(btrim(NEW.nama));
  NEW.branch := CASE WHEN NEW.branch IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE upper(btrim(NEW.branch)) END;
  NEW.organization := CASE WHEN NEW.organization IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE upper(btrim(NEW.organization)) END;
  NEW.job_level := CASE WHEN NEW.job_level IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE upper(btrim(NEW.job_level)) END;
  NEW.job_position := CASE WHEN NEW.job_position IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE upper(btrim(NEW.job_position)) END;
  NEW.grade := CASE WHEN NEW.grade IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE upper(btrim(NEW.grade)) END;
  NEW.class := CASE WHEN NEW.class IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE upper(btrim(NEW.class)) END;
  NEW.employment_status := CASE WHEN NEW.employment_status IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE upper(btrim(NEW.employment_status)) END;
  NEW.approval_line_name := CASE WHEN NEW.approval_line_name IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE upper(btrim(NEW.approval_line_name)) END;
  NEW.reprimand_type := CASE WHEN NEW.reprimand_type IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE upper(btrim(NEW.reprimand_type)) END;
  NEW.reprimand_status := CASE WHEN NEW.reprimand_status IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE upper(btrim(NEW.reprimand_status)) END;
  NEW.role := upper(btrim(NEW.role));
  NEW.status_akun := upper(btrim(NEW.status_akun));
  NEW.job_code := CASE WHEN NEW.job_code IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE upper(btrim(NEW.job_code)) END;
  NEW.phone := CASE WHEN NEW.phone IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE upper(btrim(NEW.phone)) END;
  NEW.gender := CASE WHEN NEW.gender IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE upper(btrim(NEW.gender)) END;
  NEW.marital_status := CASE WHEN NEW.marital_status IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE upper(btrim(NEW.marital_status)) END;
  NEW.address := CASE WHEN NEW.address IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE upper(btrim(NEW.address)) END;
  NEW.ktp_number := CASE WHEN NEW.ktp_number IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE upper(btrim(NEW.ktp_number)) END;
  NEW.npwp := CASE WHEN NEW.npwp IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE upper(btrim(NEW.npwp)) END;
  NEW.bpjs_kesehatan := CASE WHEN NEW.bpjs_kesehatan IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE upper(btrim(NEW.bpjs_kesehatan)) END;
  NEW.bpjs_ketenagakerjaan := CASE WHEN NEW.bpjs_ketenagakerjaan IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE upper(btrim(NEW.bpjs_ketenagakerjaan)) END;
  NEW.bank_name := CASE WHEN NEW.bank_name IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE upper(btrim(NEW.bank_name)) END;
  NEW.place_of_birth := CASE WHEN NEW.place_of_birth IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE upper(btrim(NEW.place_of_birth)) END;
  NEW.education := CASE WHEN NEW.education IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE upper(btrim(NEW.education)) END;
  NEW.religion := CASE WHEN NEW.religion IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE upper(btrim(NEW.religion)) END;

  -- Email is intentionally trimmed but not uppercased to avoid changing an external identifier.
  NEW.email := CASE WHEN NEW.email IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE btrim(NEW.email) END;

  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
    NEW.updated_at := now();
  ELSIF NEW.updated_at IS NULL THEN
    NEW.updated_at := now();
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: karyawan_to_profile(public.karyawan); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.karyawan_to_profile(k public.karyawan) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE sql STABLE
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
  SELECT json_build_object(
    'nik', k.employee_id, 'nama', k.nama, 'branch', k.branch,
    'organization', k.organization, 'level', k.job_level, 'position', k.job_position,
    'grade', k.grade, 'class', k.class, 'statusKerja', k.employment_status,
    'atasanNama', k.approval_line_name, 'atasanId', k.approval_line_id,
    'joinDate', to_char(k.join_date,'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'statusAkun', k.status_akun,
    'role', k.role, 'job_code', k.job_code, 'jobCode', k.job_code,
    'facePhotoVer', coalesce(k.face_photo_ver,0)
  );
$$;


--
-- Name: karyawan_working_period(date, date); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.karyawan_working_period(p_join_date date, p_as_of date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE) RETURNS text
    LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_age interval;
BEGIN
  IF p_join_date IS NULL OR p_as_of IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;
  IF p_as_of < p_join_date THEN
    RETURN 'Not started';
  END IF;
  v_age := age(p_as_of, p_join_date);
  RETURN format('%s Year %s Month %s Day',
    extract(year FROM v_age)::integer,
    extract(month FROM v_age)::integer,
    extract(day FROM v_age)::integer
  );
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: log_activity(text, text, text, text, text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.log_activity(p_token text, p_action text, p_module text, p_target text, p_detail text, p_status text DEFAULT 'SUCCESS'::text) RETURNS void
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
BEGIN
  BEGIN
    v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    v_emp := NULL;
  END;

  INSERT INTO public.activity_log (
    employee_id,
    nama,
    role,
    action,
    module,
    target,
    detail,
    status
  )
  VALUES (
    v_emp.employee_id,
    v_emp.nama,
    v_emp.role,
    p_action,
    p_module,
    p_target,
    p_detail,
    COALESCE(p_status, 'SUCCESS')
  );
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: login_pin(text, text, text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.login_pin(p_employee_id text, p_pin text, p_device_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_user_agent text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare v_k karyawan; v_token text; v_token_hash text;
begin
  if p_employee_id is null or trim(p_employee_id)='' or p_pin is null or trim(p_pin)='' then
    return json_build_object('success',false,'message','NIK dan PIN wajib diisi.');
  end if;

  -- TANPA FOR UPDATE (menghindari menggantung menunggu lock baris)
  select * into v_k from public.karyawan where employee_id = trim(p_employee_id);
  if not found then return json_build_object('success',false,'message','NIK atau PIN salah.'); end if;
  if v_k.status_akun <> 'AKTIF' then return json_build_object('success',false,'message','Akun karyawan tidak aktif.'); end if;
  if v_k.locked_until is not null and v_k.locked_until > now() then
    return json_build_object('success',false,'message','Akun terkunci sementara. Coba lagi beberapa menit lagi.');
  end if;

  if v_k.pin_hash is null or v_k.pin_hash <> "extensions"."crypt"(p_pin, v_k.pin_hash) then
    update public.karyawan
    set failed_login = coalesce(failed_login,0)+1,
        locked_until = case when coalesce(failed_login,0)+1 >= 5 then now()+interval '5 minutes' else null end
    where employee_id = v_k.employee_id;
    insert into public.login_attempts(employee_id,success,user_agent) values (v_k.employee_id,false,p_user_agent);
    return json_build_object('success',false,'message','NIK atau PIN salah.');
  end if;

  update public.karyawan set failed_login=0, locked_until=null, last_login_at=now() where employee_id=v_k.employee_id;

  v_token := encode("extensions"."gen_random_bytes"(32),'hex');
  v_token_hash := encode("extensions"."digest"(v_token,'sha256'),'hex');
  insert into public.app_sessions(employee_id,token_hash,device_id,user_agent,expires_at)
  values (v_k.employee_id,v_token_hash,p_device_id,p_user_agent,now()+interval '30 days');
  insert into public.login_attempts(employee_id,success,user_agent) values (v_k.employee_id,true,p_user_agent);

  return json_build_object('success',true,'token',v_token,'role',v_k.role,
    'user',json_build_object('nik',v_k.employee_id,'nama',v_k.nama,'role',v_k.role),
    'employee',public.karyawan_to_profile(v_k));
end; $$;


--
-- Name: logout(text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.logout(p_token text) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
begin
  update public.app_sessions
  set revoked_at = now()
  where token_hash = encode("extensions"."digest"(p_token, 'sha256'), 'hex');

  return json_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'message', 'Logout berhasil.'
  );
end;
$$;


--
-- Name: mark_my_notification_read(text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.mark_my_notification_read(p_token text, p_notification_id text) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_unread bigint;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);

  IF p_notification_id IS NULL OR btrim(p_notification_id) = '' OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.approval_log al
    WHERE al.id = p_notification_id
      AND al.target_nik = v_emp.employee_id
      AND al.action_type IN (
        'ATTENDANCE_MANAGER_DECISION', 'ATTENDANCE_HR_DECISION',
        'TIME_OFF_MANAGER_DECISION', 'TIME_OFF_HR_DECISION', 'TIME_OFF_MANAGER_AND_HR_DECISION',
        'REIMBURSEMENT_MANAGER_APPROVE', 'REIMBURSEMENT_MANAGER_REJECT',
        'REIMBURSEMENT_SUPERADMIN_APPROVE', 'REIMBURSEMENT_SUPERADMIN_REJECT'
      )
  ) THEN
    RETURN json_build_object('ok', false, 'message', 'Pemberitahuan tidak ditemukan.');
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.hris_notification_reads (employee_id, notification_id)
  VALUES (v_emp.employee_id, p_notification_id)
  ON CONFLICT (employee_id, notification_id) DO NOTHING;

  SELECT count(*) INTO v_unread
  FROM public.approval_log al
  WHERE al.target_nik = v_emp.employee_id
    AND al.action_type IN (
      'ATTENDANCE_MANAGER_DECISION', 'ATTENDANCE_HR_DECISION',
      'TIME_OFF_MANAGER_DECISION', 'TIME_OFF_HR_DECISION', 'TIME_OFF_MANAGER_AND_HR_DECISION',
      'REIMBURSEMENT_MANAGER_APPROVE', 'REIMBURSEMENT_MANAGER_REJECT',
      'REIMBURSEMENT_SUPERADMIN_APPROVE', 'REIMBURSEMENT_SUPERADMIN_REJECT'
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.hris_notification_reads nr
      WHERE nr.employee_id = v_emp.employee_id
        AND nr.notification_id = al.id
    );

  RETURN json_build_object('ok', true, 'read', true, 'unreadCount', coalesce(v_unread, 0));
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: mark_my_notifications_read(text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.mark_my_notifications_read(p_token text) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_marked bigint := 0;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);

  INSERT INTO public.hris_notification_reads (employee_id, notification_id)
  SELECT v_emp.employee_id, al.id::text
  FROM public.approval_log al
  WHERE al.target_nik = v_emp.employee_id
    AND al.action_type IN (
      'ATTENDANCE_MANAGER_DECISION', 'ATTENDANCE_HR_DECISION',
      'TIME_OFF_MANAGER_DECISION', 'TIME_OFF_HR_DECISION', 'TIME_OFF_MANAGER_AND_HR_DECISION',
      'REIMBURSEMENT_MANAGER_APPROVE', 'REIMBURSEMENT_MANAGER_REJECT',
      'REIMBURSEMENT_SUPERADMIN_APPROVE', 'REIMBURSEMENT_SUPERADMIN_REJECT'
    )
  ON CONFLICT (employee_id, notification_id) DO NOTHING;

  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_marked = ROW_COUNT;
  RETURN json_build_object('ok', true, 'markedCount', coalesce(v_marked, 0), 'unreadCount', 0);
END;
$$;

--
-- Name: process_approval(text, text, text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.process_approval(p_token text, p_id text, p_action text, p_alasan text) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_abs public.absensi;
  v_new_status text;
  v_action text := UPPER(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_action, '')));
  v_role text;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  v_role := UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,''));
  IF v_role = 'ADMIN' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Administrator role is view-only. Contact Superadmin for changes.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF v_action NOT IN ('APPROVE','REJECT') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid approval action.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF v_action = 'REJECT' AND NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_alasan,'')),'') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'A rejection reason is required.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_abs FROM public.absensi WHERE id = p_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Attendance record not found.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002'; END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id', COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id,''), true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role', COALESCE(v_emp.role,''), true);

  -- Stage 1 is strictly assigned to the direct manager. Superadmin is not a bypass.
  IF v_abs.status_approval = 'PENDING_ATASAN'
     AND v_abs.atasan_id = v_emp.employee_id
     AND v_role IN ('KARYAWAN','SUPERADMIN') THEN
    v_new_status := CASE WHEN v_action = 'APPROVE' THEN 'PENDING_HR' ELSE 'DITOLAK_ATASAN' END;
    UPDATE public.absensi SET
      status_approval = v_new_status,
      alasan_approval = NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_alasan,'')),''),
      alasan_approval_atasan = NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_alasan,'')),''),
      approval_manager_at = now(),
      approval_manager_by = v_emp.employee_id,
      approval_completed_at = CASE WHEN v_new_status = 'DITOLAK_ATASAN' THEN now() ELSE NULL END,
      foto_delete_after = NULL
    WHERE id = p_id;
  ELSIF v_abs.status_approval = 'PENDING_HR'
        AND v_role = 'SUPERADMIN' THEN
    v_new_status := CASE WHEN v_action = 'APPROVE' THEN 'DISETUJUI' ELSE 'DITOLAK_HR' END;
    UPDATE public.absensi SET
      status_approval = v_new_status,
      alasan_approval = NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_alasan,'')),''),
      alasan_approval_hr = NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_alasan,'')),''),
      approval_hr_at = now(),
      approval_hr_by = v_emp.employee_id,
      approval_completed_at = now(),
      foto_delete_after = CASE
        WHEN v_new_status = 'DISETUJUI' AND foto_retention_enabled = TRUE
          AND NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(storage_path,'')),'') IS NOT NULL
          AND BTRIM(storage_path) !~* '^https?://'
        THEN now() + INTERVAL '24 hours' ELSE NULL END
    WHERE id = p_id;
  ELSE
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'You are not authorized to process this attendance record, or its status has changed.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  RETURN json_build_object('success',true,'message','Attendance status updated successfully.','status',v_new_status);
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: process_cuti_approval(text, text, text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.process_cuti_approval(p_token text, p_id text, p_action text, p_alasan text) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_cuti public.pengajuan_cuti;
  v_owner public.karyawan;
  v_action text := UPPER(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_action, '')));
  v_role text;
  v_year integer;
  v_existing integer;
  v_has_balance boolean := false;
  v_new_balance integer;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  v_role := UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,''));
  IF v_role = 'ADMIN' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Administrator role is view-only. Contact Superadmin for changes.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF v_action NOT IN ('APPROVE','REJECT') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid approval action.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF v_action = 'REJECT' AND NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_alasan,'')),'') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'A rejection reason is required.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_cuti FROM public.pengajuan_cuti WHERE id = p_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Time-off request not found.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO v_owner FROM public.karyawan WHERE employee_id = v_cuti.employee_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'The employee who submitted this request could not be found.'; END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id', COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id,''), true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role', COALESCE(v_emp.role,''), true);

  -- Stage 1 must be performed by the assigned direct manager, including when that person is Superadmin.
  IF v_cuti.status_atasan = 'PENDING'
     AND v_owner.approval_line_id = v_emp.employee_id
     AND v_role IN ('KARYAWAN','SUPERADMIN') THEN
    IF v_action = 'APPROVE' THEN
      UPDATE public.pengajuan_cuti
      SET status_atasan = 'DISETUJUI', alasan_atasan = NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_alasan,'')),''), timestamp_atasan = now()
      WHERE id = p_id;
    ELSE
      UPDATE public.pengajuan_cuti
      SET status_atasan = 'DITOLAK', alasan_atasan = NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_alasan,'')),''), timestamp_atasan = now()
      WHERE id = p_id;
    END IF;

  -- Stage 2 is final approval and is only available after the manager has approved.
  ELSIF v_cuti.status_atasan = 'DISETUJUI'
        AND v_cuti.status_hr = 'PENDING'
        AND v_role = 'SUPERADMIN' THEN
    IF v_action = 'APPROVE' THEN
      -- Locking the employee row serializes balance updates for the same employee.
      IF v_cuti.kode_cuti = 'CT' THEN
        v_year := EXTRACT(YEAR FROM v_cuti.tanggal_mulai)::integer;
        SELECT s.sisa INTO v_existing
        FROM public.sisa_cuti s
        WHERE s.employee_id = v_cuti.employee_id AND s.tahun = v_year AND s.kode_cuti = 'CT'
        FOR UPDATE;
        v_has_balance := FOUND;
      END IF;

      UPDATE public.pengajuan_cuti
      SET status_hr = 'DISETUJUI', alasan_hr = NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_alasan,'')),''), timestamp_hr = now()
      WHERE id = p_id;

      IF v_cuti.kode_cuti = 'CT' THEN
        IF v_has_balance THEN
          v_new_balance := COALESCE(v_existing, 0) - COALESCE(v_cuti.total_hari, 0);
          IF v_new_balance < 0 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Insufficient annual time-off balance. The request was not approved.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
          END IF;
          UPDATE public.sisa_cuti SET sisa = v_new_balance
          WHERE employee_id = v_cuti.employee_id AND tahun = v_year AND kode_cuti = 'CT';
        ELSE
          SELECT COALESCE(m.kuota_tahunan,0) - COALESCE((
            SELECT SUM(COALESCE(c.total_hari,0))::integer
            FROM public.pengajuan_cuti c
            WHERE c.employee_id = v_cuti.employee_id AND c.kode_cuti = 'CT'
              AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.tanggal_mulai)::integer = v_year
              AND c.status_atasan = 'DISETUJUI' AND c.status_hr = 'DISETUJUI'
          ),0)
          INTO v_new_balance
          FROM public.master_cuti m WHERE m.kode = 'CT';
          IF v_new_balance IS NULL OR v_new_balance < 0 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Insufficient annual time-off balance. The request was not approved.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
          END IF;
          INSERT INTO public.sisa_cuti(employee_id,tahun,kode_cuti,sisa)
          VALUES (v_cuti.employee_id,v_year,'CT',v_new_balance)
          ON CONFLICT (employee_id,tahun,kode_cuti) DO UPDATE SET sisa = EXCLUDED.sisa;
        END IF;
      END IF;
    ELSE
      UPDATE public.pengajuan_cuti
      SET status_hr = 'DITOLAK', alasan_hr = NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_alasan,'')),''), timestamp_hr = now()
      WHERE id = p_id;
    END IF;
  ELSE
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'You are not authorized to process this time-off request, or its status has changed.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  RETURN json_build_object('success', true, 'message', 'Time-off status updated successfully.');
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: process_reimbursement_approval(text, text, text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.process_reimbursement_approval(p_token text, p_id text, p_action text, p_alasan text DEFAULT ''::text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan; v_owner public.karyawan; v_row public.hr_reimbursement_requests%ROWTYPE;
  v_action text:=upper(btrim(coalesce(p_action,'')));
  v_next text; v_audit_action text; v_msg text;
  v_manager_step boolean; v_hr_step boolean;
BEGIN
  v_emp:=public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF upper(coalesce(v_emp.role,''))='ADMIN' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Administrator role is view-only.' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF v_action NOT IN ('APPROVE','REJECT') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Aksi persetujuan tidak valid.' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  IF v_action='REJECT' AND nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_alasan,'')),'') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Catatan penolakan wajib diisi.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO v_row FROM public.hr_reimbursement_requests WHERE id=p_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pengajuan reimbursement tidak ditemukan.' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;

  v_manager_step := (v_row.status='PENDING_ATASAN'
                     AND upper(coalesce(v_emp.role,'')) IN ('KARYAWAN','SUPERADMIN'));
  v_hr_step := (v_row.status='PENDING_HR' AND upper(coalesce(v_emp.role,''))='SUPERADMIN');

  IF v_manager_step OR v_hr_step THEN
    -- Jalur normal: identik dengan implementasi sebelum migrasi.
    SELECT * INTO v_owner FROM public.karyawan WHERE employee_id=v_row.employee_id FOR UPDATE;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Data karyawan pengaju tidak ditemukan.' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
    IF upper(coalesce(v_owner.job_code,'')) <> 'HYBRID' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Persetujuan Reimbursement hanya berlaku untuk pengajuan karyawan HYBRID.' USING ERRCODE='42501';
    END IF;
    IF v_manager_step AND v_owner.approval_line_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_emp.employee_id THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tahap approval berubah atau tugas ini bukan milik Anda.' USING ERRCODE='42501';
    END IF;
    PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',coalesce(v_emp.employee_id,''),true);
    PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',coalesce(v_emp.role,''),true);
    IF v_manager_step THEN
      v_next:=CASE WHEN v_action='APPROVE' THEN 'PENDING_HR' ELSE 'DITOLAK_ATASAN' END;
      UPDATE public.hr_reimbursement_requests SET status=v_next,manager_approval_at=now(),manager_approval_by=v_emp.employee_id,
        manager_note=nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_alasan,'')),''),updated_at=now() WHERE id=p_id;
      v_audit_action:=CASE WHEN v_action='APPROVE' THEN 'REIMBURSEMENT_MANAGER_APPROVE' ELSE 'REIMBURSEMENT_MANAGER_REJECT' END;
    ELSE
      v_next:=CASE WHEN v_action='APPROVE' THEN 'DISETUJUI' ELSE 'DITOLAK_HR' END;
      UPDATE public.hr_reimbursement_requests SET status=v_next,hr_approval_at=now(),hr_approval_by=v_emp.employee_id,
        hr_note=nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_alasan,'')),''),updated_at=now() WHERE id=p_id;
      v_audit_action:=CASE WHEN v_action='APPROVE' THEN 'REIMBURSEMENT_SUPERADMIN_APPROVE' ELSE 'REIMBURSEMENT_SUPERADMIN_REJECT' END;
    END IF;
    INSERT INTO public.approval_log(id,actor_id,actor_role,action_type,target_id,target_nik,status,alasan)
    VALUES('RMBLOG-'||gen_random_uuid()::text,v_emp.employee_id,v_emp.role,v_audit_action,v_row.id,v_row.employee_id,v_next,nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_alasan,'')),''));
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'id',p_id,'status',v_next,
      'message',CASE WHEN v_next='PENDING_HR' THEN 'Disetujui atasan; menunggu persetujuan Superadmin.'
        WHEN v_next='DISETUJUI' THEN 'Pengajuan reimbursement disetujui.' ELSE 'Pengajuan reimbursement ditolak.' END);
  END IF;

  -- Idempotensi: baris sudah lewat tahap pending. Terima ulang permintaan HANYA
  -- bila pemanggil adalah pelaku transisi yang sama dengan aksi yang sama.
  IF v_row.manager_approval_by IS NOT NULL
     AND v_row.manager_approval_by = v_emp.employee_id THEN
    IF v_action='APPROVE' AND v_row.status IN ('PENDING_HR','DISETUJUI','DITOLAK_HR') THEN
      v_msg:=CASE v_row.status WHEN 'PENDING_HR' THEN 'Disetujui atasan; menunggu persetujuan Superadmin.'
              ELSE 'Pengajuan reimbursement sudah diproses sebelumnya.' END;
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'id',p_id,'status',v_row.status,'already_processed',true,'message',v_msg);
    END IF;
    IF v_action='REJECT' AND v_row.status='DITOLAK_ATASAN' THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'id',p_id,'status',v_row.status,'already_processed',true,
        'message','Pengajuan reimbursement sudah diproses sebelumnya.');
    END IF;
  END IF;
  IF v_row.hr_approval_by IS NOT NULL
     AND v_row.hr_approval_by = v_emp.employee_id
     AND v_action='APPROVE' AND v_row.status='DISETUJUI' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'id',p_id,'status',v_row.status,'already_processed',true,
      'message','Pengajuan reimbursement sudah diproses sebelumnya.');
  END IF;
  IF v_row.hr_approval_by IS NOT NULL
     AND v_row.hr_approval_by = v_emp.employee_id
     AND v_action='REJECT' AND v_row.status='DITOLAK_HR' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'id',p_id,'status',v_row.status,'already_processed',true,
      'message','Pengajuan reimbursement sudah diproses sebelumnya.');
  END IF;

  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tahap approval berubah atau tugas ini bukan milik Anda.' USING ERRCODE='42501';
END;
$$;
