--
-- Name: retention_list_candidates(text, integer); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.retention_list_candidates(p_mode text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 100) RETURNS TABLE(attendance_id text, object_path text, object_created_at timestamp with time zone)
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $_$
DECLARE
  v_mode text := lower(btrim(coalesce(p_mode, '')));
  v_cutoff timestamptz;
  v_limit integer := greatest(
    1,
    least(coalesce(p_limit, 100), 100)
  );
BEGIN

  IF v_mode = 'legacy' THEN

    SELECT config_timestamptz
      INTO v_cutoff
      FROM public.photo_retention_config
     WHERE config_key = 'legacy_cutoff_at';

    IF v_cutoff IS NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION
        'Waktu cutover retensi tidak ditemukan.';
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
      matched.attendance_id::text,
      o.name::text,
      o.created_at
    FROM storage.objects AS o

    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT a.id AS attendance_id
      FROM public.absensi AS a
      WHERE
        a.storage_path = o.name

        OR (
          NULLIF(btrim(a.foto_url), '') IS NOT NULL
          AND btrim(a.foto_url) !~* '^(https?://|data:)'
          AND regexp_replace(
            btrim(a.foto_url),
            '^/?evidence/',
            '',
            'i'
          ) = o.name
        )

        OR (
          NULLIF(btrim(a.foto_path), '') IS NOT NULL
          AND btrim(a.foto_path) !~* '^(https?://|data:)'
          AND regexp_replace(
            btrim(a.foto_path),
            '^/?evidence/',
            '',
            'i'
          ) = o.name
        )

        OR right(
          o.name,
          length(a.id) + 4
        ) = a.id || '.jpg'

      ORDER BY
        (a.storage_path = o.name) DESC,
        a.id

      LIMIT 1
    ) AS matched ON TRUE

    WHERE o.bucket_id = 'evidence'
      AND o.name ~ '(^|/)ABS-[^/]+[.]jpg$'
      AND o.created_at < v_cutoff

    ORDER BY
      o.created_at ASC,
      o.name ASC

    LIMIT v_limit;

  ELSIF v_mode = 'due' THEN

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
      a.id::text,
      a.storage_path::text,
      o.created_at
    FROM public.absensi AS a

    JOIN storage.objects AS o
      ON o.bucket_id = 'evidence'
     AND o.name = a.storage_path

    WHERE a.foto_retention_enabled = TRUE
      AND a.foto_deleted_at IS NULL
      AND a.foto_delete_after IS NOT NULL
      AND a.foto_delete_after <= now()
      AND a.status_approval IN ('VALID', 'DISETUJUI')

    ORDER BY
      a.foto_delete_after ASC,
      a.id ASC

    LIMIT v_limit;

  ELSE

    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'Mode retensi tidak valid. Gunakan legacy atau due.';

  END IF;

END;
$_$;


--
-- Name: retention_mark_deleted(text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.retention_mark_deleted(p_object_path text) RETURNS integer
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_rows integer;
  v_path text := btrim(coalesce(p_object_path, ''));
BEGIN

  IF v_path = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Path objek kosong.';
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.absensi AS a
  SET foto_deleted_at = COALESCE(
    a.foto_deleted_at,
    now()
  )
  WHERE
    a.storage_path = v_path

    OR (
      NULLIF(btrim(a.foto_url), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND btrim(a.foto_url) !~* '^(https?://|data:)'
      AND regexp_replace(
        btrim(a.foto_url),
        '^/?evidence/',
        '',
        'i'
      ) = v_path
    )

    OR (
      NULLIF(btrim(a.foto_path), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND btrim(a.foto_path) !~* '^(https?://|data:)'
      AND regexp_replace(
        btrim(a.foto_path),
        '^/?evidence/',
        '',
        'i'
      ) = v_path
    )

    OR right(
      v_path,
      length(a.id) + 4
    ) = a.id || '.jpg';

  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows = ROW_COUNT;

  RETURN v_rows;

END;
$$;

--
-- Name: save_evidence_path(text, text, text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.save_evidence_path(p_token text, p_absensi_id text, p_storage_path text, p_public_url text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_rows integer;
  v_expected_path text;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);

  IF p_absensi_id IS NULL OR BTRIM(p_absensi_id) = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ID absensi tidak valid.';
  END IF;

  v_expected_path := v_emp.employee_id::text || '/' || BTRIM(p_absensi_id) || '.jpg';

  IF BTRIM(COALESCE(p_storage_path, '')) <> v_expected_path THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Path foto tidak sesuai dengan sesi karyawan.';
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.absensi AS a
  SET
    storage_path = v_expected_path,
    foto_url = v_expected_path, -- kompatibilitas dengan frontend lama
    foto_uploaded_at = now(),
    foto_deleted_at = NULL,
    foto_retention_enabled = TRUE,
    foto_delete_after = CASE
      WHEN a.status_approval = 'VALID'
        THEN now() + INTERVAL '24 hours'
      WHEN a.status_approval = 'DISETUJUI'
        THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(a.approval_completed_at, now()), now()) + INTERVAL '24 hours'
      ELSE NULL -- pending/rejected tidak dijadwalkan otomatis
    END
  WHERE a.id = BTRIM(p_absensi_id)
    AND a.employee_id = v_emp.employee_id;

  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows = ROW_COUNT;
  IF v_rows = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Data absensi tidak ditemukan atau bukan milik akun ini.';
  END IF;

  RETURN json_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'id', p_absensi_id,
    'storage_path', v_expected_path
  );
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: save_lokasi_kantor(text, text, text, numeric, numeric, integer, integer, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.save_lokasi_kantor(p_token text, p_branch text, p_alamat text, p_lat numeric, p_lon numeric, p_radius integer, p_max_accuracy integer, p_status text DEFAULT 'AKTIF'::text) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare v_emp karyawan;
begin
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.employee_id',COALESCE(v_emp.employee_id::text, ''),true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.hris_role',COALESCE(v_emp.role, ''),true);
  IF UPPER(COALESCE(v_emp.role,'')) <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Superadmin can perform this action.' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  if p_branch is null or trim(p_branch)='' then raise exception 'Branch wajib diisi.'; end if;

  insert into public.lokasi_kantor(branch, alamat, latitude, longitude, radius_m, max_accuracy_m, status)
  values (p_branch, p_alamat, p_lat, p_lon, coalesce(p_radius,100), coalesce(p_max_accuracy,50), p_status)
  on conflict (branch) do update set
    alamat = excluded.alamat,
    latitude = excluded.latitude,
    longitude = excluded.longitude,
    radius_m = excluded.radius_m,
    max_accuracy_m = excluded.max_accuracy_m,
    status = excluded.status;

  return json_build_object('success',true,'message','Lokasi kantor berhasil disimpan.');
end; $$;


--
-- Name: save_lokasi_kantor(text, text, text, text, numeric, numeric, integer, integer, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.save_lokasi_kantor(p_token text, p_old_branch text, p_branch text, p_alamat text, p_lat numeric, p_lon numeric, p_radius integer, p_max_accuracy integer, p_status text) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_current_branch text;
  v_count integer;
  v_new_status text := upper(coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_status),''),'AKTIF'));
  v_is_rename boolean := false;
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF upper(coalesce(v_emp.role,'')) <> 'SUPERADMIN' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Superadmin can manage office locations.' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  IF nullif(btrim(p_branch),'') IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Branch name is required.' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  IF p_lat IS NULL OR p_lon IS NULL OR p_lat < -90 OR p_lat > 90 OR p_lon < -180 OR p_lon > 180 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Latitude/longitude is outside valid bounds.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  IF coalesce(p_radius,0) < 1 OR coalesce(p_max_accuracy,0) < 1 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Radius and maximum GPS accuracy must be at least 1 meter.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  IF v_new_status NOT IN ('AKTIF','NONAKTIF') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid location status.' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;

  IF nullif(btrim(p_old_branch),'') IS NULL THEN
    SELECT count(*) INTO v_count FROM public.lokasi_kantor l
    WHERE upper(btrim(l.branch)) = upper(btrim(p_branch));
    IF v_count > 0 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'A branch with this name already exists (case-insensitive). Edit the existing location instead.' USING ERRCODE='23505';
    END IF;
    INSERT INTO public.lokasi_kantor(branch,alamat,latitude,longitude,radius_m,max_accuracy_m,status,updated_at)
    VALUES(btrim(p_branch),nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_alamat,'')),''),p_lat::double precision,p_lon::double precision,p_radius,p_max_accuracy,v_new_status,now());
    RETURN json_build_object('success',true,'message','Office location created.','branch',btrim(p_branch),'renamed',false);
  END IF;

  -- Resolve old spelling case-insensitively; fail closed if old duplicate spellings exist.
  SELECT count(*) INTO v_count FROM public.lokasi_kantor l
  WHERE upper(btrim(l.branch)) = upper(btrim(p_old_branch));
  IF v_count = 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'The existing branch could not be found. Refresh the location list and retry.' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
  IF v_count > 1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Several office locations differ only by letter case. Clean up duplicate locations before renaming.' USING ERRCODE='23505'; END IF;
  SELECT l.branch INTO v_current_branch FROM public.lokasi_kantor l
  WHERE upper(btrim(l.branch)) = upper(btrim(p_old_branch))
  ORDER BY (l.branch = p_old_branch) DESC, l.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE;
  v_is_rename := v_current_branch IS DISTINCT FROM btrim(p_branch);

  SELECT count(*) INTO v_count FROM public.lokasi_kantor l
  WHERE upper(btrim(l.branch)) = upper(btrim(p_branch))
    AND upper(btrim(l.branch)) <> upper(btrim(v_current_branch));
  IF v_count > 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Another office location already uses the requested branch name (case-insensitive).' USING ERRCODE='23505'; END IF;

  -- Detect schedule collisions before moving names so migration does not merge rules silently.
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.attendance_schedule_rules src
    JOIN public.attendance_schedule_rules dst
      ON src.id <> dst.id
     AND upper(btrim(dst.branch)) = upper(btrim(p_branch))
     AND src.day_of_week = dst.day_of_week
     AND src.effective_from = dst.effective_from
    WHERE upper(btrim(src.branch)) = upper(btrim(v_current_branch))
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'The new branch name would collide with existing shift rules. Resolve duplicate branch/day/effective-date rules first.' USING ERRCODE='23505';
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.attendance_calendar_overrides src
    JOIN public.attendance_calendar_overrides dst
      ON src.id <> dst.id
     AND upper(btrim(dst.scope_branch)) = upper(btrim(p_branch))
     AND src.calendar_date = dst.calendar_date
    WHERE src.scope_branch <> '*'
      AND upper(btrim(src.scope_branch)) = upper(btrim(v_current_branch))
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'The new branch name would collide with existing calendar overrides. Resolve duplicate dates first.' USING ERRCODE='23505';
  END IF;

  -- Keep employee branch data, shift rules, and branch-scoped calendar overrides aligned.
  UPDATE public.karyawan k SET branch = btrim(p_branch), updated_at = now()
  WHERE upper(btrim(coalesce(k.branch,''))) = upper(btrim(v_current_branch));

  UPDATE public.attendance_schedule_rules r SET branch = btrim(p_branch), updated_at = now()
  WHERE upper(btrim(r.branch)) = upper(btrim(v_current_branch));

  UPDATE public.attendance_calendar_overrides o SET scope_branch = btrim(p_branch), updated_at = now()
  WHERE o.scope_branch <> '*'
    AND upper(btrim(o.scope_branch)) = upper(btrim(v_current_branch));

  UPDATE public.lokasi_kantor l SET
    branch = btrim(p_branch), alamat = nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_alamat,'')),''),
    latitude = p_lat::double precision, longitude = p_lon::double precision,
    radius_m = p_radius, max_accuracy_m = p_max_accuracy,
    status = v_new_status, updated_at = now()
  WHERE l.branch = v_current_branch;

  RETURN json_build_object('success',true,'message',CASE WHEN v_is_rename THEN 'Office location updated and branch name changed.' ELSE 'Office location updated.' END,'branch',btrim(p_branch),'oldBranch',v_current_branch,'renamed',v_is_rename);
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: save_my_face(text, double precision[], text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.save_my_face(p_token text, p_descriptor double precision[], p_photo text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_emp public.karyawan;
  v_photo text := NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_photo,'')), '');
BEGIN
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  IF v_emp.employee_id IS NULL OR v_emp.status_akun <> 'AKTIF' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Active employee session required.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF p_descriptor IS NULL OR array_length(p_descriptor,1) <> 128 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'A valid 128-value face descriptor is required.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF v_photo IS NOT NULL AND (length(v_photo) > 1000000 OR v_photo !~* '^data:image/(jpeg|jpg|png|webp);base64,') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Profile photo must be a valid compressed image under 1 MB.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  UPDATE public.karyawan SET
    face = p_descriptor::public.vector,
    face_version = COALESCE(face_version,0) + 1,
    face_photo = COALESCE(v_photo, face_photo),
    face_photo_ver = COALESCE(face_photo_ver,0) + 1,
    face_updated_at = now(),
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE employee_id = v_emp.employee_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Employee profile was not found.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002'; END IF;
  RETURN json_build_object('success', true, 'message', 'Profile photo and Face ID updated.', 'facePhotoVer', COALESCE(v_emp.face_photo_ver,0) + 1);
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: session_karyawan(text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.session_karyawan(p_token text) RETURNS public.karyawan
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_k karyawan;
begin
  if p_token is null or trim(p_token) = '' then
    raise exception 'Unauthorized';
  end if;

  select k.*
  into v_k
  from public.app_sessions s
  join public.karyawan k on k.employee_id = s.employee_id
  where s.token_hash = encode("extensions"."digest"(p_token, 'sha256'), 'hex')
    and s.revoked_at is null
    and s.expires_at > now()
    and k.status_akun = 'AKTIF';

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Sesi berakhir. Silakan login kembali.';
  end if;

  return v_k;
end;
$$;


--
-- Name: submit_attendance(text, text, double precision, double precision, double precision, double precision[], text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.submit_attendance(p_token text, p_tipe text, p_lat double precision, p_lon double precision, p_acc double precision, p_descriptor double precision[], p_catatan text DEFAULT ''::text, p_address text DEFAULT ''::text) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_emp karyawan; v_office lokasi_kantor; v_threshold double precision;
  v_face_dist double precision; v_distance double precision; v_in_office boolean;
  v_status text; v_atasan text; v_id text; v_has_masuk boolean; v_has_pulang boolean;
  v_today date := (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::date;
  v_now time := (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::time;
begin
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);
  p_tipe := upper(trim(coalesce(p_tipe,'')));
  if p_tipe not in ('MASUK','PULANG') then raise exception 'Tipe absensi tidak valid.'; end if;
  if p_lat is null or p_lon is null then raise exception 'GPS belum tersedia.'; end if;
  if p_descriptor is null or array_length(p_descriptor,1) <> 128 then raise exception 'Face descriptor tidak valid.'; end if;
  if v_emp.face is null then raise exception 'Face ID belum terdaftar.'; end if;

  select coalesce(value::double precision,0.55) into v_threshold from public.settings where key='FACE_MATCH_THRESHOLD';
  v_face_dist := (p_descriptor::vector <-> v_emp.face);
  if v_face_dist > v_threshold then raise exception 'Wajah tidak cocok.'; end if;

  select * into v_office from public.lokasi_kantor
   where upper(btrim(branch)) = upper(btrim(v_emp.branch)) and status='AKTIF'
   order by (branch = v_emp.branch) desc, updated_at desc, branch
   limit 1;
  if not found then raise exception 'Lokasi kantor untuk branch % tidak ditemukan.', v_emp.branch; end if;
  if coalesce(p_acc,9999) > v_office.max_accuracy_m then
    raise exception 'Akurasi GPS terlalu rendah (% m). Maksimal % m.', round(p_acc), v_office.max_accuracy_m;
  end if;

  v_distance := public.haversine_m(p_lat,p_lon,v_office.latitude,v_office.longitude);
  v_in_office := v_distance <= v_office.radius_m;

  -- BARU: catatan wajib saat luar radius
  if not v_in_office and (p_catatan is null or trim(p_catatan)='') then
    raise exception 'Absen di luar radius wajib disertai catatan.';
  end if;

  select coalesce(bool_or(tipe='MASUK'),false), coalesce(bool_or(tipe='PULANG'),false)
  into v_has_masuk, v_has_pulang
  from public.absensi
  where employee_id=v_emp.employee_id and tanggal=v_today
    and status_approval not in ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR');

  if p_tipe='MASUK' and v_has_masuk then raise exception 'Sudah Clock In hari ini.'; end if;
  if p_tipe='PULANG' and v_has_pulang then raise exception 'Sudah Clock Out hari ini.'; end if;
  if p_tipe='PULANG' and not v_has_masuk then raise exception 'Anda belum Clock In.'; end if;

  if v_in_office then v_status:='VALID'; v_atasan:=null;
  else v_status:='PENDING_ATASAN'; v_atasan:=v_emp.approval_line_id; end if;

  v_id := 'ABS-' || to_char(timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') || '-' || v_emp.employee_id;
  insert into public.absensi(id,employee_id,tanggal,jam,timestamp,tipe,latitude,longitude,accuracy,address,catatan,branch_target,distance_m,status_approval,atasan_id,face_match,face_distance,face_local_precheck)
  values(v_id,v_emp.employee_id,v_today,v_now,now(),p_tipe,p_lat,p_lon,p_acc,p_address,p_catatan,v_office.branch,v_distance,v_status,v_atasan,true,v_face_dist,false);

  return json_build_object('success',true,'id',v_id,'inOffice',v_in_office,
    'message', case when v_status='VALID' then case when p_tipe='MASUK' then 'Clock In berhasil.' else 'Clock Out berhasil.' end
                 else 'Pengajuan presensi terkirim. Menunggu persetujuan.' end,
    'statusApproval',v_status,'tanggal',to_char(v_today,'YYYY-MM-DD'),'jam',to_char(v_now,'HH24:MI:SS'),'tipe',p_tipe);
end; $$;


--
-- Name: submit_attendance(text, text, double precision, double precision, double precision, text, text, text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.submit_attendance(p_token text, p_tipe text, p_lat double precision, p_lon double precision, p_acc double precision, p_descriptor text, p_catatan text DEFAULT ''::text, p_address text DEFAULT ''::text, p_foto_base64 text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_emp            karyawan;
  v_branch         text;
  v_office         lokasi_kantor;
  v_pasuruan_office lokasi_kantor;
  v_pasuruan_distance double precision;
  v_threshold      double precision;
  v_face_dist      double precision;
  v_distance       double precision;
  v_in_office      boolean;
  v_status         text;
  v_atasan         text;
  v_id             text;
  v_has_masuk      boolean;
  v_has_pulang     boolean;
  v_prior_in_status text;
  v_prior_in_manager text;
  v_prior_in_requires_approval boolean := false;
  v_approval_required boolean := false;
  v_desc_arr       double precision[];
  v_today          date := (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::date;
  v_now            time := (timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()))::time;
begin
  -- ===== AUTH =====
  v_emp := public.session_karyawan(p_token);

  -- ===== VALIDASI DASAR =====
  p_tipe := upper(trim(coalesce(p_tipe,'')));
  if p_tipe not in ('MASUK','PULANG') then
    raise exception 'Tipe absensi tidak valid.';
  end if;
  if p_lat is null or p_lon is null then
    raise exception 'GPS belum tersedia.';
  end if;

  -- ===== FIX 1: PARSE FACE DESCRIPTOR DARI TEXT =====
  if p_descriptor is null or trim(p_descriptor) = '' then
    raise exception 'Face descriptor tidak valid.';
  end if;

  -- Handle JSON array "[0.1, 0.2, ...]" ATAU PostgreSQL array "{0.1, 0.2, ...}"
  if left(trim(p_descriptor), 1) = '[' then
    v_desc_arr := translate(trim(p_descriptor), '[]', '{}')::double precision[];
  elsif left(trim(p_descriptor), 1) = '{' then
    v_desc_arr := p_descriptor::double precision[];
  else
    raise exception 'Format face descriptor tidak dikenali.';
  end if;

  if array_length(v_desc_arr, 1) <> 128 then
    raise exception 'Face descriptor harus 128 angka.';
  end if;

  if v_emp.face is null then
    raise exception 'Face ID belum terdaftar.';
  end if;

  -- ===== FACE MATCHING =====
  select coalesce(value::double precision, 0.55)
    into v_threshold
    from public.settings
   where key = 'FACE_MATCH_THRESHOLD';

  v_face_dist := (v_desc_arr::vector <-> v_emp.face);

  if v_face_dist > v_threshold then
    raise exception 'Wajah tidak cocok. Jarak: %.', round(v_face_dist::numeric, 3);
  end if;

  -- ===== LOKASI KANTOR BERDASARKAN MUTASI CABANG EFEKTIF =====
  -- Keep the geofence target aligned with the same branch-history resolver used
  -- by attendance snapshot triggers and the day-off attendance path.
  SELECT h.branch INTO v_branch
  FROM public.attendance_employee_branch_history h
  WHERE h.employee_id = v_emp.employee_id
    AND h.effective_from <= v_today
    AND (h.effective_to IS NULL OR h.effective_to >= v_today)
  ORDER BY h.effective_from DESC
  LIMIT 1;
  v_branch := COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(v_branch), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(v_emp.branch), ''), 'Pusat');

  select * into v_office
    from public.lokasi_kantor
   where upper(btrim(branch)) = upper(btrim(v_branch)) and status = 'AKTIF'
   order by (branch = v_branch) desc, updated_at desc, branch
   limit 1;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Lokasi kantor untuk branch % tidak ditemukan.', v_branch;
  end if;

  v_distance  := public.haversine_m(p_lat, p_lon, v_office.latitude, v_office.longitude);
  v_in_office := v_distance <= v_office.radius_m;

  -- PM may also clock in/out at the active Pasuruan office. The employee's
  -- own branch remains the primary location; Pasuruan is an additional option.
  -- Selecting it here makes branch_target and server-side geofence validation
  -- agree, so an in-radius Pasuruan event is stored as VALID (not pending).
  IF upper(coalesce(v_emp.job_code,'')) = 'PM' THEN
    SELECT * INTO v_pasuruan_office
    FROM public.lokasi_kantor
    WHERE lower(btrim(branch)) = 'pasuruan'
      AND status = 'AKTIF'
    ORDER BY updated_at DESC, branch
    LIMIT 1;

    IF FOUND THEN
      v_pasuruan_distance := public.haversine_m(
        p_lat, p_lon, v_pasuruan_office.latitude, v_pasuruan_office.longitude
      );
      IF v_pasuruan_distance <= v_pasuruan_office.radius_m
         AND (NOT v_in_office OR v_pasuruan_distance < v_distance) THEN
        v_office := v_pasuruan_office;
        v_distance := v_pasuruan_distance;
        v_in_office := TRUE;
      END IF;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF coalesce(p_acc, 9999) > v_office.max_accuracy_m THEN
    raise exception 'Akurasi GPS terlalu rendah (% m). Maksimal % m.',
      round(p_acc), v_office.max_accuracy_m;
  end if;

  if not v_in_office and (p_catatan is null or trim(p_catatan) = '') then
    raise exception 'Absen di luar radius wajib disertai catatan.';
  end if;

  -- ===== CEK DUPLIKASI =====
  select coalesce(bool_or(tipe='MASUK'), false),
         coalesce(bool_or(tipe='PULANG'), false)
    into v_has_masuk, v_has_pulang
    from public.absensi
   where employee_id = v_emp.employee_id
     and tanggal     = v_today
     and status_approval not in ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR');

  if p_tipe = 'MASUK'  and v_has_masuk  then raise exception 'Sudah Clock In hari ini.';  end if;
  if p_tipe = 'PULANG' and v_has_pulang then raise exception 'Sudah Clock Out hari ini.'; end if;

  -- ===== STATUS APPROVAL =====
  -- Clock Out follows Clock In when the latter is still waiting for approval,
  -- even when Clock Out itself is inside the geofence. This keeps the day coherent.
  v_prior_in_status := NULL;
  v_prior_in_manager := NULL;
  IF p_tipe='PULANG' THEN
    SELECT a.status_approval, a.atasan_id, (COALESCE(a.approval_required,false) OR COALESCE(a.outside_location,false) OR a.approval_manager_at IS NOT NULL OR a.approval_hr_at IS NOT NULL OR a.status_approval IN ('PENDING_ATASAN','PENDING_HR'))
      INTO v_prior_in_status, v_prior_in_manager, v_prior_in_requires_approval
    FROM public.absensi a
    WHERE a.employee_id=v_emp.employee_id AND a.tanggal=v_today AND a.tipe='MASUK'
      AND a.status_approval NOT IN ('DITOLAK_ATASAN','DITOLAK_HR')
    ORDER BY a.jam DESC, a.timestamp DESC LIMIT 1;
  END IF;
  IF p_tipe='PULANG' AND v_prior_in_requires_approval THEN
    v_status := CASE WHEN v_prior_in_status IN ('PENDING_ATASAN','PENDING_HR') THEN v_prior_in_status ELSE 'PENDING_ATASAN' END;
    v_atasan := COALESCE(v_prior_in_manager, v_emp.approval_line_id);
    v_approval_required := TRUE;
  ELSIF v_in_office THEN
    v_status := 'VALID'; v_atasan := null;
  ELSE
    v_status := 'PENDING_ATASAN'; v_atasan := v_emp.approval_line_id;
    v_approval_required := TRUE;
  END IF;

  -- ===== FIX 2 & 3: INSERT + FOTO SEKALIGUS =====
  v_id := 'ABS-' || to_char(timezone('Asia/Jakarta', now()), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
       || '-' || v_emp.employee_id;

  insert into public.absensi(
    id, employee_id, tanggal, jam, timestamp, tipe,
    latitude, longitude, accuracy, address, catatan,
    branch_target, distance_m, status_approval, atasan_id,
    face_match, face_distance, face_local_precheck, approval_required,
    foto_url                                    -- ← foto base64 disimpan di sini
  ) values (
    v_id, v_emp.employee_id, v_today, v_now, now(), p_tipe,
    p_lat, p_lon, p_acc, p_address, p_catatan,
    v_office.branch, v_distance, v_status, v_atasan,
    true, v_face_dist, false, v_approval_required,
    p_foto_base64                               -- ← langsung tersimpan, TIDAK ada race condition
  );

  return json_build_object(
    'success',        true,
    'id',             v_id,
    'inOffice',       v_in_office,
    'message',        case
                        when v_status = 'VALID' then
                          case when p_tipe='MASUK' then 'Clock In berhasil.'
                               else 'Clock Out berhasil.' end
                        else 'Pengajuan presensi terkirim. Menunggu persetujuan.'
                      end,
    'statusApproval', v_status,
    'tanggal',        to_char(v_today, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
    'jam',            to_char(v_now, 'HH24:MI:SS'),
    'tipe',           p_tipe
  );
end;
$$;


--
-- Name: submit_attendance_with_photo(text, text, double precision, double precision, double precision, text, text, text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -

CREATE FUNCTION public.submit_attendance_with_photo(p_token text, p_tipe text, p_lat double precision, p_lon double precision, p_acc double precision, p_descriptor text, p_catatan text, p_address text, p_foto_base64 text) RETURNS json

  );

CREATE FUNCTION public.submit_attendance_with_photo__v12_internal(p_token text, p_tipe text, p_lat double precision, p_lon double precision, p_acc double precision, p_descriptor text, p_catatan text, p_address text, p_foto_base64 text) RETURNS json
